The island was appreciated by the Romans already for its excellent wines, hidden sandy bays, pristine clear waters and sands used for medicinal purposes. Tourism flourished during the Austro-Hungarian reign when doctor Hojs organized a health spa in the Bay of Bok. Nowadays this is the island of expatriots. Over 3000 of original inhabitants and their descendents live in the United States. The island is home only to around 150 local people. But it is slowly becoming a European retreat of house owners searching rural pleasures and peaceful artistic existence. Throughout the year the island has a daily connection with the island of Mali Lošinj and the mainland either by ship or catamaran. The island has a an elementary school, a post office, health care center, typical village pubs where you can get famous squids from the Adriatic Sea. The island of Susak was proclaimed a national heritage therefore there are no hotels and no cars on the island .

Name: European Holiday Home Association
Company description: The European Holiday Home Association (EHHA) is a united voice of short-term rentals in Europe. Short-term rental accommodation represents about one quarter of all tourist accommodation in the EU. EHHA members are national associations which represent property managers and property owners, online short-term rental platforms and companies which provide ancillary services to short-term rental accommodation providers (it can be a provision of a software, cleaning services, provision of linen, guest facing technology and many more).  EHHA members are playing a vital role by providing accommodation offerings that are widely dispersed across European towns and regions (not just in city centres), and by funnelling the economic benefits of travel into wider communities by encouraging local spending and contributing income to short-term rental providers. We continuously engage with policy makers to support harmonized, proportionate, clear and justified regulation at all levels. We trust this will ensure the safe and sustainable growth of STR activity, such that it can contribute to Europe’s recovery, while providing authorities with the necessary transparency and oversight they need to enforce local rules. For any further questions, please contact us by writing an email to info@ehha.eu

De authentieke druivenrassen, als het kan biologisch, maar toch liefst duurzaam geteeld, zorgen ervoor dat de persoonlijkheid van de wijnmaker weerspiegeld wordt in het karakter van de wijn, om zo tot een maximale wijnbeleving te komen. “Wijnen die verrukkelijk smaken” is hier de boodschap: Een wijn waar je gewoonweg gelukkig van wordt, om zomaar te genieten, of bij het juiste gerecht ,…. daar streven wij naar …

Skal det være fylt med aktiviteter? Ja takk, litt av alt sammen, sier du kanskje… Vi har alle en fornemmelse av hva et slikt sted skal være. Men kan du sette fingeren på det? Til sammen kan de tilby deg det meste av det du ser etter. Alle plukket ut av en grunn. Alle er forskjellige. Alle med hver sin atmosfære – skapt av menneskene som jobber der, historien og omgivelsene. I en skog. I et åpent landskap. Med en utsikt. Ved sjøen. I enden av en vei. Steder som kan endre deg og de du reiser med. Ikke mye. Men litt, hvis du vil. Det beste er at du ikke trenger å reise så langt. Det er bare å vite om mulighetene. Tilbud fra over 60 unike hoteller på 1 time ⏱ Hotell og gjestegårder. Skapt av historie, omgivelse og menneskene som jobber der.

Eiendommen består av et stort hovedhus med møtesal, peisestue, biljard- og bordtennisrom, spisesal og storkjøkken. Overnatting skjer på 7 hytter, hvorav 5 hytter er nybygg. Rommene varierer fra dobbeltrom til flerpersonsrom (dorms) med inntil 7 sengeplasser. De resterende to hyttene er i 90-talls stil.  Vi er bygget og blir vedlikeholdt primært på dugnad av kjære venner med hjerte for folket i Nordfjord. Fjordly eies av Normisjon region Sogn og Fjordane.  Eiendommen er rusfri sone. Bruk av alkohol og rusmiddel er ikke tillatt inne eller ute på området.  Fjordly er forpliktet på Normisjon sitt kristne verdigrunnlag. Vi ønsker å skape eit helt himmelsk leirsted som har Jesu hjertevarme til alle, men med spesielt hjerte, øyner og ører for barn og unge.

To see all the different Kempinski jobs and apply please go to https://kempinski.jobs It is also possible to search and find the Kempinski jobs in LinkedIn's  "Jobs"​ section.

Name: SANI RESORT
Company description: Sani Resort is a luxurious landscape stretching across fragrant pine forests, golden sands and crystal clear waters. This is the awe-inspiring thousand-acre natural backdrop to Sani Resort, home to five multiple-awarded 5-star hotels recognized around the globe by leading travel organizations. Five stunning properties all within walking distance of each other, yet far enough away to create a real sense of individuality. While the beating heart of Sani is the vibrant, glamorous Marina with its sumptuous restaurants, bars and boutiques. Employees are the most valuable asset at Sani Resort and our aim is to develop staff skills and help them to reach their potential. We are always on the outlook to identify, recruit and maintain the people with the greatest smile and passion to provide exceptional guest services, which characterises the whole company  Do you enjoy smiling? Join our team!

Name: Travel Charme Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Bright eyes. Vacation dreams. Favourite places. Travel Charme Hotels & Resorts, which the Hirmer Group took over in 2018, stands for unique experiences and genuine hospitality. The portfolio of the upscale holiday hotel expert currently includes eleven individual establishments: the Kurhaus Binz and the Nordperd & Villen Göhren on Rügen, the Strandhotel Bansin and the Strandidyll Heringsdorf on Usedom, the Ostseehotel Kühlungsborn, the Hotel Gothisches Haus in Wernigerode and the Bergresort Werfenweng in the Salzburg region, the Fürstenhaus on Lake Achensee in Tyrol, the Ifen Hotel in the Kleinwalsertal and also the Badeschloss and the Straubinger Grand Hotel in Bad Gastein. The individual hotels not only impress with their unique dreamy locations, they also inspire their guests with an unmistakable mixture of personal service, a pinch of adventure and a lot of passion.

Name: Event Hotels
Company description: Alle Infos zu Aktionen, Karriere, Datenschutz & Impressum sind im Shared Link aufzufinden ⬇️ Gut zu wissen: …unsere 59 Häuser verfügen in Summe über 9.993 Zimmer. …jene Hotels werden nicht nur über die beiden Zentralen in Köln, sondern auch von Berlin, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Liechtenstein und Luxemburg aus gesteuert. …in allen zentralen Büros arbeiten derzeit über 200 Kolleg*innen. …und in allen Hotels aktuell mehr als 2.500 Mitarbeiter*innen. …wir beschreiben uns als fair, kreativ, modern, zuverlässig, aufgeschlossen und ambitioniert. Unsere Geschichte: Event Hotels fand seine Entstehung im Jahre 1992 und ist ein Gründer- und Inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Anders Braks (CEO) übernahm zu jenem Zeitpunkt das erste Hotel und begründete damit die Erfolgsgeschichte der Event Hotels, denn mittlerweile werden durch Event Hotels 59 Häuser in Europa (Deutschland, Niederlande und Italien) betrieben. Innerhalb des Investment Rankings wird Event Hotels mit AA bewertet. Name: MHP Hotel AG
Company description: MHP Hotel AG, formerly known as Munich Hotel Partners GmbH, is an independent hotel investment and management platform headquartered in Munich, specializing in premium and luxury hotels. The company is dedicated to sustainability, integrating environmental protection, resource conservation, and climate neutrality into its operations, as demonstrated by the LEED O+M Platinum certification awarded to the Basel Marriott Hotel. Operating as a white-label hotel operator, MHP establishes strong partnerships with major hotel brands and property owners, emphasizing transparent communication and long-term relationships. Its impressive portfolio features notable properties such as Le Méridien in various cities, the JW Marriott in Frankfurt, and the upcoming Conrad Hamburg, catering to both business and leisure travelers in prime urban locations. MHP Hotel AG's mission is encapsulated in its motto "You Matter," highlighting the significance of guests, employees, and investors in creating a positive and inclusive hospitality experience. The company is a prominent player in the hospitality industry, managing operations across key cities in Germany and Austria, including Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Munich, and Vienna. MHP is committed to providing exceptional service and crafting memorable experiences for its guests, reflecting its mission to enhance the quality of hospitality. By collaborating with a diverse range of partners and clients, MHP focuses on meeting the evolving needs of modern travelers, whether they are on leisure or business trips. With a strong commitment to excellence and innovation, MHP Hotel AG strives to be a leader in the hotel sector, ensuring that each property under its management adheres to the highest standards of comfort and service.

Name: COSTA NAVARINO
Company description: Costa Navarino is a sustainably driven destination in the Mediterranean, located in Messinia in the southwest Peloponnese of Greece.  Graced with a breath-taking seaside landscape, this is a region shaped by 4,500 years of history. The Costa Navarino philosophy is driven by a genuine desire to preserve the natural beauty and heritage of Messinia. The destination comprises several distinct sites featuring five-star hotels, luxury private residences, a world-class golf experience, and many year-round activities. Navarino Dunes is home to The Romanos, a Luxury Collection Resort, The Westin Resort Costa Navarino and Costa Navarino Residences. Navarino Bay is the setting for Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino, W Costa Navarino and Navarino Agora, a curated marketplace. Both sites have signature golf courses, while at Navarino Hills there are two further signature golf courses.

Name: Hotel Bayerischer Hof München
Company description: Hotel Bayerischer Hof München is a prestigious luxury hotel situated in the heart of Munich, celebrated for its exceptional hospitality and commitment to creating magical moments for its guests. With a rich history that seamlessly blends tradition with modernity, the hotel continuously evolves to offer new highlights, including exquisite dining options and elegantly designed accommodations, such as newly developed suites. The hotel's mission is to provide exceptional service and a unique atmosphere, particularly during festive seasons like Christmas and New Year's Eve, where guests can indulge in gourmet menus and celebratory events. Catering to a diverse clientele, including families, business travelers, and event organizers, Hotel Bayerischer Hof features a variety of venues for private and corporate gatherings. The hotel also partners with local cultural institutions to enhance the guest experience, offering a holistic approach to luxury hospitality. Among its luxurious amenities are the renowned Blue Spa and fine dining restaurants, which aim to provide both relaxation and vibrant city life. The sophisticated beauty center within the hotel offers a range of cosmetic treatments and wellness services, ensuring a rejuvenating experience for all clients. The experienced team at the beauty center is dedicated to personalized care and indulgence, further enhancing the overall guest experience. Hotel Bayerischer Hof München targets discerning guests seeking luxury accommodations, fine dining, and exclusive wellness experiences in a historic and elegant setting, making it a premier destination in Munich.

Name: Deutsche Hospitality
Company description: Deutsche Hospitality stands for an exceptional portfolio comprising more than 130 hotels in 20 countries on three continents, about 30 hotels are currently under development. Deutsche Hospitality stands for an exceptional portfolio comprising more than 130 hotels in 20 countries on three continents, about 30 hotels are currently under development. The unique and varied Deutsche Hospitality portfolio includes Steigenberger Porsche Design Hotels, Steigenberger ICONs, Steigenberger Hotels & Resorts, MAXX by Deutsche Hospitality, our lifestyle option, Jaz in the City, the IntercityHotels at busy hubs such as railway stations and airports and the Zleep Hotels with quality and design at an affordable price.

Name: Motel One Group
Company description: Motel One Group is a leading budget design hotel chain that operates over 95 hotels across 13 countries, primarily in major European cities. The company is known for its modern design, high service standards, and prime urban locations, offering guests a comfortable and stylish stay at competitive prices. With a mission to create a welcoming environment that feels like a home away from home, Motel One emphasizes appreciation, openness, and teamwork among its staff, fostering a strong sense of community. The target market includes both business and leisure travelers seeking quality accommodations without the high price tag, and the company is committed to sustainability, utilizing eco-friendly practices in its operations. As a pioneer in the budget design hotel concept, Motel One continues to expand its footprint, providing numerous career opportunities for ambitious individuals in the hospitality industry.

Name: Mitsis Group
Company description: As Greece’s largest privately-owned hotel chain, MITSIS has been a tourism pioneer for 50 years now, making its own mark on Greece’s tourist industry, driven by a customer - centered philosophy and the promise of an unparalleled holiday experience.  With 24 hotels in our portfolio in Athens, Chalkidiki, Corfu, Crete, Kamena Vourla, Kos, Rhodes, Piraeus and Santorini, we aspire to stand out as the preferred portfolio of hotels & resorts in Greece offering excellent service, great locations, impeccable facilities, sophisticated dining and a broad spectrum of options for our clientele.  We bring to life enriching experiences for our guests, making the most of our unparalleled family touch and genuine Greek essence, always seeking to be flexible and adaptable to individual customer needs and the mindset of new generations.  Transforming each visitor into a special guest is the key to our success.  Mitsis Group has been awarded several prizes by local and international tour operators and travel organizations in recognition of the high quality of the services provided, its contribution to upgrading local tourism and its respect for the environment. We are proud to be named Great Place To Work® Certified™ thanks to our people.

Name: Victor's Group
Company description: Wir sind Gastgeber und Allesgeber. Helfende Hand mit offenem Ohr. Feinschmecker und Entdecker. Pfleger und Verleger. Wir sind groß, erfahren und international. In unserem Mittelpunkt steht immer der Mensch. Mit dem großen Ziel, Menschen durch besten Service mehr Lebensqualität zu bieten, eröffnete Hartmut Ostermann im Jahr 1977 seine erste Seniorenresidenz – und legte damit den Grundstein für die Victor’s Group, die heute vorrangig in drei großen Geschäftsfeldern tätig ist. Pflege und medizinische Dienstleistungen: Die Victor’s Group betreibt unter den Marken Pro Seniore, Residenz Ambiente, SenVital, Best Care und weiteren Einzelmarken deutschlandweit über 120 Einrichtungen im Gesundheitswesen. Damit zählt sie zu den größten Anbietern von Pflege- und Wohneinrichtungen in Deutschland. Hotellerie und Gastronomie: In Deutschland sprechen 14 Victor’s Residenz-Hotels sowohl Freizeit- als auch Businessgäste an. Nahe Lissabon betreibt Victor’s die Ferienhausanlage Victor’s Portugal Malveira-Guincho. Catering und Gebäudemanagement: Victor’s Health Care wurde 1990 in Mannheim gegründet und ist seitdem bundesweit als Spezialist für Catering und Service im Gesundheits- und Sozialbereich im Einsatz. All das ist natürlich nur mit kompetenten, motivierten Menschen möglich: In der Victor’s Group sind rund 12.500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter beschäftigt – Tendenz steigend. Mit mehreren unternehmenseigenen Fachschulen sowie lebendigen Aus- und Weiterbildungssystemen investiert Victor’s permanent in neue Fach- und Führungskräfte, bietet aber auch langjährigen Mitarbeitern beste Aufstiegschancen. Alle Mitarbeiter der Victor’s Group profitieren zudem von attraktiven Vorteilen, zum Beispiel von ganzjährigen Rabatten in allen Victor’s Residenz-Hotels und der Ferienhausanlage Victor’s Portugal Malveira-Guincho sowie Vergünstigungen in zahlreichen bekannten Onlineshops.

Name: Trivago NV
Company description: trivago NV is a holding company, which engages in the provision of a global hotel and accommodation search platform. The company is headquartered in Dusseldorf, Nordrhein-Westfalen and currently employs 668 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2016-12-16. The firm and its subsidiaries offer online meta-search for hotel and accommodation through online travel agencies (OTAs), hotel chains and independent hotels. The firm is focused on focused on reshaping the way travelers search for and compare hotels while enabling hotel advertisers to grow their businesses by providing access to a broad audience of travelers through the Company's websites and apps. The platform allows travelers to make informed decisions by personalizing their hotel search and providing access to a deep supply of hotel information and prices. The firm operates in three operating segments namely the Americas, Developed Europe and the Rest of the World. The firm offer marketing tools to help promote their listings on platform and drive traffic to their websites. The tools and services, including the subscription-based trivago Business Studio Pro Apps Package.

Name: NOVUM Hospitality
Company description: NOVUM Hospitality is one of Europe's largest family-owned hotel groups, operating over 150 hotels across more than 60 locations. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Hamburg, the company has established itself as a key player in the midscale and upper midscale hotel segments, known for its diverse range of centrally located accommodations. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality experiences, NOVUM Hospitality emphasizes community engagement and sustainability, aiming to create a welcoming environment for all guests. The company has recently entered a strategic partnership with IHG Hotels & Resorts, positioning itself as a major global franchise partner and launching the innovative co-brand Holiday Inn – the niu. This collaboration enhances NOVUM's offerings, allowing it to cater to a broader audience, including business and leisure travelers seeking modern, locally inspired hotel experiences.

Name: GCH Hotel Group
Company description: GCH Hotel Group is a leading hotel management company in Europe, operating over 80 hotels in Germany and Austria, with an additional 40 properties across Europe, totaling more than 15,000 rooms and serving over 3 million guests annually. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality through a centralized professional management approach, allowing individual hotels to focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences. GCH Hotel Group's mission is encapsulated in their motto "Let’s Grow, Create, Host," emphasizing their commitment to growth, creativity, and responsibility. Their target market includes business travelers, families, and event organizers, with properties like the Wyndham Hannover Atrium offering extensive amenities such as meeting rooms, fitness facilities, and award-winning dining options. The company values trust, engagement, and flexibility, striving to be the most valuable hotel management entity in Europe.

Name: Maritim Hotelgesellschaft MbH
Company description: Maritim Hotelgesellschaft mbH is one of the largest owner-managed hotel chains in Germany, with a diverse portfolio of hotels spanning seven countries, including Mauritius, Egypt, Malta, Albania, Bulgaria, Italy, and China. Established in 1846, the company has built a reputation for providing exceptional hospitality experiences that blend modern amenities with timeless elegance. Maritim is dedicated to enhancing guest satisfaction through a strong focus on high service quality, innovative digital solutions, and sustainable practices. The company's mission is to create a welcoming environment for both business and leisure travelers, ensuring that every guest enjoys a memorable stay. Maritim caters to a wide range of clients, from individual travelers seeking comfort to corporate groups in need of comprehensive conference facilities. The company partners with local businesses to promote regional tourism, further enriching the guest experience and supporting community engagement. With a commitment to sustainability, Maritim actively invests in initiatives such as e-charging stations and eco-friendly practices, aiming to minimize its environmental impact while maintaining high standards of service. The company's vision includes expanding its international presence while upholding its core values of quality, hospitality, and community involvement. By continuously improving service quality and operational efficiency, Maritim Hotelgesellschaft mbH strives to remain a leading player in the hospitality industry, ensuring that all guests receive exceptional service and a comfortable, enjoyable experience.

Name: Meeting Point Hotels
Company description: Meeting Point Hotels is a prominent hotel management company that operates a diverse portfolio of properties across various destinations, including Spain, Greece, and Italy. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality experiences, focusing on comfort, quality, and sustainability. With a mission to redefine the art of hospitality, Meeting Point Hotels aims to create memorable stays for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. Their target market includes leisure travelers seeking relaxation and adventure in picturesque locations. The company collaborates with various partners, including travel agencies and local businesses, to enhance guest experiences and promote regional tourism. Through continuous innovation and a commitment to customer satisfaction, Meeting Point Hotels strives to be a leader in the hospitality industry.

Name: Lindner Hotel Group
HQ Location: Germany, North Rhine-westphalia, Düsseldorf, 20 Emanuel-leutze Straße, 40547
Company description: Die Lindner Hotels AG wurde 1973 in Düsseldorf von Diplom-Ingenieur und Architekt Otto Lindner gegründet. Die AG ist die Muttergesellschaft der Lindner Hotel Group und beschäftigt selbst derzeit knapp 850 Mitarbeitende. Die Lindner Hotel Group hat ihre Präsenz im Markt mit vier Marken klar strukturiert: Lindner Hotels & Resorts im oberen Mittelklassesegment, die luxuriösen 7Pines Hotels & Resorts, die urbanen Lifestyle-Boutique-Hotels, die unter der Marke Me and All von Hyatt betrieben werden, und die L-Collection, eine Kollektion exklusiver internationaler Destinationen. Von den insgesamt 35 Hotels der restrukturierten Lindner Hotel Group betreibt die Lindner Hotels AG neun Hotels an sieben Standorten. Die Hotelstandorte der ‚LHG Lifestyle Hotels GmbH (Me and All)‘, der ‚7Pines‘ und ‚L Collection‘ in Deutschland, Europa und eines in den USA waren von dem für die Lindner Hotels AG beantragten Verfahren nicht unmittelbar betroffen. Ebenso wenig die in Realisierung befindlichen ‚Me and All‘-Projekte der LHG Lifestyle Hotels GmbH. Adrian Lindner (CEO), Dr. Christoph Scherk (CFO) bilden den Vorstand der Lindner Hotels AG.

Name: Lindner Hotels & Resorts | Part Of JdV By Hyatt
Company description: Founded by Otto Lindner in Düsseldorf in the 1970s, the Lindner Hotels & Resorts brand embodies timeless values. As a family-owned business, we honour the spirit of our founder, guiding decisions for future generations. Navigating the evolving hospitality industry, we've maintained Lindner's values while strategically rebranding for new segments and global markets. Dedicated to innovation, we've revitalised the brand, preserving its essence amidst growth. Ready to share our journey, rooted in tradition yet forward thinking!

Name: Premier Inn Deutschland
Company description: Premier Inn Deutschland, a subsidiary of the British Whitbread Group, is a rapidly growing hotel chain specializing in the premium economy segment. With its first hotel opening in Rosenheim and a total of 60 locations across Germany, the company aims to become the number one player in this market segment. Premier Inn provides guests with comfortable accommodations featuring modern amenities and a high level of hospitality, supported by an international team. The hotels are strategically located in central areas, making them ideal for both business travelers and tourists.  The company is committed to community engagement, actively supporting local initiatives such as collaborations with the children's charity Children for a Better World e.V. Premier Inn's target audience includes both transient travelers and vacationers looking to explore Germany's cultural and natural attractions. The hotel chain is known for offering affordable and comfortable lodging in various cities, with a mission to ensure a restful stay through high-quality services and amenities in a welcoming environment.  Focusing on family-friendliness, Premier Inn offers special deals where children under 16 can stay and eat breakfast for free. The clientele encompasses both business professionals and leisure travelers seeking central locations and good value for money. By partnering with local organizers and tourism organizations, Premier Inn enhances guest experiences, often integrating cultural events such as musicals and city tours. The company is dedicated to expanding its presence in key urban areas, catering to a diverse clientele that includes international tourists and families, while continuously innovating to meet the evolving needs of its guests.

Name: Living Hotels
Company description: Living Hotels – Apartments in hotels // Home away from home Whether for business or pleasure, Living Hotels are your temporary home away from home. Besides cozy hotel rooms we also offer you affordable serviced apartments: comfortably furnished with complete kitchen or kitchenette, separate living and working area, state-of-the-art business technology, WLAN access and individual round-the-clock service. And by the way: It´s getting cheaper, the longer you stay!  As we are a family-owned, medium-sized business, one thing is very important to us: We are cordial and individual and want our employees and guests to feel comfortable with us. We cater for personal issues and desires with passion and commitment and try to be close to the people as a host AND employer. For the unique feeling to have found a second home. Our history of success started in 1982. Today, we are market leaders in the area of serviced apartments in German-speaking countries and offer around 3,000 rooms in 17 different Living Hotels to business and private travelers – of course always in an excellent location. Visit us in Berlin, Bonn, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt / Main, Munich, Nuremberg, Weimar or Vienna. We are looking forward to meeting you there! Follow this link to see our imprint: https://www.living-hotels.com/en/imprint/

Name: AHORN Hotels & Resorts
Company description: AHORN Hotels & Resorts is a prominent family-run hotel group based in Berlin, operating seven vacation hotels across Germany, primarily in scenic natural landscapes such as the Erzgebirge, Thüringer Wald, Uckermark, and Harz. With a focus on family and active vacations, the company offers a range of accommodations in the 3-star superior and 4-star categories, totaling 2,389 rooms. AHORN's mission emphasizes creating a positive work environment and fostering employee development, which is reflected in their high employee satisfaction ratings and commitment to training young talents. The company targets families and active travelers, providing diverse leisure and dining options to enhance guest experiences. Additionally, AHORN Hotels & Resorts is dedicated to maintaining strong partnerships and a supportive community for both employees and guests, ensuring a welcoming atmosphere for all.

Name: Motel One Germany Betriebs GmbH
Company description: The Munich-based company was founded in 2000 and currently operates over 90 hotels in 12 countries. Motel One offers a unique combination of high-quality interiors, exclusive design, excellent service and outstanding city centre locations at attractive prices. As the creator and a champion of the budget design concept, we believe in evolving continuously rather than resting on our laurels. We embrace our social responsibility, encourage and support our employees, give them a stake in the company’s success with attractive incentives, and do our bit towards social integration. We are warm hosts and committed to sustainable development. We strive to maintain high levels of satisfaction among our staff and our guests. These things provide a solid basis for the successful evolution of Motel One in major cities in Germany and abroad.

Name: Dorint Hotels Betriebs GmbH
Company description: Dorint Hotels Betriebs GmbH is a prominent player in the hospitality industry, specializing in the operation and management of luxury hotels across Germany, including the esteemed Maison Messmer in Baden-Baden. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional guest experiences by blending modern luxury with traditional hospitality, creating a welcoming atmosphere that feels like a home away from home. With a strong emphasis on high-quality service, Dorint Hotels caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, business professionals, and event organizers. The company offers tailored services such as gourmet dining, wellness facilities, and exclusive event spaces, ensuring that every guest's needs are met. Dorint Hotels is committed to wellness and relaxation, featuring amenities like thermal baths and various sauna experiences that appeal to both leisure travelers and business clients. Their mission is to create memorable moments for guests, whether through family celebrations or corporate events, supported by state-of-the-art conference facilities. The company partners with local businesses and cultural institutions to enhance the guest experience and promote the unique charm of each location, fostering a sense of community engagement. Dorint Hotels envisions itself as a leader in the luxury hotel market, with a commitment to sustainability and responsible tourism. By focusing on innovative offerings and exceptional service, Dorint Hotels aims to ensure that every guest leaves with unforgettable memories, solidifying its reputation as a premier choice in the hospitality sector.

Name: Oetker Hotels
Company description: Oetker Hotels are true masterpieces located in the world’s most desirable destinations. Each property is a landmark and a timeless icon of elegance. With deep devotion to local culture and community, our Hosts of Choice preserve a tradition of legendary European hospitality and genuine family spirit that began in 1872. The collection includes L’Apogée Courchevel, Le Bristol Paris, Brenners Park-Hotel & Spa in Baden-Baden, Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, Château Saint-Martin & Spa in Vence, The Lanesborough in London, Eden Rock-St Barths, Jumby Bay Island in Antigua, Palácio Tangará in São Paulo, Hotel La Palma in Capri, The Vineta Hotel in Palm Beach (2025), and more than 150 private villas around the globe. In 2027, a new masterpiece will be opening in Saint-Tropez.

Name: Scorpios
Company description: Never sitting still at the intersection of hospitality, gastronomy, architecture, design, music and visual art, Scorpios is a constellation of gathering places that brings cultural experimentation to sublime natural surroundings. Dreamed up in 2015 on a sun-drenched southern tip of Mykonos, the brand's flagship project soon became synonymous with the revival of the Greek island's left-field electronic music scene as a community organically blossomed, bringing mindfulness, visual art, fashion, and craft into the fold. Catching the attention of Soho House in 2019, Scorpios then set its sights further afield.  In 2024, Scorpios unveiled its new flagship location on a secluded peninsula along Turkey’s Bodrum Aegean coast, introducing its first accommodations and wellness offerings to deliver a round-the-clock experience. By nurturing the community, prioritising wellbeing in all its forms, encouraging creative collaboration, and framing nature's beauty, the Scorpios and Soho House partnership looks forward to opening projects in Athens and Dubai.

Name: Pentahotels
Company description: Hey! We are Penta, your lively neighborhood hotel. We make no distinction between leisure and business travellers, and our friendly and laid-back approach starts from the check-in at the bar.  Over 20 hotels across Europe, each one gravitating around our hallmark Pentalounge: a combination of lounge, bar, café and reception – your new living room, with standout interior design. You are who you meet, so, get travelling.

Name: Flemings Hotels
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Frankfurt Am Main, 52 Bleichstraße, 60313
Company description: Die Flemings Hotels sind ein einzigartiges Sortiment individueller Hotels in Familienbesitz mit Firmensitz in Frankfurt am Main. Zur Flemings Hotels GmbH & Co. KG gehören insgesamt 7 Mid- und Upscale-Hotels: 6 zentral gelegene Cityhotels in Frankfurt, München und Wien sowie ein Franchisebetrieb der Intercityhotel GmbH in Bremen. Unsere Hotels bieten eine perfekte Kombination aus modernem Komfort und zeitgemäßem Design. Jedes Hotel überzeugt mit seinem Boutique at Heart-Ansatz durch individuelle Zimmer, die mit hochwertigen Annehmlichkeiten ausgestattet sind und sowohl Geschäftsreisende als auch Städtereisende ansprechen. Mit unseren flexiblen Tagungsmöglichkeiten, moderner Technik und Inhouse-Restaurants sind wir der ideale Partner für große und kleine Veranstaltungen. Unsere „People makes places“-Philosophie spiegelt dabei unsere Leidenschaft wider, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste einzugehen und ihnen Flemings Moments zu bescheren.

Name: Ruby
Company description: We believe that a hotel should be more than just a bed for the night. Where you stay when you’re away from home should be stylish and inspiring. Somewhere characterful and charming, with the flexibility to hit the town or settle in for an evening. ✨ When it comes to where you work, we think it should be just as inspiring. Places with personality and soul, that bring new ideas to life and brighten your workday. ❤️ Since launching in 2013, we’ve opened 17 hotels and 5 workspaces across Europe, and there are 19 more on the horizon. Start a fresh chapter with us; see our open opportunities across all our destinations here.  👉🏽rubyverse.com/career We pride ourselves on our Lean Luxury philosophy. By streamlining things behind the scenes and being smart with every detail and space, we can offer unforgettable, city-centre locations at a fraction of the normal cost. 🚀 Stay up-to-date about our upcoming openings and promotions by following us across our channels and subscribing to our newsletter 📬 🚀 ruby-hotels.com 💻 ruby-workspaces.com 📍 lean-luxury.com ☞ instagram.com/rubyhotels ☞ instagram.com/rubyworkspaces For more information about our transparency and accountability imprint please visit  https://www.ruby-hotels.com/en/system/imprint

Name: SantAnna
Company description: SantAnna offers unpretentious luxury and sophisticated entertainment on the prominent island of Mykonos.  Located on Paranga Beach on the south of the island, protected from the Mykonian winds, boasts a Beach Club, 3 restaurants with revisited Mediterranean cuisine, sushi and a raw bar and one of the biggest seawater swimming pools in Europe, retail shops, a wellness center and many different lounge areas are also available for the constant indulgence of the visitors with a choice of exclusive services upon request.  SantAnna is the most diverse project of the Nice-n-Easy Restaurant Group which includes eight successful organic restaurants; Nice-n-Easy Mykonos at the island’s town and Nesaea with contemporary creative Greek island cuisine on Agia Anna Beach at Kalafatis, two Nice-n-Easy restaurants in Athens in Kolonaki and Kifissia & the Italian bistro & bar Frankie in Athens. In May 2018, the newest addition to the group, "nice n easy" Seaside, debuted in the Greek capital’s most iconic location, Astir Beach. "Nice n easy" group is also operating the “Exquisite Catering,” which is a leading catering service on Mykonos for private villas and hotels, offering its services across Greece.

Name: MEININGER Hotels
Company description: MEININGER Hotels is a dynamic hotel chain that merges the comfort of traditional hotels with the vibrant atmosphere of hostels, catering to a diverse range of travelers. Founded in Berlin in 1999, the company has grown to operate over 36 properties across 26 cities in 10 European countries, providing budget-friendly accommodations in prime urban locations. MEININGER's mission is to offer accessible and affordable comfort while fostering local identities and promoting sustainability. The hotels are designed to create a welcoming environment for everyone, from backpackers and families to business travelers, encouraging social interaction and community building. With a focus on flexibility, MEININGER provides a variety of room types, including private rooms and shared dormitories, making it ideal for educational groups, leisure guests, and corporate travelers alike. The company emphasizes modern amenities such as guest kitchens, game zones, and work-friendly public areas, ensuring that both short stays and extended visits are enjoyable. MEININGER's vision is to enhance the travel experience by not only providing a place to stay but also creating a vibrant community space that encourages guest interaction. Committed to sustainability and corporate social responsibility, MEININGER actively engages in projects that promote environmental and social well-being. The company aims to expand its portfolio to 22,000 beds by 2024, supported by strategic partnerships and a dedicated team focused on enhancing the guest experience. By collaborating with local businesses and attractions, MEININGER enriches the travel experience, allowing guests to immerse themselves in the local culture. Overall, MEININGER Hotels stands out as a preferred choice for budget-conscious travelers seeking both comfort and community during their adventures.

Name: Success Hotel Group

W każdym obiekcie zapewniamy opiekę rezydentów i pilotów, atrakcyjne i wyjątkowe wycieczki lokalne, pozwalające na odkrywanie Grecji oraz wyjątkowe Kluby Animacyjne — „Zorba”, „Delfinki” i „Opa! Grecos” zapewniające dobrą zabawę i organizację czasu wakacji Klientom z każdej grupy wiekowej.

Company description: The Seaside Collection Hotel Group comprises of in total 12 exclusive resort and city hotels: in Gran Canaria, Lanzarote and the Maldives and six city hotels in Hamburg, Leipzig, Dresden, St. Peter Ording and Chemnitz. All of the Seaside establishments are acclaimed for their privileged locations, personal service and exclusive gastronomy together with unique architecture and distinctive design concepts. The group was founded in the Canary Islands over 30 years ago by Theo Gerlach, who at the age of 90 years continues personally at the helm of his hotels. In 1997, his son Gregor Gerlach assumed responsibility for the German division of the group. And for some years his daughter Anouchka Gerlach is responsible together with her father for the Spanish division of the group. The group is highly acclaimed as setting the benchmark for hotel gastronomy. In addition to the hospitality industry, the Seaside Collection Hotel Group is active in construction and gastronomy.  Seaside Collection is recognized for its values as a business that strives to provide longevity for employees and their commitments to sustainable tourism. Theo Gerlach firmly believes that sustainable development will permit tourism to be the driving force behind economic prosperity. The ongoing initiatives in each individual hotel encompass these principles and remain his legacy to future generations.  Investment plans incorporate refurbishments to maintain the hotels at an optimal standard together with the introduction of new sustainability initiatives to ensure a continued reduction in environmental impacts encouraging sustainable development. Innovative future projects ensure a stable model of growth, professionalism and service to their guests.

Company description: Die Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar GmbH ist eine zentrale Institution, die sich der nachhaltigen Entwicklung und Förderung der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar widmet. Ihre Mission umfasst die Förderung von Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Kultur sowie die Verbesserung der Lebensqualität für die Bürgerinnen und Bürger. Name: Hotel Augusta

High on the cliffs of Santorini, facing the ancient caldera, Canaves Collection Properties redefine hospitality as you know it. Welcome to Canaves Ena, Canaves Oia Suites, Canaves Sunday, Canaves Elefas Villas and Canaves Epitome.   From its inception, the theme of Canaves Collection has remained the same: to deliver unrivaled luxury experiences to guests so they can enjoy Santorini at it's best, all in one spot.

Company description: Slowness is a collective of people, places and projects that reframe the way we live and interact.  In times of great haste, we dare to be slow. Not a mere shift in velocity but an altered state of being. We break cycles of distraction and destruction, opening deep chasms of reflection and space for energetic insight. Slowness defies conventions, embracing the imperfect, the strange and indigenous. Not the prettiest apple but the tastiest, the unaltered, the one that bends the branch. Slowness has been quietly unfolding since the creation in 2016 of La Granja Ibiza. The transformation of a dormant agricultural plot into a working farmstead devoted to discourse around food set the stage for a new kind of hospitality concept. We began to assemble a community of designers, farmers, writers, artists, artisans and architects whose work engages with slowness toward a resetting of values in hospitality and beyond. Cultivating arts, crops and inner gardens, we build and nourish locally rooted places that offer a deeper, more conscious form of hospitality—not a “pit stop” away from the hectic pace of daily life but a continuous journey of reconnection, of learning to live in harmony with nature, our community and ourselves. Drawing on the insights of the slow movement, adaptive reuse, and regenerative agriculture, we take a localized, conscientious approach to every element in the creation of integrated aesthetic environments designed to enrich wellbeing and model a more sustainable future. We draw inspiration from idealistic collectives of the past, like the 1920s experimental Catskills retreat Yama Farms or the legendary avant-garde incubator Black Mountain College, which looked to traditional cultures and crafts as they dreamed up wildly innovative new forms. To be slow is not merely to decrease the pace of life. It’s about taking the time to reconsider our actions and think more deeply and responsibly about how we live.

Name: Fodele Beach & Water Park Holiday Resort
Company description: A care-free heaven waits 25 km west of Heraklion Airport. Carved into the cliffside, overlooking the sea, sits Fodele Beach & Water Park Resort. Company description: Willkommen in unserem Hotel auf Sylt Sylt. Das Eiland in der Nordsee ist für viele mehr als nur die schönste der nordfriesischen Inseln. Name: A&o Hostels
Company description: A&O Hostels, founded in 2000 by Oliver Winter, is the largest privately-owned hostel chain in Europe, boasting over 40 hostels across 27 cities in 11 countries. The company is dedicated to providing affordable and sustainable accommodation options, catering to a diverse clientele that includes backpackers, families, business travelers, and school groups. A&O's mission is to ensure that "everyone can travel," emphasizing cost-effectiveness and quality service in centrally located hostels.  With a strong commitment to sustainability, A&O aims to become Europe's first net-zero emissions hostel chain by 2025, implementing eco-friendly practices and responsible sourcing throughout its operations. The company focuses on energy efficiency, community engagement, and the well-being of its over 1,300 employees through comprehensive health and safety measures.  Targeting a wide range of travelers, A&O collaborates with local organizations to support social initiatives and cultural projects, enhancing the communities in which it operates. Known for its flexible booking options and amenities such as guest kitchens and pet-friendly policies, A&O provides a comfortable and convenient stay for all guests. The company prides itself on offering modern and affordable lodging options, ensuring a relaxed atmosphere complemented by free Wi-Fi.  A&O Hostels stands out as a leading budget accommodation provider in Europe, striving to create memorable experiences for its guests while maintaining the highest standards of service and comfort.

Name: Domes Aulūs Elounda Curio Collection By Hilton

Company description: Elaine’s World ist eine 2016 gegründete Gastronomie- und Eventmarke inmitten Frankfurts Innenstadt. Um und in Frankfurts populären Hochhausbauten gelegen, zählen zu unseren Locations unter anderem eine Espresso-Bar, ein Hybrid aus Deli und Museumscafé wie ein Fine Dining Restaurant mit Showküche. Name: Mykonos Grand Hotel & Resort
Company description: Dazzling whitewashed, cube-shaped buildings and cobbled paths set against the backdrop of a deep blue sea and sky, Mykonos Grand Hotel and Resort has a superb beachfront location barely three miles from Mykonos town. Opposite is the sacred island of Delos, said to be one of the sunniest areas in the world – and, according to Greek mythology, the birthplace of Apollo. All around is the island’s natural beauty: picturesque stretches of sand, crystalline seas, azure-blue skies and an earthen-colored landscape bathed in the unique Aegean light. Scattered across an extensive five acres to provide space and privacy, the 96 generously-sized rooms and suites are decorated in bright white with splashes of blue some with private pools. Furniture and decorative lighting is elegant and streamlined, recalling mid-twentieth century styling.   This stylish and restful enclave has a wonderfully pampering spa where Greek inspired massages can be held in cabanas by the sea, a beautiful 500sqm pool and a spectacular outdoor amphitheater for social events and exercise classes. The hotel’s gourmet Dolphins of Delos Restaurant is a dramatic open air dining experience with stunning views. While the Aqua e Sole Restaurant has a tranquil poolside location. Other resort’s facilities include tennis and squash courts and a Technogym fitness center.

Company description: Born from passion, honed by experience, and driven by innovation, we are a family-owned group home to three distinctive luxury resorts in Western Crete—ÓROS Resort, Pilot Beach, and Pilot Amphora—each a beacon of comfort and genuine Greek hospitality on the charming west coast of Crete. Our journey began in the early 90s with a pioneering spirit that laid the foundations not only for our resorts but for the region itself as a hub for exceptional and authentic Cretan hospitality. Today, guided by our unwavering values of hospitality, sustainability, and social responsibility, we continue to honour the beauty, heritage, and culture of Crete, giving back through conscious initiatives that protect the land and support the local community. Our commitment extends beyond luxury—we remain deeply devoted to our people, our environment, and the timeless essence of Philoxenia, where warm welcomes and effortless discreet service make every guest feel at home, in their own perfect retreat. With thoughtful attention to detail, we create a setting where every meaningful occasion is embraced with care. From the exclusive ÓROS Luxury Beach Resort, a sanctuary of refined indulgence overlooking the ceaseless blue horizon, to the renowned Pilot Beach Resort, where Cretan tradition meets five-star leisure, and Pilot Amphora, a timeless retreat inspired by the island’s rich heritage, we go beyond luxury to create life lasting moments. More than destinations, our resorts are places where memories are made, pampering every sense, amplifying every feeling and leaving an imprint that lingers long after departure.

Dalla scelta delle eccellenze enogastronomiche presenti nei Sicilia's Bar Restaurant Shop, al settore hospitality con il Picciolo Etna Golf • Resort & Spa e il Sicilia's Residence Hotel • Art & Spa.  Anche la movida porta in alto il nome del brand con l'iconico Sicilia's Cafe de Mar, punto di riferimento per i turisti e per i siciliani sul Lungomare di Aci Trezza. Il Gruppo Sicilia's dal 2021 promuove attivamente il golf in Sicilia con "Il Pìcciolo Golf Club", il primo campo da golf costruito in Sicilia nel 1989 e l’unico in Italia realizzato su di un vulcano attivo, patrimonio dell'UNESCO.  Nel giugno 2024, il gruppo inaugura Sicilia’s Torre Casalotto Etna Golf, uno splendido Golf driving range che sorge sulla panoramica collina di Aci Trezza. Il campo pratica cittadino, offre ai suoi ospiti corsi di golf per principianti, perfezionamento, allenamenti hi-tech con Trackman Simulator e un panoramico ristorante e lounge bar. Sicilia's è l'isola che piace.

Name: Burgerlich
Company description: Aus Liebe zum Burger Das Premium-Konzept Burgerlich setzt auf eine stringent durchgehende „Homemade- Philosophie“, hohe Qualität und Frische. Die Burger werden zu 100 Prozent aus qualitativ hochwertigem Rindfleisch regionaler Anbieter hergestellt und jeden Tag frisch zubereitet. Zunächst wird das Fleisch durch den Fleischwolf gedreht, in Kugeln portioniert und erst vor dem Grillen in die flache runde Form (Burger Patty) gebracht. Je nach Wunsch des Gastes wird der Burger auf dem 360 Grad heißen Rost medium oder well done frisch gegrillt. Ganz nach dem Motto „Für jeden Geschmack den richtigen Burger“ gibt es verschiedene Varianten – vom klassischen Burger zum scharfen Chili-Burger bis hin zur vegetarischen Variante. Auch die drei Brötchensorten – Brioche, Sesam und Vollkorn – zwischen denen der Gast frei wählen kann, lassen Freiraum für Vielfalt. Die gemeinsam mit einer Hamburger Bäckerei entwickelten und nach geheimer Rezeptur zubereiteten Brötchen (Burger Buns) werden als rohe Teiglinge geliefert und vor Ort frisch gebacken. In der Verbindung aus heiß gegrilltem und selbstgemachtem Burger Patty, frischen Beilagen und hausgebackenem Brötchen liegt das Geheimnis des Burgers – no ordinary Hamburger.

Name: Gewinnblick GmbH
Company description: Die Gewinnblick GmbH ist mit 80 Mitarbeitern und zehn Standorten einer der größten Anbieter von Kassen- und Bezahlsystemen für die Gastronomie und Hotellerie in der DACH-Region. Das Portfolio umfasst individuelle Beratung, Konfiguration und Installation digitaler Gesamtlösungen sowie flächendeckenden Service an 365 Tagen im Jahr - telefonisch, online und vor Ort. Gestartet als Einkaufsgemeinschaft aus mehreren Kassenhändlern werden mittlerweile über 14.000 Kunden betreut. 40 Jahre Erfahrung und die Zusammenarbeit mit stärksten Branchenpartnern machen Gewinnblick auch zum Impulsgeber bei der Weiterentwicklung bestehender und eng aufeinander abgestimmter Kassen- und Bezahlsysteme für das gesamte Gastgewerbe.  Getreu dem Motto „Sehen, was wirklich zählt.“ ist das erklärte Ziel, Kunden zu Vorreitern ihrer Branche zu machen. Sämtliche gastronomischen Abläufe in Service, Küche und Büro werden durch innovative und flexible Kassen- und Bezahlsysteme gesteuert, verwaltet und optimiert. Das Ergebnis: mehr Transparenz, ein entspannterer Arbeitsalltag und höhere Zufriedenheit bei Gästen, Kunden und Mitarbeitern. Impressum: https://www.gewinnblick.de/impressum/

Name: Steigenberger Graf Zeppelin
HQ Location: Germany, Baden-württemberg, Stuttgart, 7 Arnulf Klett Platz, 70173
Company description: Herzlich Willkommen im Steigenberger Graf Zeppelin - Ihr Businesshotel mitten im Herzen Stuttgarts direkt gegenüber dem historischen Hauptbahnhof und somit optimaler Ausgangspunkt für Business, Kultur und Shopping.  Unsere Zimmer und Executive Junior Suiten bieten schallisolierte Fenster, Klimaanlage, W-Lan, TV, Minibar, Nespresso Kaffeemaschine, Teezuereitungsmöglichkeiten. Schwäbische Küche und internationale Klassiker genießen Sie im Restaurant Zeppelino'S mit seiner Sommerterrasse. Cheers! Unsere Zeppelin Bar eignet sich den ganzen Tag perfekt für Getränke und Snacks, während alle Zigarrenliebhaber in der Davidoff Cigar Lounge entspannen können. Egal ob Kurzbesprechung zu zweit, umfangreiches Businessmeeting oder private Party - unser Event Team plant mit Ihnen Ihre Veranstaltung individuell. 11 lichtdurchflutete Veranstaltungsräume bieten Platz für bis zu 400 Personen. Für Ihr Workout können Sie 24/7 den TechnoGym Fitnessraum mit Panoramaaussicht aus dem 5. Stock nutzen und danach in der Sauna entspannen. Stuttgart ist immer eine Reise wert. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

Name: Relais & Châteaux Gut Steinbach Hotel Chalets SPA
Company description: Das Relais & Châteaux Gut Steinbach Hotel und Chalets ist ein 4 Sterne Superior Hotel in Reit im Winkl im oberbayerischen Chiemgau. Auf 51 Hektar erwartet unsere Gäste ein Stammhaus mit 50 Zimmern und Suiten sowie ein Chaletdorf mit 7 großzügigen Landhaus Chalets. Jedes Chalet verfügt über zwei bis drei Schlafzimmer mit jeweils eigenem Badezimmer. Ein gemeinsamer Wohn- und Essbereich sowie ein privater Wellnessbereich mit Sauna, Ruhebereich und Erlebnisdusche rundet das Erlebnis ab.  Die mehrfach prämierte Küche, die zuletzt mit dem Grünen Stern des Guide Michelin ausgezeichnet wurde, ist für ihr 80:80 Konzept weit über die Grenzen des Chiemgau hinaus bekannt. Die Philosophie ist einfach wie auch anspruchsvoll: 80 Prozent aller Lebensmittel kommen aus maximal 80 Kilometern Entfernung. Küchenchef Achim Hack baut die Partnerschaft zu den regionalen Produzenten stetig aus und pflegt den täglichen Gang in den hoteleigenen Kräutergarten zur Verfeinerung seiner Gerichte. Im November 2021 eröffnet zudem der neue "Heimat & Natur SPA" auf 2.000qm Innen- und Außenfläche. Gäste dürfen sich unter anderem auf einen 18 Meter Indoorpool, eine Panoramasauna, mehrere Ruheoasen sowie ein breites Angebot an Massagen und Behandlungen freuen. Gut Steinbach eignet sich nicht nur für Entspannung, Sport und Genuss, sondern ist auch hervorragend für kleinere Tagungen sowie Besprechung, die ein hohes Maß an Intimität erfordern, geeignet. Neben den Tagungsräumen lassen sich auch die Chalets mit ihrem Dorfcharakter für Meetings nutzen. Außerdem steht mit dem Konzept "Tagen im Wald" das komplette Hotelgrundstück für unsere Gäste bereit.  Auf dem Grundstück leben in der eigenen biozertifizierten Landwirtschaft Yaks, Ziegen, Hühner, Gänse und Hirsche. Reit im Winkl selbst ist das Eldorado des Winter- und Sommersports. Die Langlaufloipe führt direkt an der Hoteltüre von Gut Steinbach vorbei und das Skigebiet Steinplatte ist 10 Minuten entfernt.

Name: C. Wöllhaf GastroService GmbH
Company description: As a pioneer of modern catering service, the C. Wöllhaf GastroService GmbH is one of the leading airport catering companies on the German airports of Berlin, Frankfurt and Cologne-Bonn. Founded by Claus Wöllhaf in the year of 1983, the company owns numerous restaurants, bistros, snack- and coffeebars, as well as conference- and banquet centers. Wöllhaf is one of Germany’s top system caterers, more than 300 employees host millions of guests every year. Company description: In beeindruckender Lage auf 1 350 Metern Seehöhe in Kals am Großglockner mitten in den Bergen Osttirols liegt das Gradonna Mountain Resort auf einem sonnigen Hochplateau mit seinem 4-Sterne-Superior-Hotel und den Luxus-Chalets mit eigenem Spa-Bereich eingebettet in die imposante Landschaft der Hohen Tauern. Das autofreie, architektonisch visionäre Resort verbindet 4-Sterne-Superior-Luxus und großzügigen Wellness- und Spa-Genuss mit einmaligen Ausblicken auf den Großglockner und die Berggipfel rund um Kals.

Name: Brera Serviced Apartments
Company description: Brera Serviced Apartment stands for its origin – the design, artistic, lively neighborhood in Milan where people gather together with a glass of wine, pizza and pasta and who enjoy their familiar surrounding. We live the Brera Lifestyle in our apartments – surrounded by a fun neighborhood who are part of our friends community, designed with classic Italian Alessi  kitchenware, an espresso coffee machines and wall drawings made by the Milan artist Orsola Fontana. Centraly located in Frankfurt, Nuremberg and Munich – Brera Serviced Apartments are the perfect spot for business guests who enjoy their privacy and an atmosphere where it feel like  “staying with friends”.

Name: HSMA Deutschland E.V.
Company description: Die HSMA (Hospitality Sales und Marketing Association) Deutschland e.V. ist der Verband der Sales- und Marketingfachkräfte in Hotellerie und Tourismus. Sie bildet das Netzwerk und den Wissenspool zu allen relevanten Sales & Marketing Themen der Hospitality Branche. Hier trifft die geballte Kompetenz von über 800 Mitgliedern zusammen. Mit dem Expertenkreis verfügt der Verband über ein Gremium, welches das gebündelte Markt-Know How zusammenfasst und auch von der IHA (Hotelverband Deutschland) als offizielles Organ für den Bereich Sales & Marketing genutzt wird.

Name: SCHLOSS Fleesensee
Company description: Herzlich willkommen auf der LinkedIn Unternehmensseite des SCHLOSS Fleesensee, ein einzigartig magischer Ort inmitten der wunderbaren Naturlandschaft der Mecklenburgischen Seenplatte. Hier laden wir unsere Gäste ein, ganz zu sich selbst zu kommen und die beste Version des eigenen ICH zu entdecken. 175 Zimmer und Suiten, drei Restaurants, Bar, Terrasse, mehr als 500 qm Veranstaltungsfläche, Schlosspark mit altem Baumbestand, Spa mit beheiztem Außenpool. Ein modernes, stilvolles Ambiente in historischen Mauern. Zeitgenössische Kunst. Das Gastronomiekonzept ist einzigartig und überzeugt mit zahlreichen Produkten aus eigenem Anbau: Vom Gemüse- und Kräutergarten am SCHLOSS Hotel über die eigene Black Angus Rinderherde bis hin zur selbst geführten Backstube – bei der Herkunft unserer Produkte überlassen wir nichts dem Zufall.   Vom SCHLOSS Hotel über SCHLOSS Golf bis hin zu SCHLOSS Spa - alle unsere Angebote sind passgenau auf die Bedürfnisse eines jeden Gastes zugeschnitten.  In unseren Beiträgen berichten wir Ihnen von unserer einzigartigen SCHLOSS Familie, nehmen Sie mit auf unsere Events und machen neugierig auf diesen einzigartigen Ort. Folgen Sie uns! _______ Wir machen uns etwas aus Personen, die mehr aus sich machen. Und uns. Die pulsierende Großstadt für ein Provinznest aufgeben? Das Altbekannte gegen eine noch junge Marke eintauschen? Das Vertraute hinter sich lassen, um einen Neuanfang zu wagen? Für uns eine klare Sache: Unbedingt! Denn wo sonst hat man das Glück, inmitten einer traumhaften Naturlandschaft zu arbeiten, die so facettenreich ist wie das Land der tausend Seen? Werden Sie Teil eines enthusiastischen Teams und helfen Sie mit, eine junge, frische Marke mit Leben zu füllen. Wir geben Ihnen die Chance, sich einzubringen und weiterzuentwickeln – statt an verstaubten Routinen festzuhalten. Name: Kongresshotel Potsdam Am Templiner See
Company description: Ein Ort wie kein anderer! Hier, wo einst Graf Zeppelin seine Luftschiffe baute, steht heute das größte Tagungshotels des Landes, das Kongresshotel Potsdam. Hier kommt hier die ganze Welt zusammen bei nationalen und internationalen Kongressen mit Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern aus 20 Nationen. Das 4-Sterne Haus ist eingebettet in eine reizvolle Wald- und Seenlandschaft. Das weitläufige, gärtnerisch schön gestaltete Außengelände bezieht den naturnahen Raum auf angenehme Weise ein und lässt Möglichkeiten für Tagungen und Veranstaltungen im Grünen mit direktem Seeblick. Seit der Hoteleröffnung bilden wir in fünf Ausbildungsberufen erfolgreich aus und sind Praxisbetrieb für duale Studiengänge. Wir sind selbst geprüfte Ausbilder und Ausbilderinnen und ermöglichen Berufseinsteiger*innen und Auszubildenden gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in der vielseitigen und dienstleistungsorientierten Hotelbranche.   Wir suchen Sie! Sie begeistern sich für die Hotellerie und wollen an einem außergewöhnlichen Ort und in einem motivierten Team arbeiten? Kommen Sie zu uns, wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Gesichtern und Menschen, die das Herz an der richtigen Stelle haben!

Name: Borealis Hotel Group - HR
Company description: Borealis Hotel Group (“Borealis”), founded in 1997 and headquartered in Amsterdam, is a fast-expanding European hospitality company. The group, backed by strong institutional investors, is led and supported by a passionate team with an extensive track-record. After selling its former portfolio end 2015, Borealis started building todays portfolio and now operates and owns hotels in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, Spain and Denmark, all branded by international hotel chains like Accor, Hilton, IHG, and Marriott. Next to its secured pipeline of additional hotels across continental Europe the group’s ambition is to continue and accelerate its growth by initiating new hotel projects, conversions of existing assets as well as portfolio add-ons to its platform.

Name: Academias Hotel - Autograph Collection
Company description: AN ACADEMY FOR THE SENSES Inspired by ancient Athenian wisdom and intellect, Academias Hotel is a luxurious city hotel, portraying a contemporary interpretation of Plato’s Academy blending the old and the new, which awakens all the senses, while combining bespoke facilities, with impeccable services and unique experiences. Echoing the spirit of the academy, the hotel embodies the 3 principles of the historic Academy – Science, Art & Philosophy – and brings them to life throughout various spaces within the hotel, in a postmodern way. With a total of 60 rooms and suites and surrounded by all of Athens’ ancient landmarks, Academias Hotel provides the ideal setting for harmonious interplay between intellectual creativity and a handful of leisure and business activities.

Name: Leonardo Hotels
Company description: LEONARDO HOTELS CENTRAL EUROPE, headquartered in Berlin, is responsible for a portfolio of 110 hotels with over 18,000 rooms in 48 destinations and ten countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Romania, Spain, Italy and France. Previously focused primarily on business travelers, the company has also been expanding in the leisure sector since 2022. The family of brands includes: Leonardo Hotels: feel-good establishments with a living culture of welcome, Leonardo Royal Hotels: stylish business hotels with the highest quality of service, Leonardo Boutique Hotels: charming comfort hotels with that certain something extra, NYX Hotels by Leonardo Hotels: young lifestyle hotels with art, entertainment and local spirit, Leonardo Limited Edition: collection of carefully curated individual hotels.  Leonardo Hotels Central Europe is part of the Fattal Hotel Group, founded in 1998 by David Fattal. The Israeli hotel group currently has 270+ hotels with 48,000+ rooms in 20 countries and 117 destinations and is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE).

Name: DEHOGA Bundesverband
Company description: Hinter dem Deutschen Hotel- und Gaststättenverband  (DEHOGA Bundesverband) steht mit dem Gastgewerbe in Deutschland eine wachsende Dienstleistungsbranche überwiegend mittelständischer Prägung. 222.000 Betriebe mit 2,2 Millionen Beschäftigten und über 53.000 Auszubildenden – das Gastgewerbe ist ein starkes Stück Wirtschaft und das Rückgrat der heimischen Tourismusindustrie. Name: DoubleTree By Hilton Berlin Ku'damm
Company description: Nur wenige Schritte vom berühmten Kurfürstendamm entfernt und direkt am hübschen Los-Angeles-Platz liegt das DoubleTree by Hilton Berlin Ku´damm. Es ist das erste Haus der Hilton-Submarke in Berlin, das dritte in Deutschland und – so Hotelmanager Hannes Dreher – „das vielleicht schönste in Europa“. 16 Monate dauerte die umfassende Renovierung des großen Gebäudes am Los-Angeles-Platz, das 1981 als Steigenberger Hotel eröffnete und lange Zeit eine der ersten Adressen Berlins war.  Ob Alice Cooper, Marlon Brando, Luciano Pavarotti oder Tina Turner – sie alle logierten einst hier. 2019 erwarb die amerikanische Blackstone Group, einer der weltstärksten Investoren im Bereich Alternative Investments, das in die Jahre gekommene Gebäude. Betreiber wurden die Event Hotels aus Köln, die damit ihr Portfolio auf fünf Häuser in Berlin erhöhten. Das elegante wie kühne Design stammt vom mehrfach ausgezeichneten Designbüro Virserius Studio NY der Schwestern Therese und Regina Virserius. Das Restaurant verfügt über 260 Sitzplätze. Rechtliche Informationen (Impressum und Datenschutzerklärung) sind abrufbar unter 'Website'.

Name: Albeck & Zehden Hotelmanagement Und Service GmbH
Company description: Hotel operator with passion and specialist in restructuring management Since 1987 we have been operating hotels in Berlin and throughout Germany in our own name and for third parties, both in the luxury segment and in the economy segment. In addition, we act as consultants and service providers in a wide variety of hotel areas. We have experience in changing operators, taking over operations as well as short-term and long-term management contracts. Over the years we have specialized in particular in the restructuring of hotels in cooperation with banks, investors, lawyers and administrators. The hotel operations are analyzed and evaluated by us according to market and location conditions, economic indicators, strategies and potential. The developed concept not only enables the company to better position itself on the market, but also to optimize all processes and cost structures as well as to classify the product in a long-term forecast in order to survive in the long term. Numerous hotel businesses have been successfully restructured or refurbished by our group of companies in this way and a number of jobs and training positions have been preserved.

Company description: An einem der reizvollsten Orte Deutschlands, zu Füßen der beiden Königsschlösser Hohenschwangau und Neuschwanstein, steht das AMERON Neuschwanstein Alpsee Resort & Spa. Mit Blick auf den Alpsee, umgeben von Wäldern und einem außergewöhnlichen Gebirgspanorama, verschmelzen Natur und Kultur in diesem Haus auf einzigartige Weise mit dem Esprit von AMERON. Dieser wird getragen von unserer Philosophie, dass jedes AMERON-Hotel ein Unikat ist – geprägt durch die Individualität seiner Region und zugleich mit einem gleichbleibend hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Service und Gastfreundschaft. Tradition trifft auf Modernität, klassische Eleganz auf urbanes Flair. Diese werden saniert und mit den Neubauten Galeria und Seehaus zu einem neuen Ensemble verbunden: Eine Einheit, die Geschichte atmet und zugleich fortschreibt. Insgesamt 137 Zimmer und Suiten, Tagungsräumlichkeiten, weitläufiges SPA mit direktem Blick auf den Alpsee, ein Kids Club sowie unterschiedliche Gastronomieangebote werden in dem großzügigen Hotelareal zusammengeführt.

Company description: Unser Golfplatz im GolfResort Semlin am See bietet Golfern nicht nur eine außergewöhnliche Lage inmitten der atemberaubenden Natur des Naturparks West-Havelland, sondern auch ein unmittelbar auf dem Gelände befindliches Hotel mit Natur-Wellness-Bereich. Die Entscheidung fällt schwer: Soll man lieber auf dem strahlenden Grün des 27-Loch-Meisterschaftsplatzes spielen, im Wellness-Bereich entspannen, die umliegenden Wälder erkunden oder im nahe gelegenen See schwimmen? Von unserer Sonnenterrasse aus genießen Sie einen wunderschönen Blick auf die Löcher 18 und 27, begleitet von Wildgerichten und regionalen Spezialitäten im Restaurant Havelländer, die jeden hungrigen Golfer auf köstliche Weise verzaubern. Buchen Sie jetzt direkt zum besten Preis! Entdecken Sie auch unsere zahlreichen Angebote, darunter Wandern, Radfahren und einen Besuch des nahegelegenen Sternenparks, der Ihnen einen ganz besonderen Blick in den Himmel ermöglicht. Name: Schloss Lieser Autograph Collection By Marriott
Company description: The story of Schloss Lieser began around 1885 when the castle was built by Eduard Puricelli, a successful entrepreneur, under the architecture of Heinrich Theodor Schmidt. Soon after moving in, Eduard started cultivating vineyards on the surrounding hills to produce and bottle his own wines. The villa was slightly elevated to prevent the ground floor, where the bottling happened, from flooding when the river would burst its banks. Maria Puricelli was the sole heiress of the family’s possessions when her father died. She married the handsome, wealthy Prussian politician Clemens Freiherr von Schorlemer-Lieser, who was part of the cabinet of Kaiser Wilhelm II, the last German Emperor and King of Prussia. At the turn of the century, Maria and Clemens moved into the villa and renovated it into the beautiful castle it is today. Although the original architect had chosen a Neo-Renaissance style and based his design on the Italian Palladian villas of the 16th and 17th centuries, the new additions were Art Nouveau. In 2007 the property was acquired by the present owner, Mr. P. Killaars, who embarked on a wide-ranging program of renovation and expansion during six years (2011-2017), transforming the castle into an extra-special luxury residence. Now Schloss Lieser is still one of the most important buildings in the region. It holds the second place of the German state Rhineland-Palatinate. (The first place is taken by Burg Eltz). And starting from August 2019, Schloss Lieser is ready to welcome visitors from all over the world to share its beautiful history.

Dazu der weiße Strand, das Licht, die Farben, das Meer, die Dünen, der Wald, die Sterne am Himmel und in der Küche. Wir sind nachhaltig, weil wir die Natur intensiv nutzen und täglich erleben dürfen. Wir nennen das ein Holistic Hideaway. EIN FASZINIERENDER ORT FÜR KENNER*INNEN Ein Urlaub oder Kurztrip in der Nebensaison an der Ostsee ist eine echte Bereicherung. Besonders das faszinierende Wintergesicht des Meeres auf der Halbinsel Fischland-Darß-Zingst lässt viele nicht mehr los. Bei „richtig frischen“ Temperaturen bilden sich Eisschollen, schieben sich über- und untereinander, das Meer drückt mit seiner ganzen Kraft dagegen, eigenwillige Gebilde brechen auf und schaffen eine spektakuläre Landschaft. Das Kur- und Bäderwesen der Ostsee nutzt seit mehr als 100 Jahren ionisierende Luft der Brandungszone zur Vorbeugung. Oder sind die Kraniche schon da? Alljährlich kommen bis zu 70.000 Kraniche vorbei und rasten. Ein atemberaubendes Naturschauspiel. Und wenn Sie schon unterwegs sind, hier liegt alles ganz nah beieinander: Strand, Düne, Küstenwald, Bodden und auf der Landzunge Darß-Fischland-Zingst finden Sie viele kleine Inselorte.
