Our History Founded in 1872 by Ioannis Pourikas in Elassona, Larissa, Rockwell started as a personal enterprise focused on manufacturing and trading cutting tools (scissors, knives, etc.) for both home and professional use. Initially, our clientele consisted mainly of livestock farmers and agriculturists from Thessaly, Western Macedonia, and Epirus. During the winter months, the manufacturing workshop was based in Elassona, while in the summer, it relocated to Samarina, Grevena. In 1922, Apostolos Ioannou Pourikas took over, maintaining high quality and expanding distribution throughout Greece. In 1965, Evangelos Apostolou Pourikas shifted the business to importing and distributing foreign brands, ending our production but continuing product repair. By 1992, Leonidas and Apostolos Pourikas modernised the business, focusing on retail and selective wholesale trade. In 1997, under the leadership of Leonidas Pourikas, Rockwell moved its operations to Athens, evolving into a uniquely high-quality enterprise in its field.  Today, Rockwell's quality is evident in both retail and wholesale markets across Greece and Cyprus, participating in exhibitions such as HO.RE.CA. Committed to maintaining our high standards, our goal is to expand our retail presence and wholesale points, establishing Rockwell as a leader in the industry. The perfect geographic location of Villa Fleria can make your stay loose and easy, since there are mini-markets and traditional Cretan tavernas within walking distance. Die Region rund um das Seehotel bietet den Gästen eine Vielzahl von kulturellen und touristischen Angeboten: Als interessante Ausflugsziele sind die Landeshauptstadt Schwerin mit ihrem wunderbaren Museum, das eine der größten Duchamp-Sammlungen besitzt, die Hansestadt Wismar mit ihren großartigen Backsteinkirchen, die "Weiße Stadt am Meer" Heiligendamm, sowie Bad Doberan und Güstrow mit dem Barlachmuseum zu nennen. Auch eine liebevolle Anrichtung von Sashimi würde einen Transport zumeist nicht überstehen. Deshalb verzichtet Yoko auf diese Produktlinien und konzentriert sich auf Sushi Menüs, die in bester Verfassung geliefert werden können. Die Fahrer von Yoko Sushi werden in der Einarbeitung explizit zum möglichst stoßfreien und ruckelfreien Transport des Sushi angehalten und die Transportbehälter sind entsprechend abgefedert. Für eine Bestellung empfiehlt es sich, eine Firma wie Yoko Sushi zu wählen, die sich auf das Liefern von Sushi spezialisiert hat, und somit über das entsprechende Know How und Kenntnisse verfügt, um auch in Stoßzeiten alle Kunden pünktlich mit den beliebtesten Sushi Produkten wie Makis und Inside Out Rolls in hoher Qualität beliefern zu können.

Company description: In 1935, the community of Nahariya was established and eventually became a leisure city, owing much to the hard work of a group of Jews hailing from all across Germany. The local authority also played a role by encouraging people to acquire adjacent plots of land. In the 1930s, Dr Alois Shtarkman bought land near the seashore for the price of what was then the equivalent of three monthly salaries. The plot was vacant until the late 1950s when the decision was made to build two houses for the Shtarkman Family (Alois and Charlotte) and the Bendheim Family (Erna and Herman). At the begining of the 1960s, Alois Shtarkman travelled to the United States for work, and was joined by his wife and his son, Michael. Erna, who remained in Israel, began to rent out the properties during the summer to holidaymakers under the name “Erna Guest House”.  The venture became a great success, by virtue of her warm hospitality and the fantastic cakes she baked, some still baked at the hotel to this very day (the most famous being the Apple Strudel). Upon the return of the Shtarkman Family from America and in light of Erna’s success, the building was expanded, and its name was changed to “Beit Erna” (House of Erna). The two sisters joined forces and managed the establishment together. In 1974, Charlotte passed away, and Erna helped Michael, who took over the management of the hotel. Michael acted as a revitalizing spirit to the place and poured his soul into the operation. His special character and sense of humour did not go unnoticed by the many guests from both Israel and abroad. In 1982 Michael married Hannah. Soon thereafter, Erna passed away, and the era of the founders came to an end. Within a short period of time, the couple had four daughters who grew up at the family-run hotel. In 2001, Michael passed away, and in 2014 the family decided that the hotel would undergo extensive refurbishment yet still preserve some of the original furniture as the family’s legacy.

In Spring he does flower walks and searches for wild orchids, anemones, Cretan tulips, which are growing in Crete everywhere. There are walks in various categories, from light to heavy. Cross country, across donkey paths, through gorges and over calibrated paths. A true experience, you come to places where no tourists will come, in overgrown churches with the most beautiful frescoes and where bats have found their sleeping place. There are regular Griffon vultures flying over because they build their nests in the hills near us. In Summer you witness the swarms of bee-eaters who nest in the area. Our sky at night is very special. Because we do not have light pollution you can observe thousands of stars with the naked eye. In clear weather, it seems that you can touch the Milky Way.  Footscapes of Crete is a very special place.

Name: DasWohnzimmer Musicbar/lounge
Company description: Feiern, chillen, kreativ werden – das alles und viel mehr ist dasWohnzimmer. Seit nunmehr fast 23 Jahren versuchen wir – das bin ich, Alexander Lisson und mein Team – euch ein Stück Großstadt in den „Biegel“ im Backnanger Zentrum zu bringen. Wie das funktioniert?  Mit einer Mischung aus Musicbar und Lounge sind wir ein Unikum in unserer Stadt: In diesem Sinne holen wir nicht nur namhafte DJs und Musiker zu uns nach Backnang. In einer heimeligen Atmosphäre und mit einer großen Getränkekarte laden wir euch auch zum Kickern, Chillen und Quatschen ein. Am Mittwochabend wird unser Wohnzimmer außerdem zur Nähstube, in der Nähbegeisterte gemeinsam mit Designerin Claudia Fischer kreativ werden können. Und immer mal wieder trainieren Komiker von lokal und überregional eure Lachmuskeln. Noch immer nicht überzeugt?  Dann hier ein paar Impressionen…   Mit schwarzen Ledersofas, warm-rot gestrichenen Wänden, sowie Bildern und Grafiken lokaler Künstler haben wir für euch eine gemütliche Atmosphäre geschaffen. Unsere 7 Meter lange Bar lockt mit einem großen Cocktailangebot, mit mehr als 20(!) Biersorten und vielen weiteren Getränkespecials. Wenn Euch mal nicht nach Quatschen, sondern nach einem Wettkampf unter Freunden zu Mute ist, bietet unser Tischkicker oder ganz viele verschiedene Spiele eine gute Alternative.  Ob Modern Rock, Alternative, Chillout, Electro House, Reggae oder Gitarrenmusik – als selbsternannte „Stubenrocker“ haben wir in Sachen Musik für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei. Über die Jahre haben namhafte Djs wie Axel Conradt, Tango Chop Suey und Bö von "Paul Artists" (Res. Climax/Stuttgart), und Emmanuel Marzell (Sunshive live Hire&Fire Gewinner) bei uns gastiert. Mit unplugged-Konzerten von Lay Down Layla, 2weeksbefore, Where’s the grace oder TH Number 74 versuchen wir auch die Rocker unter euch zu überzeugen. Also: egal ob zum chillen, trinken, tanzen oder nähen – wir laden euch herzlich in unser Wohnzimmer ein und freuen uns auf euch! Eure #Stubenrocker

Name: EigenArt Appartement Berlin-Mitte
Company description: Berlin ist immer eine Reise wert, das weiß jeder, der einmal hier war. Die lebendige Bundeshauptstadt, mit höherer Taktfrequenz als jede andere deutsche Stadt, hat rund um die Uhr für Sie geöffnet und bietet Ihnen ein nahezu unerschöpfliches kulturelles Angebot. Ihr Appartement befindet sich im Zentrum dieses Pulsschlages, denn die neue Mitte Berlins beginnt direkt vor Ihrer Haustür. Unser Haus wurde im Jahre 1871 vor den Toren der Friedrichstadt im heutigen Bezirk Mitte (vormals Wedding) erbaut. In den letzten Kriegstagen stark zerstört, wurde es erst 1982 instandgesetzt und modernisiert. Der ehemalige Grenzübergang „Chausseestraße“ befand sich bis zur Maueröffnung im Jahre 1989 direkt hinter unserem Haus. Genießen Sie nach Ihrem Stadtbummel die Ruhe und Entspannung in unseren modernen Appartements und überlassen Sie die Metropole für kurze Zeit sich selbst. Wir möchten mit einer angenehmen Atmosphäre zum Erfolg Ihres Berlinbesuches beitragen. Besonderen Wert haben wir auf zeitgemäße Gestaltung, Funktionalität und komfortable Einrichtung der Appartements gelegt. Hochwertige Materialien, klare Formen und dezente Eleganz prägen das Interieur. Das Bad glänzt mit italienischen Fliesen und klassischen Accessoires. Plastiken, Holzschnitte und Zeichnungen der beiden bei Berlin lebenden Künstler Anna Arnskötter und Lothar Seruset prägen die Räumlichkeiten. Damit Sie auch beruflich auf nichts verzichten müssen, verfügen Sie über einen Arbeitstisch mit DSL-Anschlußmöglichkeit für PC oder Lapop. Telefon mit eigener Durchwahlnummer, schnelle W-LAN Internetverbindung, Kabel-Farbfernseher, Radio und ein Wandtresor stehen Ihnen im Appartement zur Verfügung. Eine gut ausgestattete Einbauküche macht Sie unabhängig. Sie können aber auch das vielfältige Angebot der deutschen und internationalen Küche in der näheren Umgebung nutzen.

The necessity of solving the problem and fact of the increasing trend of hotels practically rationalizing away "the heart of the hotel" in other words the position of THE CONCIERGE brought up this solution. Also hotels with an existing concierge can very well use this system in order to optimise the internal processes and level of service for their guests. With the support of three friends, profoundly experienced in mobile connectivity solutions and strong entrepreneurial skills, she managed to set up i-frontdesk and be one of the nine winners of the Telefonica incubator "Wayra" Germany in August 2012! Our vision is to make it possible for every progressive hotel providing their guests with a tablet device beside the bible on the desk welcoming them in their room and making their stay as pleasant and exciting as possible. Name: E-Koufonisia
Company description: It’s no coincidence that when anyone hears the word “Koufonisia,” their soul smiles. They close their eyes and immediately transport themselves to the site where clear blue water reflects their dream…to the endless beaches, to the vibrations of the island and the hidden caves where their worries find solace. To Chora, where the local inhabitants drink together and open their homes to say “Welcome.” There, southeast of Naxos and west of Amorgos, on Koufonisia you lose all concept of time and simply put, feel free. Koufonisia is part of the Small Cyclades, a cluster of islands in the southeastern Cyclades. Koufonisia is composed of two small islands, Ano (Upper) and Kato (Lower) Koufonisi as well as Keros. They’ve been inhabited since prehistoric ages. So many people, customs, traditions and different societies have taken root in these places and have left vital traces to be unraveled and understood by the rest of the world. Findings suggest the existence of a Cycladic civilization with evidence from its very early years. Archaeologist Ulrich Köhler in 1884, excavated and discovered The Harpist and The Flute Player along with two female statuettes, which were clear samples of marble sculptures from the Early Cycladic period. Remnants from an ancient Roman civilization were used to establish the present village of Chora which was part of a large Roman settlement that extended up to Loutro. Relics and marble slabs from Early Christianity were discovered on the premises of Saint George and Saint Nicholas churches.

Due to seasonal changes and different bean origins these espresso blends will vary in composition and thus in taste. The best way to stay informed is either to speak to one of the baristas or to have a look at the blend descriptions located in front of the grinders. We aim to showcase the diversity of coffee, and for that reason we offer freshly brewed filter coffee from changing exceptional micro roasters. A menu of current drip coffees can be found at the brew bar. Once coffee beans have been roasted they begin to mature and release carbon dioxide gas in a process known as „degassing“, which affects the flavour of the coffee. We only use filter coffees that are less than fifteen days past their roast date and we consider our espresso blends to be at their optimum for use between the fifth and fifteenth day after roasting. Our espresso coffee is always ground fresh to order. We only use Demeter certified organic milk from Brodowin which is delivered fresh daily. The milk is steamed fresh to order and is never used twice. In order to retain the milk’s natural sweetness we try to avoid heating it beyond 65°C. Our breakfast and brunch is prepared a la carte with regional and Demeter certified organic products.

Name: Hotel Restaurant Hollerather Hof
Company description: Hotel Restaurant Hollerather Hof was built in 1933/1934. The build was commissioned by the authority, whose idea was that the hotel would serve as an example for all hotels in the Eifel region. The was a booming winder sports area and was growing more popular at that time. The hotel was then known as " Sports Hotel Restaurant Hollerather Hof ". Simultaneously with the completion of the Hollerather Hof, the "Adolf Hitler Schans" was opened. This ski-jump was the largest and most modern in the Eifel region and served as the primary training ramp for the " Westdeutschen Skiverband ". The hotel offered shelter to members of the Ski Association.  During the Second World War the ski-jump was completely destroyed and the hotel was badly damaged. This is not surprising because the area was the scene of the famous Battle of the Bulge or The Ardennes Offensive.  Many buildings in the area were damaged or were completely destroyed, so was the church of Hollerath. Since the hotel was one of the few buildings that was still largely intact, after the war the cellar served as a temporary church. The Sunday school also took shelter in the hotel.   In 1954 the ruins of the Hotel where completely rebuilt. In the following years the tourism again began to flourish. The hotel was known throughout the Eifel region and beyond and was also highly respected culinary.

Passalacqua's mission is to create a serene and enriching experience for its guests, allowing them to recharge and indulge in the beauty of their surroundings through various activities, including cooking classes, spa treatments, and outdoor adventures. The hotel caters to discerning travelers seeking a luxurious getaway, and its clientele includes families, couples, and individuals looking for a tranquil retreat. With a focus on exceptional service and culinary excellence, led by renowned chef Viviana Varese, Passalacqua aims to redefine high-end Italian hospitality while honoring its rich heritage.

Company description: Blastness is a leading technology provider specializing in revenue management solutions for the hospitality industry. Blastness aims to empower hoteliers by providing comprehensive support in online distribution management, ensuring they remain competitive in a dynamic market. The company serves a diverse clientele, including boutique hotels and large chains, and partners with industry leaders to enhance their clients' digital presence and revenue strategies.

Company description: Hellotickets is a dynamic online platform specializing in ticket sales for concerts, events, and attractions, primarily focusing on enhancing the travel experience for visitors to major cities like Madrid. By leveraging extensive research and data analysis on traveler behavior, Hellotickets aims to maximize the impact of large-scale events, such as concerts, on local economies. Name: Dromoland Castle Hotel & Country Estate
Company description: Dromoland Castle, one of Europe’s finest castle hotels, offers Guest’s the experience of living like landed gentry, surrounded by luxury, beauty, and service. Refurbished and transformed into a luxury hotel in 1962, it retains priceless reminders of the Castle’s historic past. Relax and unwind in any one of our 99 rooms choose from a state room or suite, Queen Anne or Deluxe room, we promise luxury and comfort no matter what you choose. Under the careful guidance of Executive Chef David McCann, we offer an elegant dining experience. If you are loking for something more casual why not try our signature experience Mrs. White's Afternoon Tea or choose from the snack menu served in the Gallery through out the day. On the Castle’s 410-acre estate, guests can hunt, fish, play tennis and championship golf or alternatively The Spa at Dromoland Castle is a perfect haven to enjoy the tranquility of Dromoland Castle. Dromoland Castle is situated in the Heart of the beautiful County Clare on the outskirts of New Market on Fergus,   just 8 miles from Shannon Airport makes it an ideal location for those of whom are travelling from overseas.   A short drive will take you to the incredible Cliffs of Moher which is one of Irelands most visited attraction in the west of Ireland.    South of Dromoland Castle, Bunratty Castle rests.  Renowned for its spectacular 15th Century Castle which houses famed mediaeval banquets amidst sumptuous surrounds, Bunratty is one of the finest surviving examples of an Irish Tower House.

Name: Sheraton Parco De Medici Rome Hotel
Company description: The Sheraton Parco de' Medici Rome Hotel is located in the most vital financial and commercial area of the Capital, at the centre of a strategic point that includes the congress and business district of EUR, the New Roman Trade Fair, Fiumicino and Ciampino International Airports, while the city centre and the most important shopping centres are just a few kilometres away. Through its commitment to outstanding hospitality, Blu Hotels S.p.A. strives to maintain high standards of quality and guest satisfaction, positioning itself as a leader in the Italian hotel industry.

Name: JSH Hotels & Resorts
Company description: THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS JSH Hotels Collection is a leading hotel management group that manages a global portfolio of 18 independent and international hotels and resorts in Italy, Austria, and Switzerland. Ours is a dynamic, young and diversified company whose key factor for success is the respect for a precise scale of corporate values and a culture of travel that by necessity departs from people. What does our guest look for when staying in our facilities? What do you expect? What are your needs, your expectations? How can we satisfy them? What can we and should we do if it is a disappointment? Finding the right answer to these questions is the founding principle of our work. Our research is complex, because the needs are increasingly more demanding, multiple and specific, and the response must be appropriate, and cannot be based on market segments, but must be instead “on target", focusing on the individual person. We all know that you are looking for more and more from your holiday; wellness and serenity, and to be able to break away from everyday life by immersing yourself in a relaxing and enjoyable dimension. Well-being can no longer come from generalist principles, or from flat and uniform standards. What people are looking for and what we want to offer is true well-being for everyone, even for those who have not been on vacation for a very long time. Expectations are diverse, for example for those who always enjoy fresh vegetable extract, or for the sportsman who wants to stay active on vacation. For the celiac baby who is gluten intolerant. For those who suffer from back pain and do not sleep well if the mattress is not rigid enough. For those who find the greatest achievement by reading a book under the stars or sipping a drink at sunset. Our sense of hospitality is the answer to these questions. Or rather, it is the very essence of our research, which never stops and makes us so dynamic, fluid, and ever projected towards innovation and mindful of new trends. The answer to these questions comes, every day, from the people who work in our hotels. From the chefs in the kitchen who spend their lives experimenting above a hot stove, to the reception staff who welcomes guests upon arrival. From the housekeeping staff, which makes the rooms perfect every morning, to the masseuse, who gives a moment of happiness through his hands. From the director, who is the “deus ex machina”, the ultimate problem solver of every area of the hotel, to the local coach, who focuses on opportunities outside of the hotel or resort to enable the guest to discover the splendor of the surrounding territories. Everyone, in his own way, works with one goal in mind: To meet the demands of the customer with a smile and to respond to needs and expectations, with promptness, sincerity and attentive care. Thanks to our ten-year experience as operators in the hotel management industry, we have advanced skills that enable us to manage very different assets, diversifying our products and enhancing their special characteristics, from boutique hotels to congress centers, from resorts to luxury segment. And we do this in collaboration with the most prestigious international brands, such as Hilton, Marriott, Radisson Blu, Holiday Inn. Our hotels provide experiences, emotions, well-being, and the discovery of the surrounding territories, cultures and traditions. We are promoters of a healthy lifestyle where sport, physical activity, good food, and personal care are indispensable. To ensure this, to succeed and maintain our leadership in the hospitality industry, we know we must focus on people, both inside and outside our company. There are over 1000 people who already work with us and contribute each day to our ambitious goals. And they will continue to grow. Our success is, above all, their success. ANDREA CIGARINI President & CEO JSH Hotels Collection

Company description: Hogs Head consists of Hogs Head Golf Club (HHGC) and the Lodge at Hogs Head. The golf course is newly designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. (RTJ) and gets its name from its location on the Hogs Head peninsula (a marine bearing point marking the opening to Ballinskelligs Bay from the North Atlantic). The project was the inspiration of Mr. Tony Alvarez II and Mr. Bryan Marsal, to provide a place built by friends for friends who share the love, camaraderie and fellowship of the game of golf. Hogs Head Golf course offers a variety of playing options and is divided into a Riverside Nine and a Seaside Nine, where both the river and sea play important roles respectively in the defence of par. We provide services at all stages of homelessness and enable people to move to a place they can call home.   At Simon, we listen to people who turn to us for help and do everything we can to support them to move out of homelessness into independent living. We strive to empower people to access, secure and retain a home of their own by reducing the reliance on short-term emergency accommodation and providing permanent supported housing for people to sustain a home in their local community. Moving people into supported housing produces life-enhancing and life-saving results and is more cost-effective in the long run. The organisation was founded by a group of Trinity and UCD students in 1969, who began by providing much-needed soup and sandwiches to people who were sleeping rough in Dublin city centre. In addition to the Soup Run, which still goes out 365 nights of the year, Dublin Simon provide many services which aim to help those who are sleeping rough on the streets, people who are in their own accommodation but at risk of homelessness and those who are at any of the stages in between. (Charity number CHY 5963).

Ancora oggi, dopo cinque generazioni, i fratelli Conticello proseguono la tradizione gastronomica popolare palermitana: la pasta con le sarde, la focaccia schietta e maritata e l'intramontabile sfincione conservano i sapori e i profumi di una volta.

Name: Costa Degli Ulivi Hotels S.p.A.

In parallelo alle attività professionali già avviate, questo gruppo di giovani dallo spiccato spirito imprenditoriale ha portato avanti queste ardite idee con metodica tenacia. Molte idee superarono la fase embrionale, e da semplici progetti si trasformarono in realtà aziendali, che giunsero ad esprimere specifiche compagini societarie. Nel 1967 nasce la Costa degli Ulivi S.p.A., società che da una parte raccoglie il testimone della gran mole di iniziative degli anni precedenti, dall'altra la volontà di concentrare tutti gli strumenti ed i servizi necessari per ogni singola struttura Alberghiera. Oltre mezzo secolo dopo, le strutture alberghiere della Costa degli Ulivi Hotels conservano ancora intatto lo spirito che contraddistinse quei pionieri. Un autentico fil rouge che unisce tutte, e che giustifica ampiamente il motto: “Strutture uniche in luoghi straordinari …” Ancora oggi le ardite idee e gli appunti ad esse correlate  sono conservati all'interno degli uffici della Costa degli Ulivi Spa che rappresenta ancora oggi uno dei progetti imprenditoriali più di successo nel territorio di Palermo. Negli anni 2000, la seconda generazione in linea con gli ambiziosi progetti dei genitori ha deciso di acquisire e ristruttura l’ex Cassa di Risparmio di Palermo creando una struttura di Lusso accessibile dando un chiaro segno alla propria e alle future generazioni che questa terra può e deve essere un posto dove poter costruire sogni, posti di lavoro e progetti ambiziosi.

Name: HAMS
Company description: HAMS is rapid response unit setup to provide support to financial institutions and owners dealing with distressed hotel assets. In response to discussions with financial institutions Ronan King of the Amethyst Group - a hotel specialist and former senior partner with BDO Simpson Xavier - founded HAMS to provide support in dealing with hotels experiencing trading difficulties. Severe liquidity issues in the sector has caused many banks to take steps to protect their security and assume control of the trading business.  Operating distressed hotels requires an experienced hotel asset management team.  In recognition of the current trend and based on experience with previous cycles, Ronan King approached Jim Murphy of PREM Group (Hotel Management Specialists) to source relevant skills and experience.

Name: SINERGIE SRL
Company description: Sinergie è il centro in cui convergono produttori, tecnici e professionisti, al servizio di hotels, centri di aggregazione e strutture ricettive. Se hai un’idea da realizzare, un problema da risolvere, un progetto da portare avanti, contattaci. Per la soluzione. Il progetto Sinergie nasce da un’idea di professionisti del settore che capiscono l’importanza del gruppo e dell’unione delle competenze. Da quell’idea, si è sviluppato il percorso che ci porta oggi ad essere tra i leader - in ambito alberghiero e ricettivo in genere – nella fornitura di arredi tessili, complementi di arredo, pavimentazioni e rivestimenti. Una grande azienda non ha futuro se non tiene fede alla propria ﬁlosoﬁa; la nostra ci è ben chiara, e ci motiva ogni giorno: la soddisfazione del cliente. Non è solo un’espressione abusata, è la nostra mission, e queste sono le strade che percorriamo per raggiungerla: abbandono del general contract – sinergia di forze diverse – ascolto delle esigenze – ricerca della soluzione più aderente ai bisogni – assistenza. Non ci interessa vendere per vendere, reperire materiali e prodotti che in un modo qualunque rispondano alle richieste e poi abbandonare il cliente. Ci interessa fornire un servizio, ed è per questo che abbiamo pensato allo sharing, la condivisione di opportunità da parte di tutti i partecipanti all’iniziativa: ogni azienda e ogni professionista partecipa con lo scopo di raggiungere l’obiettivo : la soddisfazione di chi si è rivolto a noi. Il risultato è che il team di consulenti che vi seguirà dal primo momento in cui ci contatterete per esporre la vostra esigenza, per proporvi poi la soluzione più adatta, con i migliori prodotti e le migliori tecnologie, ﬁno al post-vendita, sempre al vostro ﬁanco per una consulenza che vada ben oltre la semplice vendita di un oggetto.

In 1914, the King of Italy Vittorio Emanuele III along with the royal family chose the Palazzo as a summer residence. Refined and sober, decorated with floral motifs in different colours and shades, the rooms radiate the warm sunshine and vital energy of the surrounding nature. The luxuriant Mediterranean scrub and deeply rooted culinary traditions of Ciociaria create a perfect union for organic, local products and natural flavours. To initiate the guests to a state of deep relaxation, the Fonte SPA facilities of the Hotel include Turkish baths, saunas, multi-jet showers, hydro-tubs, Jacuzzi, relax room, indoor heated pool, and outdoor pool. The Palazzo offers also 16 spacious meeting rooms, all flooded with natural daylight, fully equipped with up-to-date technology and wi-fi connection. Nel restante periodo dell'anno i congressi e le attività legate al centro benessere animano l'attività dell'hotel. Ospitiamo ogni tipo di evento, dall'incontro alla convention, lo gestiamo e forniamo a chi  lo gestisce tutti i servizi ristorazione, tecnici, bar, post congress e anche team building. La forza del nostro centro congressi è di avere tutto integrato all'interno della nostra struttura. Il centro benessere, grazie alle dimensioni e all'apertura annuale, ha completato tutta l'offerta alberghiera sia legata alle vacanza, che legata al congressuale.  Crediamo nei grandi valori che animano la terra di Romagna,nell'ospitalità, nella passione, nel gusto dell' accoglienza tipica di questa terra. Crediamo che essa però non sia sufficiente senza l'efficienza, la professionalità e l'organizzazione. Con questi fondamenti, cerchiamo di rendere il nostro hotel uno spazio nuovo, un luogo sempre aperto che offra possibilità e servizi che non si concludono con il pernottamento in una camera. Vogliamo rendere il Club Hotel Dante un punto di riferimento per chi cerca un luogo accogliente, familiare, di qualità, e completo per qualsiasi esigenza.

Name: Waterford Castle Hotel & Golf Resort
Company description: Waterford Castle Hotel & Golf Resort Show you Mean Business by Where you do Business Tucked into the south east corner of Ireland and just minutes from the quays of thriving Waterford City and the local airport, there is the perfect escape for business. Your journey begins as you embark on the ferry ride that gently transfers you across the Kings Channel to the Island. In that short distance you’ll ﬁnd yourself transported to a different world; where your pace slows and the luxury of time seems to extend out before you as you travel along the beech lined avenue. The Castle itself  is very unique, with its history stretching back to the 16th Century. Company description: The Hotel Splendide Royal in Rome is a luxury five stars hotel, designed to be royal, luxurious and the same stature of the most accredited hotels in Europe. Located in the noble center of Rome, a city which was and is once again an intersection of cultures and communication. After more than one year of skilled re-structuring, this 19th century palace – once headquarters of the Roman Maronite community and only a stroll away from the famed Via Veneto – is today a luxury hotel and, in its own way, a symbol of the changes taking place within the Capital City’s fine tradition of hospitality. Recently baptized as Splendide by guests themselves, the hotel is “toutcourt”, full of that warmth and kindness found usually only among friends. Guests appreciate the richness in style and the spacious architecture – in distinct contrast with the typical present-day minimalism governing most new hotels’ interior decor and designThe Baroque Rome of Bernini, Borromini and Pietro da Cortona, the city that tourists admire everyday by just walking through its streets and across its piazzas finally has a hotel which gracefully offers that same decor and furniture once only to the noble palaces of 17th century Roman aristocracy. Here, the lush and rich sumptuousness of the city’s Baroque period comes to life again. The Murano glass chandelier which Luchino Visconti chose for the ballroom scene in his masterpiece film “The Leopard”, now lights up the hotel’s hall amidst the marble floors’ geometric designs. On the walls, golden “boiseries” enhance the warm tones of brocades while the Winter Garden’s sparkling stucco and lush mirrors reflect the soft and natural rays of light beaming in through the vault from above.

Name: I Palazzi Hotels
HQ Location: Italy, Lombardy, Brunello, Via Campo Di Maggio, 21020
Company description: I Palazzi – Historic Experience Hotels è un brand alberghiero italiano, nato nel 2016 che può contare su uno staff di grande esperienza nel settore dell’hotellerie. La collezione de “I Palazzi” è costituita da strutture che occupano edifici storici di rilievo, restaurati nel massimo rispetto dell’identità e della specificità architettonica degli immobili, in modo che ognuno restituisca un’atmosfera diversa e rappresentativa del contesto urbano in cui si trova. Qualità e bellezza di strutture di particolare pregio si fondono con raffinatezza e cura del servizio, per uno stile di ospitalità tutto italiano. A Varese si trova il Palace Grand Hotel, uno dei più importanti hotel della zona di Malpensa, perfetto sia per chi cerca una location business, sia per chi desidera rilassarsi vista lago. A Venezia si trova Cà Bonfadini, un hotel 5 stelle a Cannaregio, fiore all’occhiello del gruppo. Un palazzo storico che rende magico qualsiasi soggiorno, anche grazie agli affreschi che caratterizzano in maniera distintiva ogni singola suite. Al suo interno il Dama, ristorante veneziano gestito dallo chef Lorenzo Cogo: giovane e talentuoso, una vera istituzione della zona. Infine, a Siena, la dimora storica San Lorenzo a Linari, immersa nella verdeggiante campagna senese. Un angolo di paradiso per staccare da tutto e tutti.  Tre location iconiche tutte vincolate dalle Belle Arti: Varese, emblema del Liberty; Venezia, casa nobiliare del XVI secolo e Siena, antico convento del 1200. Palazzi che hanno una storia da raccontare, celebrazione della cultura e dell’arte italiana, che tanti nel mondo ci invidiano. Ad arricchire il progetto dei Palazzi, un’offerta esclusiva per gli amanti del mar Mediterraneo e delle coste italiane: MonteNapo Sea Luxury Experience. Un’esperienza di mare totale, con un soggiorno unico a bordo di un prestigioso yacht Riva Ego Super di oltre 20 metri.

Name: Hotel Pitrizza
Company description: Located on the rolling hills of the Costa Smeralda, only 5 kilometers away from the glamourous village of Porto Cervo, Hotel Pitrizza unveils an understated retreat by the Mediterranean. Nestled in verdant gardens or overlooking the sea, 65 rooms, suites and villas invite to pure serenity. Bathed in natural light, they boast traditional charming décor and a balcony, terrasse or garden to indulge in the sweet Sardinian life. Some of them also feature a private swimming pool with dazzling views of the Mediterranean sea. The Grill restaurant offers a delightful cuisine inspired by the sun-ripened products of the region while the Bar Pitrizza presents a selection of light bites and creative cocktails in the spirit of the Dolce Vita. For ultimate relaxation, the spa, the iconic swimming pool and the secluded beach complete this unspoilt well-being sanctuary. For dynamic guests, a fitness centre a tennis and a padel courts, as well as multiple watersports are also available And for the little ones, a kids club welcomes children in a dedicated area for fun-filled activities and exciting discoveries under the supervision of a dedicated member of the staff.

Name: Combo
Company description: Combo is a vibrant and dynamic space that transcends the traditional hostel experience, offering a unique blend of flavors, culture, and shared experiences. It serves as a bar, kitchen, radio station, and cultural event venue, creating a refuge for the curious to explore, create, and enjoy the pleasure of sharing. With a mission focused on urban regeneration, Combo revitalizes historical buildings, transforming them into open community hubs that welcome locals, freelancers, and travelers alike. The company fosters creativity through a diverse array of public events, artistic residencies, and engaging workshops, encouraging unexpected collaborations and interactions. By embracing diversity and promoting cultural exchange, Combo aims to build a sense of belonging and exploration within its community. Each visit promises a new discovery, making Combo a place where art, culture, and connections flourish.

Name: Marlfield House Hotel
HQ Location: Ireland, Wexford, Gorey, Courtown Road, y25dk23
Company description: Marlfield House is a luxury country house hotel in Gorey, Co. Wexford, Ireland. It is situated just one hour south of Dublin in the sunny south east . An Oasis of tranquility and charm, this luxury country house hotel has a refreshingly relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, mirrored by the courtesy of the Bowe family and their dedicated team. Marlfield first opened its doors to guests 45 years ago and is a member of the prestigious Relais & Chateaux luxury hotel group and Ireland’s Blue Book. With the addition of 5 contemporary pond suites located among the trees and foliage on the pond and the refurbishment of the gate lodge, Marlfield has a total of 26 bedrooms.  The house is set in 35 acres of manicured gardens, encompassing a large kitchen garden, woodland walks, pond , lawns and herbaceous borders. The interior bears all the signs of a much loved house filled with fresh flowers, gleaming antiques and mirrors, blazing fires and period paintings. There are a host of leisure activities in the area including links and parkland golf courses, archery, beach and woodland walks and horse riding, all within close proximity. The reputation of Marlfield has been built on its food, much of which is grown in the kitchen garden or sourced locally. Fresh vegetables, fruit and herbs grow abundantly in Summer and Autumn and are gathered daily for the kitchen. Kilmore Quay fish, Wexford beef and lamb, local artisan cheeses, all feature on the menu in the highly acclaimed restaurants - The fine dining Conservatory Restaurant and the more casual Duck Restaurant.  Marlfield House offers excellent small banqueting and conference facilities and is a beautiful setting for a romantic luxurious country wedding. Exclusive use weddings enjoy the many beautiful reception rooms , the gardens  and the wonderful food created by Marlfield’s chefs.

Name: Urban Brewing
Company description: REVIVING THE OLD + DISCOVERING THE NEW A unique restaurant & event venue for group bookings, corporate events and team dining experiences in the heart of Dublin. Our atmospheric, 200-year-old vaulted cellars, sun-filled terrace and versatile open spaces can host from 20 to 350 guests, with flexible layouts for seated meals, standing receptions, brewery tours, wine, beer and whiskey tastings, and more. We regularly welcome companies from around the world including Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon and many others for: • Corporate dinners & off-site team events • Afterwork drinks & canapés • Seasonal parties & large group bookings • Private brewery tours and tastings With a full event offering, including set menus, handcrafted drinks and dedicated support, we help teams create memorable moments, from casual gatherings to premium experiences. Looking to plan your next group event in Dublin? We’d love to hear from you.

Name: Castlebrook
Company description: Castlebrook is a multi award winning furniture fit out company specialising in the turnkey hotel and luxury apartment interiors. Established in 1982 the company has evolved into a market leading specialist in luxury interior furniture and today we are involved in projects across Europe, Middle East & Africa. The company has an extensive portfolio of completed projects and has developed an enviable reputation for its consistency in delivering high quality interiors on budget and on time. Castlebrook services are tailored to the design, specification and procurement of custom furniture and the associated project management, manufacture, installation and logistics services. We work closely with owners, operators, contractors, architects and interior designers to clearly understand their requirements from the initial concept stage through to final realisation. We have developed an extensive international network of quality partners who after many years of working closely together have a clear understand of our high standards.

Name: Milano Marittima Hotels
Company description: Siamo una famiglia innamorata dell’accoglienza, per noi ospitalità è sinonimo di sorriso, di cordialità e di attenzione. Ogni anno ci impegniamo a rendere le vacanze sempre un po’ più speciali, perché crediamo che la nostra “Casa” sia anche quella dei nostri ospiti. Il nostro gruppo è formato da 4 Hotel, tutti a Milano Marittima e vicinissimi al mare. L'HOTEL TRIONFAL, 3 stelle, è situato nella zona centrale di Milano Marittima, a soli 50 mt. dal famoso Bagno Papeete senza attraversare strade, accoglie i suoi ospiti offrendo una vacanza di totale relax sulla spiaggia oppure una vacanza di sport a scelta tra tennis, golf ed equitazione raggiungibili in pochi minuti con le biciclette ad uso gratuito dell'Hotel. L'HOTEL DELFINO, 3 stelle, direttamente sul mare senza attraversare strade e con accesso diretto alla spiaggia, è situato a pochi passi dal centro e in una zona particolarmente tranquilla ed elegante. Offre ai suoi ospiti una piscina riscaldata, un'area benessere, una palestra e un'area bimbi interna ed esterna L’HOTEL VIAMARE, 3 stelle, è situato a 600 mt dal centro di Milano Marittima e a 200 mt dal caratteristico Porto Canale di Cervia. Name: No. 1 Pery Square
Company description: Set overlooking the tree lined “People's park” in Limerick's historic Georgian quarter, No. 1 Pery square is an iconic luxury, intimate boutique townhouse Hotel & Spa. No. 1 boasts 20 bedrooms, delicious food & wine at Brasserie One, situated on the first floor with great views of the Georgian streetscape. The holistic Irish Organic Spa housed in the vaulted basement is a real urban retreat and the ideal choice for  a Spa break in Limerick.

Name: The Station House Hotel
Company description: Sitting on 12 acres of manicured gardens and woodland in the heart of the Boyne Valley, The Station House Hotel is just 40 minutes from Dublin city centre and Dublin Airport. A multi award winning hotel, and a member of the prestigious Ireland’s Blue Book, The Station House is best known for its warm welcome, it’s focus on serving the finest of local and Irish produce, and hosting beautiful events in elegant and charming surroundings.  The perfect base for exploring the Boyne Valley with its rich heritage including the nearby UNESCO world heritage site at Bru na Boinne (Newgrange, Knowth & Dowth), the Hill of Tara, Trim Castle, Dunsany Castle and Nature Reserve, and much more.  For those seeking activity, there are 2 championship golf courses within 7km (Killeen Castle & Royal Tara) as well as a host of other activities such as horse-riding, cycling, shooting shopping, or just chilling by the fires on a winters day or on the Terrace as the warmer days approach.   Built in 1862 as a busy railway junction, The Station House has a rich history itself, withstanding a fire attack in the 1920’s until it quietly retired from service in 1963. The Slattery family then purchased the property in 1981, registering it with Bord Failte in 1983 before launching Signal Restaurant and the hotel in 1984.  Specialising in events, The Station House embodies country house charm and provides the perfect location for off-site meetings and gatherings, as well as larger events hosting up to 200 guests in the stunning Carriage Suite - originally the locomotive workshop. With 19 individually decorated bedrooms, it is the perfect hideaway, just a quick drive from the city.  Open 7 days and available for exclusive hire. Please send all enquiries to info@stationhousehotel.ie  www.stationhousehotel.ie

Name: Mare Hotel Savona
Company description: L'albergo gode di posizione privilegiata sulla spiaggia, alcune camere sono dotate di vasca idromassaggio dietro il letto, altre di carattere più sobrio sono comunque spaziose, per questo sono molte le famiglie che decidono di trascorrere le ferie da noi. Il parcheggio esterno e il garage sotterraneo sono un servizio da non sottovalutare per il nostro territorio.

Name: CastelBrando
HQ Location: Italy, Treviso, Cison Di Valmarino, 29 Via Brandolini, 31030
Company description: CastelBrando was created as a Roman fort in 46 AD by the will of the Emperor Claudius Augustus. This magnificent construction was for centuries fought over by the most famous leaders of the European history because of its strategic location. Following a careful restoration, CastelBrando is today one of the best examples of the redevelopment of Italian historic and artistic legacies. It is located just above the medieval village of Cison Valmarino, in the heart of the UNESCO heritage Prosecco Hills, between Venice and the Dolomites. The castle, one of the largest and oldest in Europe, is surrounded by a beautiful park with a Hotel, a luxury Spa, two restaurants and a wine and cocktail bar.

Company description: Un esclusivo resort circondato da 42 ettari di vigneti, noccioleti e giardini, nei pressi di un territorio dichiarato Patrimonio Unesco. É il punto di riferimento per l’enogastronomia a chilometro zero ponendo grande cura ed attenzione alla sostenibilità e reperibilità della materia prima, alle tecniche tradizionali di cucina e, nel contempo abbinando i piatti ai migliori vini della zona. Name: My Arbor - Plose Wellness Hotel
Company description: In May 2018, the hotel My Arbor opened on the Plose - just a 10-minute drive from Brixen. It is a tree hotel with 104 suites, built on sticks, high up in the tops of the surrounding trees. A refuge in the middle of the forest of the Plose, surrounded by nature. My Arbor guests are invited to find there what often is missing in the hectic everyday life: time for the now, time for silence, time for the surrounding nature, MY-time. This time can be shaped individually, because in line with the MY idea, every guest will find the answer to his or her own personal needs. Holidays without restrictions with the greatest possible freedom for the guest's own rhythm. Breakfast until noon. Swimming after sunset. Sauna in the morning. MY ARBOR. My wellness hotel. In South Tyrol.

Name: Montana Lodge & Spa
HQ Location: Italy, Aosta Valley, La, 87 Località Arly, 11016
Company description: Montana Lodge & Spa è un piccolo albergo a cinque stelle situato nei pressi del Monte Bianco. Name: Gregori Hotels
Company description: Il gruppo Gregori Hotels è una solida realtà italiana nel quadrante dell’accoglienza di classe, nato e cresciuto sotto l’oculata guida del proprietario Alessandro Gregori, già presente nel mondo dell’hospitality con la famiglia da oltre 20 anni. Located just two miles from Dublin city centre and just five miles from Dublin Airport, this picturesque Dublin hotel is an ideal Dublin conference venue and a great Dublin Hotel for accommodation in Dublin and Castle Weddings.

Name: Dundrum House Hotel Golf & Leisure Resort
Company description: 18th Century Manor Hotel surrounded by a Parkland Championship Golf Course designed by Philip Walton. Manor House scheduled to re-open in 2023

Name: Butler House & Garden
Company description: Butler House and Garden is the charming Dower House of Kilkenny Castle since 1786. An integral part of the Kilkenny Castle Estate, Butler House was home to the Earls of Ormonde, who also built the castle, stables and coach houses at the rear of the house. Butler House was originally restored in the early 1970s by Kilkenny Design, who painstakingly restored all of the original architectural features and furnished the house in a very unique and contemporary way. The influence of Kilkenny Design has always been one of the unique features of Butler House bedrooms. This charming Georgian Garden was restored to its former glory in 1999.  It is now home to a superb boutique guest accommodation, comprising 17 bedrooms as well as meeting rooms, tea rooms, wedding and conference facilities. More recently, local Designer Orla Kelly, who specialises in working with Georgian properties worked with Butler House on three brand new unique bedrooms in 2020, and updated the original bedrooms in the House along with the drawing room and function room. The magnificent Butler Gardens are a feature of the property and are host to numerous cultural events and wedding ceremonies throughout the year. This charming Georgian Garden was also restored in 1999 and boasts its own private entrance to the Castle yard and Kilkenny Castle. With a view of the stunning Kilkenny Castle, our secluded walled gardens provide a beautiful backdrop across all seasons, particularly during the Spring / Summer when the garden is in full bloom. The superb location of Butler House offers visitors the very best of Kilkenny City. Through the front door, you will find Patrick Street, a two-minute walk to the centre. Through the back door, you will find the internationally renowned Butler House Walled Garden.  Butler House and Garden is also a proud member of Ireland's Blue Book, a prestigious collection of Ireland's most charming and stylish hideaways.

Name: Whitford House Hotel
Company description: Established in 1964 the proprietors, Jim and Kay combined their norman names Whitty and Radford to form the name of their new bed and breakfast  business. Their marriage was the bringing together of two families steeped in the Wexford traditions of friendship and hospitality. Now 50 years have elapsed and this 4 star property is one of the top hotels in Wexford town. It still retains the unique atmosphere that can only be nurtured in a family-owned hotel, with the support of a wonderful dedicated  team. It has been lovingly cared for through the years, giving rise to the large number of customers who return year after year for family holidays or to celebrate their own family occasions.

Name: Ballymagarvey Village
Company description: Ballymagarvey Village is a private estate in the historic Boyne Valley. Our warm homely 18th century Manor House is set around an open courtyard. We have restored the former Flaxmill Village transforming the historic outbuildings into charming spaces for both intimate and large wedding celebrations. Conveniently located 30 minutes from Dublin City Centre, Ballymagarvey Village is one of Irelands leading wedding venues.

Name: Castello Di Velona Resort Thermal SPA & Winery
Company description: A unique Resort in the middle of one of the best Italian UNESCO properties in the world; We are located among the art and history center of Italy, few km from Siena, Montepulciano, S.Giminiano, Montalcino etc… We are in the heart of the Brunello production area and we actually produce in the property one of the best Brunellos in the area with worldwide recognitio In the property we found the hottest Thermal water mine in all Tuscany with mineral water rising at the temperature of almost 90 °C, which after being cooled to 37 °C is injected both into the main pools as well as directly to the water bath tub in the rooms Our two main restaurants offer both traditional Regional Cousine as well as fine gastronomy We are in the center of Italian Fashion which can be admired in the style of the fine rooms both in the Castle side rooms as well as in the SPA Wing We love our job but most of all we love to delight our guests with a unique, tailor made 360* senses experience

Name: Geovillage Sport & Wellness Resort
Company description: The Geovillage Resort has 254 rooms located in Olbia immersed in the scenery of the north-east coast of Sardinia. The hotel is just 5 minutes from the city centre and a few kilometers from the most beautiful beaches of the Costa Smeralda and the famous villages of Porto Cervo and Porto Rotondo. The Geovillage is just 10 minutes from the international airport of Olbia Costa Smeralda. Name: Hotel Excelsior Venice Lido Resort
Company description: Hotel Excelsior Venice Lido Resort is a prestigious luxury hotel located on the picturesque Lido di Venezia, offering a serene escape just 15 minutes from the bustling heart of Venice. The resort features a variety of elegant accommodations, including premium suites with stunning views, and provides exclusive amenities such as private beach cabanas, fine dining options, and wellness activities. Name: Armani Hotel Milano

Griffini and completed in 1937 in the rationalist style of the time. This former manor house offers luxury 3 star hotel accommodation in Cahir and is the ideal base for your hotel break in the South East of Ireland. Cahir House Hotel is steeped in history, with the main tourist attraction in Cahir being the Island in River Suir, on which sits a medieval castle, Cahir Castle, once a stronghold of the Butler dynasty, Cahir House replaced Cahir Castle in the 1770s as the ancestral home of the Butlers of Cahir, whose titles include Barons of Cahir and Earls of Glengall. For sixty years Cahir House was home to Lord Cahir’s family until 1853, when Richard, Earl of Glengall was declared bankrupt and the entire estates were sold. However, twenty years later, his daughter, Lady Margaret succeeded in repurchasing Cahir House and the entire Cahir estate and retained ownership until 1961 when her son Richard Butler Charteris died, thus ending a 600 year association between the Butlers and Cahir. In 1927, Miss Nora Burke leased the premises and open Cahir House Hotel, for over forty years, the reputation of the hotel as a family run, warm, welcoming and hospitable establishment spread far and wide. Indeed, the visitor’s books include such names as Eamon De Velara, W.T Cosgrave, Mae West, Douglas Fairbanks, Walt Disney, Jackie Kennedy to name but a few. Cahir House Hotel is still a family run hotel, of which we are very proud, the legacy of genuine warmth and accommodation continues to incorporate the ideals and integrity of a time gone by with a modern efficiency and professionalism. Name: Hotel Villa Cipriani Asolo
Company description: Built in the Palladian era, the original structure that is now the Villa Cipriani underwent some notable improvements in the 18th century. The first thing we can say with certainty about the Villa dates back to 1889, when the English poet Robert Browning acquired it. During his ownership, the palace gradually took on the Florentine atmosphere that merges so well with the gentle hills of Asolo. After a few months his son, Robert Wiedemann Barret Browning, who settled permanently in Asolo, inherited the Villa. In 1902 he sold it to an important family from Treviso. The Villa was for many years a serene country estate, used for summer holidays and hospitality, until when the family ceded it and had been transformed into a country hotel named “Belvedere”. At the beginning of the ‘50s, the property again changed hands. The famous Irish family Guinness, already the proprietors of a nearby property, acquired the Villa, preserving it as a country inn. In 1962 the Guinness family passed the management to Giuseppe Cipriani, the famous founder of Harry’s Bar and Cipriani in Venice, who oversaw the transformation of the inn into a charming and refined small hotel, thenceforth known as Hotel Villa Cipriani. Villa Cipriani was acquired by Ciga Hotels in 1974, and in 1995 by Sheraton and after that by Starwood Hotels & Resorts. Name: Aherlow House Hotel And Lodges
Company description: Aherlow House Hotel was built c. 1928 by Robert Massy Dawson Saunders to replace the landlord’s residence at Ballinacourty House, which was destroyed by fire in 1922 during the Civil War. After that the Muller family owned it until the Donovan- Kavanagh- Kiely Co. developed it as a luxurious hotel in the 1970’s. Name: Ca Sagredo Hotel
Company description: A Private Palazzo, a Noble Residence, a Museum, a Luxury Hotel and much more… this all is Ca’ Sagredo. The sheer beauty of Ca’ Sagredo Hotel is weep-with-joy wondrous. As you pull up alongside the Grand Canal, you’ll need to pinch yourself and again when you step inside. The 15th century Palace has been declared a National Monument and still preserves the untouched beauty of an ancient noble Residence. It oozes romance while the opulently frescoed ballroom and lounge echoes with epic events of the past. Just gliding up the imposing marble staircase; whilst resisting a tap on a cherub’s peachy cheek, feels positively regal. Ca’ Sagredo’s views of the canal life and the historical Rialto Market opposite are storybook scenes of old. The hotel’s 42 magnificently appointed rooms and suites are a seriously suggestive sight to behold with classic Venetian styling. Art lovers be warned: there are so many treasures here, it’s easy to forget the outside world. But there’s always the hotel’s panoramic waterside L’Alcova restaurant with terrace over the Grand Canal to remind you, serving dishes that are a celebration of Italy on a plate. This magical location has inspired our Chef’s approach: the absolute protagonist is a cuisine made of fresh ingredients and characterized by a strong “Back to Nature” concept. Local delicacies are enhanced in his menus through the daily attentive personal selection from the Rialto Market: a “Natural Flavours Philosophy” providing a fresh twist on the authentic Venetian cuisine. His vision can be savored on his refined plates, characterized by rich tastes and great personality.

Name: Bianconi Ospitalità
HQ Location: Italy, Pg, Norcia, 12 Via Cesare Battisti, 06046
Company description: Gruppo alberghiero ristorativo presente a Norcia dal 1850, caratterizzato da un’elevata differenziazione di offerta e target di clientela. - 6 Strutture ricettive: Relais&Chateaux Palazzo Seneca - BEST WESTERN Hotel Salicone - Hotel Grotta Azzurra - Hotel Palatino - Residence La Castellina - Les Dependances. -2 Strutture ristorative: Ristorante Granaro del Monte da 500 posti ed il ristorante Vespasia (Una stella Michelin) - Gestione grandi eventi,  sale congressi fino a 1000 posti. - Centro sportivo all'avanguardia DESCRIZIONE: "La storia dell'Ospitalità Bianconi è una storia d’amore per l'ospitalità e per la città di Norcia che si rinnova di generazione in generazione a partire fin dal 1850.  Negli anni ’80 si segna la prima grande espansione aziendale con l’ampliamento delle camere dell’Hotel Grotta Azzurra e l’annessione del confinante “Granaro del Monte”, riconosciuto come ristorante più antico dell’Umbria. Nei primi anni ‘90 venne alla luce l'Hotel Salicone, dotato del centro sportivo più all'avanguardia dell’Umbria, entrato nel 1994 a far parte della catena alberghiera BEST WESTERN. Grazie ai suoi standard internazionali e il grandissimo Centro Sportivo Bianconi, l'Hotel ospita Federazione sportive, squadre di calcio, di basket e di pallavolo di rilievo internazionale. Negli anni 2000 la famiglia acquista uno storico Palazzo del 1500 con l’intenzione di creare un Hotel inimitabile. Prese così vita Palazzo Seneca, in grado di raccontare l’Umbria e le sue tradizioni. Dal 2009 nel circuito Relais&Chateaux, Palazzo Seneca è stato il primo Hotel Umbro ad entrare nel circuito del lusso internazionale.  Sempre nel 2009 la Famiglia Bianconi acquista anche l’Hotel Palatino a due passi da Norcia, un luogo tranquillo, ideale per famiglie e coppie. Nel 2015 il Ristorante Vespasia di Palazzo Seneca conquista la tanto ambita stella Michelin."

Name: HOSPES
Company description: L’HOSPES – Centro per gli Studi Turistici e Alberghieri e per lo sviluppo dell’Istituto “Erminio Maggia” di Stresa è stata fondata, nell’ormai lontano 1955, da un gruppo di personalità del mondo dell’industria e della cultura, per dotare la “Scuola di Stresa” di una sede e di strutture idonee al ruolo che la stessa avrebbe dovuto svolgere in campo didattico e culturale nel comprensorio di Stresa, con un bacino di utenza preferibilmente esteso alle province di Novara e del VCO ed a quelle confinanti e viciniori. L'HOSPES è, tra l’altro, ha costruito l’edificio, ove attualmente risiede la “Scuola”, costruito ad hoc, sul finire degli anni cinquanta, e successivamente ampliato con la costruzione di un nuovo corpo di fabbricato e corredato nel corso degli anni, con tutte le dotazioni necessarie allo svolgimento dell'attività didattica (biblioteca, laboratori, attrezzature professionali alberghiere). In linea con la sua carta statutaria, il Sodalizio si è posto (e si pone) l’obiettivo, certamente ambizioso, non solo di offrire, per quanto possibile, sostegno materiale alla “Scuola”, ma – e soprattutto – di fornire agli allievi ed agli ex allievi dell’Istituto adeguati, ulteriori, strumenti didattici, ad integrazione dei programmi scolastici e ad incremento della formazione culturale e professionale ed attività di aggiornamento.

Name: Eitch Borromini | Palazzo Pamphilj
HQ Location: Italy, Latium, Roma, 30 Via S. Maria Dell'anima, 00186
Company description: Set in the baroque Palazzo Pamphjli in one of the world’s most famous squares, Rome's Eitch Borromini has one foot in the 17th century and the other firmly in the here and now. The result is a five-star time travelling experience where yesteryear collides with the present. Romance oozes from every inch of this family-run endeavour whose rooftop terrace takes in an iconic scene of historic Rome: Piazza Navona. As the hotel’s namesake suggests, each of its six floors were constructed by the acclaimed architect Francesco Borromini. They are brimming with intricate frescoes and pop/contemporary art exhibitions on loan from Borromini Art Gallery.  A mesmerising open-air terrace is tucked between the bell tower and the dome of Santa Agnese church and the first floor is home to the Pamphili private library lined with famous and rare books and manuscripts. Eitch Borromini feels like a private palace and movie set (reminiscent of La Grande Bellezza by Paolo Sorrentino) and it has unbeatable 360-degree views of legendary Rome. The Palazzo's patio forms part of the Terrazza Borromini restaurant where locals and guests are treated to a menu that honours classic Italian/Mediterranean cuisine and fresh ingredients from local regions. Authentic Italian flair also flows through each of the 22 rooms and suites where original fireplaces, high vaulted ceilings, walk-in wardrobes and marble bathrooms featuring emotional showers are standard luxuries. Each one has been carefully decorated to reflect their unique character and frames the city perfectly through oversized windows.

Name: HBSL
Company description: Home The Amalfi coast, land of the Homeric mermaids reaching out the sea, reveals to its visitors a landscape of entrancing beauty, some areas even in still wild nature. This creates, the perfect scenario that brings together an oxymoronic combination of sea and mountain, peasant and fisherman.  The famous Italian director, Roberto Rossellini, defined natives as "mad, drunk with sunshine". Stubborn and headstrong men who managed to tame the harshness of the mountain during the centuries, building the typical terraces along its ridge, dominated by the intense and heady scent of the lemon groves and the vineyards: a mix of essences on a natural balcony overlooking the sea! The Hotel Botanico San Lazzaro, the newest and most exclusive boutique hotel on the Amalfi coast, is set among the terraces of San Lazzaro, an ancient and picturesque Maiori quarter, surrounded by Mediterranean vegetation and a spectacular sea view.  After walking a typical and peculiar narrow street that starts from the town centre, and that passes through the Lazzaro quarter, the guests, will reach the hotel hanged between sky and sea and will have a warm welcome by its highly qualified staff.

Name: IFlat Group
Company description: iFlat è leader nella gestione degli affitti brevi e delle case vacanza a Roma dal 2014, con un numero crescente di immobili gestiti in esclusiva. La nostra missione è massimizzare i redditi da locazione per i proprietari, intercettando il crescente flusso di viaggiatori e garantendo al contempo assoluta serenità. Dalla nostra esperienza, nel 2021 sono nate iFlat Dolomiti e iFlat Sicilia, realtà che offrono gli stessi servizi nelle rispettive aree. Sempre nel 2021, sono nate anche iFlat Property Solutions e iFlat Lighthouse. iFlat Property Solutions è un'agenzia immobiliare che si occupa di vendite, intermediazione e affitti a medio e lungo termine. iFlat Lighthouse, invece, è specializzata nella gestione di strutture ricettive particolari, come fari, castelli, trulli e altre dimore storiche. Complessivamente, gestiamo oltre 300 immobili. Il nostro team è composto da un gruppo di professionisti altamente qualificati, con oltre 40 dipendenti e collaboratori. Ognuno di loro porta con sé una vasta esperienza nel settore immobiliare e turistico, unendo competenze tecniche e una passione genuina per l'ospitalità. Utilizziamo strumenti e processi innovativi per ottimizzare la visibilità degli annunci e massimizzare gli incassi sulle principali piattaforme online come Airbnb, Booking.com ed Homeaway. Ci rivolgiamo a proprietari privati e società immobiliari che desiderano affittare i propri appartamenti per brevi periodi, ma non hanno le risorse o il tempo per farlo in autonomia con i livelli di redditività desiderati. Ci occupiamo di ogni aspetto della gestione: accoglienza degli ospiti, check-in e check-out, assistenza 24/7, ispezioni finali, pulizie e gestione della biancheria. Gestiamo inoltre tutte le attività amministrative, burocratiche e assicurative connesse ai soggiorni. Offriamo un servizio completo “chiavi in mano" liberando i proprietari da qualsiasi incombenza e garantendo un’esperienza a cinque stelle agli ospiti. Scopri di più sul nostro sito iFlat.it

Name: Circeo Park Hotel
Company description: Il Circeo Park Hotel è da oltre 40 anni un punto di riferimento per chi sceglie San Felice Circeo. Company description: In a place rich with history and cultural heritage, located in the heart of one of the most elegant cities, stands the magnificent Palazzo Victoria, a stunning palace built at the beginning of the XIV° century. Not only a Palazzo but also a Museum where you can still feel the visible traces of the past. The hotel is the result of millenary heritage of arts, cultures, architectural innovations and style that perfectly match and “live together”. Palazzo Victoria is ideally located whether the stay is for business or pleasure. It is the perfect venue for guests looking for “luxury” and the “true contemplation of beauty”.

Name: Mitico Hotel & Natural Spa
Company description: l Mitico Hotel & Natural Spa – è un hotel 4 stelle, vicino alla Fiera di Bologna e a pochi minuti dal centro storico di Bologna. Ad attendervi – in un ambiente fresco, dinamico e dal design innovativo – troverete un team giovane e fortemente motivato che saprà garantirvi cortesia, qualità e professionalità. Name: Airone Wellness Hotel
HQ Location: Italy, Sicily, Zafferana Etnea, 67 Via Cassone, 95019
Company description: Our Hotel, recently restored, is today a warm and comfortable structure, elegant and always respectful of the surrounding nature in which it is set. Our 62 rooms belong to three categories: standard, panoramic and junior suites. Even if they are all different in their dimensions, they are furnished with a warm and agreeable style and they are provided of every kind of comfort: private toilet, Lcd-Television, direct telephone, free minibar and tea facilities, safe, hair-dryer, air-conditioning. The majority of our rooms have terraces or private balconies, from where You can enjoy an extraordinary landscape.  Airone Wellness Hotel offers to our Guests a well-equipped Wellness Centre.
