Company description: Villa Lampedusa è un esempio di splendida residenza suburbana, aderente all'idea di corte che si stringeva attorno alla Casina Cinese, residenza estiva del Re Ferdinando IV di Borbone. All'interno dell'antico baglio si trova un resort con 13 eleganti camere e suite accoglienti, arredate con mobili d'epoca e dotate di ogni comfort, con una meravigliosa vista sul parco storico o sulla corte seicentesca, e un elegante ristorante "il Gattopardo", per gli ospiti che amano i profumi e la tradizione della cucina siciliana. Un luogo unico e suggestivo che ha ispirato il Principe Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa nella sua celebre opera, dove la storia si fonda con l'arte, la cultura e la poesia. Sempre all'interno della villa, si trovano le "Scuderie", un luogo magico dove organizzare cerimonie, feste, anniversari e ricorrenze speciali, grazie alla splendida cornice della dimora settecentesca, e del meraviglioso parco circostante. Un oasi di pace immersa nella natura incontaminata, tra ulivi, mandorli, agrumi e frutteti, e un giardino romantico abbellito da una serra ottocentesca con ombrosi viali, fontane, panche, dove ammirare numerose specie di piante esotiche e tropicali. Nel viale che porta alla scuderia appare l'antica "torre dell'acqua", la più alta dell'area urbana di Palermo. Questo incantevole contesto si presta a nozze, concerti, esposizioni e fiere, cene di gala, manifestazioni sportive e culturali e set cinematografici.

Lo splendido portale in travertino è un invito ad entrare nel Palazzo Todeschini-Piccolomini, che si distingue per essere stato la casa di nascita di Papa Pio III (9 maggio 1439 – 18 ottobre 1503), nipote del più noto Enea Silvio Piccolomini, il Pontefice che dette il nome all’incantevole Pienza (Pio II). All'interno scoprirete tre grandi suite con mini-spa, libri di ogni genere, una mostra d'arte permanente e un'affascinante grotta che pare essere stato un passaggio segreto che conduceva al Castello. E tra i servizi una colazione molto particolare preparata direttamente dalla proprietaria, autrice di una collana di libri di cucina. Il borgo di Sarteano si trova in una posizione strategica, ricca di magnifici scorci, attività e curiosità: dalle calde acque delle Terme di Chianciano, San Casciano, Montepulciano e Bagni San Filippo, alle escursioni in mountain o e-bike; dal fascino della medievale Rocca Manenti a quello della Tomba della Quadriga infernale, uno tra i migliori ritrovamenti etruschi a livello di conservazione.  Nei dintorni potrete invece tuffarvi nei panorami sconfinati della Valdorcia, andando a scoprire Pienza, Bagno Vignoni, Monticchiello e San Quirico, o in quelli più vivi della Val di Chiana, dove spiccano i laghi di Montepulciano, di Chiusi e il Trasimeno. Per non parlare del sito archeologico di San Casciano dei Bagni, con i suoi bronzi, oppure della confinante Umbria con Perugia, Assisi e Gubbio.

Company description: Wood meets stone at the foot of the imposing and breathtaking Monte Rosa. Guests will enjoy an authentic welcome and a refined elegance at the Hotel de Gletscher. The hotel allows its guests to reach the Monte Rosa ski area on foot or directly on skis.It was opened on 21st December 2009 as a meublé Hotel, where one can enjoy both discretion and elegance. The coming together of architecture and nature.From the large terrace, which gets the sun right up until the last hours of the day, guests can admire the stunning peaks of the Rothorn and the Testa Grigia, towering over the skyline as if you could reach out and touch them.Homely yet spacious, the Hotel de Gletscher is the place to relax and regenerate the senses no matter what the season.

To start you on your journey into Tuscia’s past, you may visit the castle, visit the museum in the main tower and look out over the ancient Etruscan land from the battlements. In the courtyard of the castle, you may also enjoy music events organized by the Carlo Cecchini Historical and Cultural Association. And in the family kitchen, you may take cooking classes, where people from the village will teach you old recipes. Understanding Tuscia is all about slowing down and experiencing an enchanted moment in Italian life, allowing the magic of the countryside to envelop you in its memories of past centuries. La presenza degli animali all'interno del complesso offre, inoltre, lo spunto per suggerire un contatto ancora più profondo tra l'essere umano e la natura. Oltre ai classici servizi agrituristici, Tra Serra e Lago propone ai propri clienti la possibilità di utilizzare aree dedicabili a sessioni formative. Tra Serra e Lago propone ai visitatori una cucina tradizionale: offre i piatti tipici della cultura canavesana, vercellese e biellese cucinati tramite l'utilizzo di prodotti provenienti dalle proprie coltivazioni e dal territorio nel quale l'agriturismo stesso è immerso.

L’attività di valorizzazione e promozione dei siti di interesse e del patrimonio culturale della città, così come la ricerca continua di un networking con le migliori realtà del territorio di interesse turistico, sono sinergiche rispetto ad una attività di affittacamere denominata Borgomurgia. La sede dove si svolge accoglienza turistica è ubicata in un palazzotto signorile della zona nobile del centro storico di Andria, a pochi passi dai principali luoghi storici e culturali della città. Name: Lume Ortigia
Company description: Il était une fois Lùme... Cernée par les eaux bleues de la mer 🌊, caressée par la lumière du Sud de la Sicile☀️, cette île, berceau de la ville de Syracuse, a vu se rencontrer depuis l’Antiquité toutes les grandes civilisations de la Méditerranée.   Grecs, Romains, Arabes, Byzantins, Espagnols et Normands, dont certains vestiges et autres ruines encore présentes sont classés 🏛, ont contribué à l’histoire et participe encore au caractère si singulier d’Ortigia. Pour découvrir Ortigia, il faut s’arrêter chez Lùme, “Lueur” en italien. Lùme n’est ni un hôtel, ni même une maison d’hôte. C’est d’abord une maison de famille.   Au cœur de la cité millénaire, cette élégante maison de famille ouvre ses portes pour une expérience inédite et chaleureuse à la découverte de la région de Syracuse. Plus qu’une adresse, un art de vivre placé sous le signe de la magie de la Sicile et baigné par le grand bleu de la mer. St Barthélémy, Ibiza, Formentera, Bali, autant d’îles que Prune a eu la chance de découvrir très jeune… Lorsque Graziella, une amie de la famille l’invite à Ortigia, elle tombe immédiatement sous le charme et décide d’y chercher une maison de vacances. Au "30 de la via Larga", elle visite un bien rare, une grande maison « cielo-terra » à laquelle elle ne résiste pas. Le projet évolue et Lùme voit le jour en 2022. Intimisme, générosité, charme et authenticité, infusent "l’expérience Lùme". Ses 6 chambres et suites avec terrasses, son roof-top embrassant la mer et les toits de Syracuse, sa salle de Yoga et son espace cardio/fitness, ou encore son Spa hammam ainsi que son coin de soins aryuvédiques proposant massages et autre moments de délassement unique au retour d’une journée de découvertes, réinvente définitivement l'art de voyager 🐚

Name: Hotel Ristorante Il Campanile
Company description: Prima di diventare un accogliente albergo e ristorante, Il Campanile si chiamava “Il Palazzo delle Anime”: un nome molto suggestivo, a indicare un luogo di ritiro e di esercizi spirituali, la cui edificazione ebbe inizio nel 1765. Teatro di vicende storiche importanti, come l’occupazione delle truppe napoleoniche nel 1834, il convento passò di mano in mano a vari parroci fino al 1976.  Nel 1875 Carlo Balocco, noto pittore della zona, “specializzato” in ex voto e in sacre raffigurazioni, venne invitato ad affrescare le sale principali della struttura, dove le sue opere rimangono ancora oggi testimoni della fede, nelle stanze dedicate all’accoglienza degli ospiti e agli eventi.  Completamente ristrutturato, il Palazzo delle Anime diventa, nel 2011, l’Hotel Ristorante Il Campanile.

Und der Mitgliedsbeitrag wird zur Förderung und Weiterentwicklung des Kochberufs eingesetzt. Alle Funktionäre sind ehrenamtlich tätig. Der Berufsverband ist ein NON PROFIT Berufsverband. Sul finire del 1700 Il castello passò poi ai dei Visconti e successivamente ai Tagliabue che lo mantennero così come lo vediamo oggi.

Name: Atellani Apartments
Company description: ELEGANT APARTMENTS IN MILAN HISTORIC CITY CENTER Situated in the museum and private home Casa degli Atellani, which hosts “La Vigna di Leonardo,” and just few steps away from Da Vinci’s “Last Supper,” Atellani Apartments offers 6, self-catering, elegantly furnished and fully-serviced vacation apartments. Restored in the 1920’s by architect, Piero Portaluppi, Casa degli Atellani transports visitors into the Milanese Renaissance, with architectural elements that date to as early as the 1400’s. Entirely refurbished by Portaluppi's grandson, Piero Castellini Baldissera, and great-grandson, Filippo Taidelli, the apartments preserve their original beauty and reflect the elegance of the building itself, while also underlining the strong family ties that have persisted for generations on the property. Conceived in 2015 as luxury, boutique apartments that unite historical charm with contemporary style, Atellani Apartments are characterized by an understated, Milanese aesthetic. Bespoke furniture and finishings were custom-made by master, local artisans. The interior design project, under the direction of Studio Castellini with  Paola Orsi Reggiori, includes homeware and fine fabrics by C& C Milano – a historic Milanese textile company. Far from the image of a corporate brand, Atellani Apartments  Casa degli Atellani has hosted an array of prominent and eclectic Renaissance artists, personalities and figures. Most noteworthy among its visitors was Leonardo Da Vinci, who stayed in the palazzo there while painting the “Last Supper”. Apart from being arguably one of Milan’s most beautiful privately owned palazzo’s, it was also one of the suggestive backdrops of the 2009 film “I am love” staring Tilda Swindon. This breathtaking setting is matched by a central and strategic location in the Porta Magenta neighborhood of Milan, which offers an array of shopping and fine dining, and numerous historical sites spanning the Roman era to Renaissance,  Art Nouveau to Rationalism.

The name Piedmont is derived from Latin Pedemontium or Pedemontis which means foot of the mountain. Exactly we are surrounded by three sides of the Alps, including Monviso. It borders with France, Switzerland and the Italian regions of Lombardy, Liguria and Aosta Valley.  We produce exception quality agriculture products -meat, milk, rice (risotto), hazel nuts and not to forget some of the world's best wines. Barolo, Barbaresco and Moscato to name a few.  Fiat is Piedmont Italy best export. There was a time in history where almost everyone living in Turin were either working for Fiat or associated to Fiat. Naturally when you come visit us you'll see many Fiats on our streets.  Piedmont Italy is divided into 8 Administrative Divisions: 1. Province of Alessandria. 2. Province of Asti. 3. Province of Biella. 4. Province of Cuneo. 5. Province of Novara. 6. Province of Turin. 7. Province of Verbano-Cusio-Ossola. 8. Province of Vercelli. Magnifica edificazione in stile Vittoriano “casa/lavoro” con ingressi dedicati e distinti tra vita pubblica (studio medico in via Roma) e vita privata (via Gramsci). Al primo sopralluogo l’edificio era in piena decadenza: dai tetti ammalorati filtrava l’acqua e l’intero apparato decorativo – infissi, pavimenti, stucchi, affreschi e tappezzerie – era stato depredato. Struttura L’ampia struttura da 600 mq si adagia su 4000 mq di esotico giardino (melo giapponese, pineta e more), con ingressi nelle centrali via Roma 66 e via Gramsci 22 con le due torri simmetriche che segnano l’ingresso e accolgono la scalinata che conduce allo stemma aradico. Il medico fu mito divino, innovatore nel gusto, nel comportamento e nella vita, che compendia nella Sua Villa Badalla. Figura complessa e controversa di un genio della modernità - a lungo vittima di ostracismo da parte di certa critica - per via delle Sue predilezioni sessuali, politiche e del contributo offerto a una ideologia pregna di patriottismo, interventismo, retorica estetizzante e superomismo lirico (su gentile concessione di Giordano Bruno Guerri).

Name: NAU Hotels & Resorts
Company description: NAU Hotels & Resorts is a premier hospitality company that specializes in providing luxurious accommodations and exceptional experiences across its portfolio of hotels and resorts in Portugal. With a mission to deliver unparalleled service and create memorable moments for guests, NAU Hotels & Resorts aims to blend comfort, elegance, and local culture in every stay. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including families, couples, and business travelers, offering tailored packages that enhance their experience, such as wellness retreats and gourmet dining options. Partnering with local artisans and culinary experts, NAU Hotels & Resorts emphasizes the importance of cultural exchange and innovation in its offerings, ensuring that each guest enjoys a unique and enriching stay. The target market includes discerning travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure in iconic locations, such as Lisbon and the Algarve.

Name: Solverde Casinos & Hotels
Company description: Solverde Casinos & Hotels is a premier entertainment and hospitality company that operates a network of casinos and hotels in Portugal. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional gaming experiences, luxurious accommodations, and top-notch customer service, aiming to create memorable moments for its guests. With a diverse range of offerings, including live sports betting and various gaming options, Solverde caters to a wide clientele, from casual visitors to avid gamers. The company partners with leading brands in the gaming and hospitality sectors to enhance its service offerings and maintain a competitive edge in the market. Solverde's mission is to deliver unparalleled entertainment experiences while fostering a responsible gaming environment, making it a preferred destination for both locals and tourists alike.

Name: Discovery Hotel Management
Company description: Criada em setembro de 2012 para gerir um conjunto de ativos imobiliários turísticos, a DHM -Discovery Hotel Management integra atualmente uma equipa de profissionais qualificados nas diferentes áreas do setor. O conceito dos hotéis Discovery está fundado na autenticidade, informalidade e respeito pelas características únicas dos locais onde estão inseridos. Cada hotel tem a sua própria identidade e privilegia experiências em sintonia com a região e a envolvente natural. A DHM tem como objetivo otimizar a gestão, sustentabilidade e performance das suas unidades. ---------------------- DHM - Discovery Hotel Management was born in September 2012 to manage a set of hospitality real estate assets, and currently, has a team of highly skilled professionals in both the real estate and tourism industries. The concept behind the Discovery hotels is founded on authenticity, informality, and respect for the unique characteristics of the destinations where they are located. Each hotel has its own identity and promotes experiences in harmony the region and the natural surroundings. DHM aims to improve the management, sustainability, and performance of its hotel units. www.discoveryportugal.com

Name: Martinhal Luxury Resorts
Company description: The Martinhal Family Hotels & Resorts were born from the expansion of the “Martinhal” brand and concept. The essence of the Martinhal brand successfully brings together the elements of luxury, family, design and genuine hospitality.  While everything started in Sagres in 2010, with the opening of the group’s first Resort Hotel, Martinhal Sagres Beach Family Resort, the Martinhal Collection has grown over the years, opening Resorts & Hotels in Quinta do Lago, Lisbon Chiado and Lisbon Oriente. Our newest luxury branded residences project, MartinhalResidences is now open in Lisbon Oriente.  Choosing Martinhal is choosing to be part of a passionate, collaborative and committed global team, where everyone feels like a valued member of our family. It is an opportunity to build meaningful, long lasting connections with colleagues from all around the world, who share the same core values and passion.

Name: Savoy Signature
Company description: Savoy Signature is a premier hospitality brand that offers an exceptional array of dining experiences and luxurious accommodations in Madeira. With a mission to provide guests with indulgent and cosmopolitan experiences, the company operates several exclusive restaurants, including the renowned Galáxia Skyfood and the culturally inspired Terreiro, each designed to elevate culinary enjoyment through unique flavors and stunning settings. Savoy Signature aims to create memorable moments for its clientele, which includes discerning travelers and locals seeking extraordinary gastronomic adventures. The brand partners with top chefs and local artisans to ensure that every meal is a celebration of creativity and quality. Targeting both leisure and business markets, Savoy Signature also provides facilities for meetings, weddings, and events, making it a versatile destination for various occasions.

Name: Grupo IBERSOL
Company description: IBERSOL, empresa creada en el año 1964, hace más de 45 años, está dedicada principalmente al sector turístico e inmobiliario. Sus orígenes y su existencia debe a unos profesionales de gran talla y bravura, que, ya en aquella época tuvieron una gran visión de futuro y fueron ampliando las actividades de su pequeño negocio hasta llegar a lo que es hoy IBERSOL. Las riendas de la empresa están aún en manos de alguno de sus fundadores. Más tarde, a ellos se incorporaron otros profesionales, uniendo así el conocimiento y la experiencia con la gallardía y las ganas de triunfo de la juventud. Combinación que no podía conducir a otra cosa más que al éxito rotundo en todos los aspectos empresariales: solvencia, seriedad, calidad de productos y de servicios. En los últimos años, IBERSOL ha consolidado su imagen, tanto ante clientes como ante proveedores, siendo una empresa estable, fiable, en plena expansión en todas y cada una de sus actividades, y con la suficiente solvencia para emprender cualquier proyecto por ambicioso que sea. Esperamos seguir en esa línea y merecer indefinidamente la credibilidad y el respeto que actualmente se está depositando en nosotros. La empresa explota más de 14 aparthoteles de ***, 3 hoteles de ***, 4 hoteles de **** y más de 1000 apartamentos, en régimen de apartamentos turísticos. También cabe destacar la explotación de un hotel rural en Tiedra (Valladolid): El Complejo de Turismo Rural de Tiedra. Tiene en funcionamiento un departamento dedicado a agencia de viajes receptiva. Cada año IBERSOL ofrece sus servicios a más de 15.000 veraneantes, de los que orientamos sus reservas, con toda la responsabilidad de hacer su estancia lo más agradable posible proporcionándoles servicios complementarios, con la calidad y eficacia suficiente como para merecer la confianza de todas las empresas del sector, con las que mantenemos las relaciones comerciales.

Name: Turim Hotels Group
Company description: The Turim Hotels Group, founded in 1992, is a group that has evolved in the national market.   The dynamic that characterizes us, is reflected in the growth of our projects and the quality of our hotel units. With the aim of satisfying all those who are looking for us, the Grupo Turim Hotels is ever closer to you, currently counting 18 units from North to South of Mainland Portugal and Madeira Island.   Come and enjoy the fantastic Hotels that we have waiting for you, equipped with experienced professionals, prepared to provide you with the best experience, whether you are traveling on business or pleasure.   It is always a pleasure to welcome you!   Turim Hotels Group is waiting for you!

Name: Jupiter Hotel Group
Company description: BEM-VINDOS AO UNIVERSO JUPITER HOTEL GROUP O Jupiter Hotel Group é um grupo hoteleiro português em crescimento, atualmente com quatro unidades hoteleiras nos segmentos de quatro e cinco estrelas e, futuramente, com mais três novas unidades - Porto, Alvor e Lagos.  No Algarve, conta com o Jupiter Algarve Hotel, na Praia da Rocha, o Jupiter Marina Hotel – Couples & SPA, em Portimão, e o Jupiter Albufeira Hotel – Family & Fun. Em Lisboa, encontra-se o Jupiter Lisboa Hotel, que reforça a presença do grupo na capital. Cada hotel tem um conceito único, pensado para diferentes mercados, seja para famílias, casais, praia ou cidade. No entanto, todos partilham um compromisso firme com a qualidade e hospitalidade, garantindo a experiência única que define a marca Jupiter Hotel Group. A nossa missão e visão Fazer felicidade com consistência e sustentabilidade na indústria do turismo, criando valor e marcando a diferença pelo amor, conhecimento e dedicação. O Jupiter Hotel Group pretende ser reconhecido como um grupo hoteleiro de referência no sector, pela procura permanente da excelência do desempenho medido pelos vários stakeholders: os hóspedes pela satisfação no produto / serviço; os colaboradores pela satisfação no trabalho; os investidores pela performance financeira. A sua visão passa por ser um grupo hoteleiro que procura criar valor e marcar a diferença pelo amor, conhecimento e a dedicação com que se entrega diariamente e fazer a felicidade dos nossos colaboradores, hóspedes e comunidade. Pretende proporcionar a todos os colaboradores elevados padrões de qualidade do serviço que possibilitem aos clientes experiências consistentes com as suas expectativas. Fazer a felicidade de todos aqueles que nos visitam, criar o desejo de regresso e da recomendação sentida com base na experiência vivida connosco.

Name: AP Hotels & Resorts
Company description: The AP Hotels & Resorts group was created in 2015 and belongs to MADRE TURISMO, owned by António Parente with the aim of being a reference in the Algarve hotel market, with the main objective of creating jobs and value in the region. It currently comprises eight hotel units: the AP Adriana Beach Resort, an All Inclusive family concept in Albufeira; the AP Victoria Sports & Beach, on Falesia beach - Albufeira, an excellent apartment hotel for families and also focused on sports; the AP Eva Senses, an excellent option for those looking to combine work and leisure, in the center of Faro; the AP Maria Nova Lounge, in Tavira; the AP Oriental Beach, in Praia da Rocha, Portimão. The last two have an Adults Friendly concept, in which comfort and rest are privileged, in an atmosphere of elegance and sophistication, the AP Cabanas Beach & Nature, in Cabanas de Tavira, with an innovative concept in the Portuguese market and especially in the Algarve: an Adults friendly, recommended for adults and people over 14 years old, which offers stays bed and breakfast or all-inclusive with a strong connection to nature and sustainability and AP Dona Aninhas, a charming boutique hotel in Viana do Castelo, North of Portugal. Also since 2024 the group acquired is first 5 star hotel – The AP Lago Montargil Conference & Spa in the beautiful Alentejo region. A luxurious property located directly at the Montargil lake! In 2025, expansion in Alentejo continued with the opening of AP Sines, a 4-star hotel focused at both leisure and corporate clients. More information and reservations at: www.ap-hotelsresorts.com

Name: PortoBay Hotels & Resorts
Company description: PortoBay Hotels & Resorts is a distinguished hospitality group that operates a collection of premium hotels and resorts across Portugal, Brazil, and the picturesque Madeira Island. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional guest experiences through a commitment to quality service, comfort, and local culture. With a mission to create memorable stays, PortoBay emphasizes sustainability and culinary excellence, as evidenced by its acclaimed restaurant, Il Gallo d'Oro, which has received multiple Michelin stars. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, business professionals, and gastronomes, while partnering with local producers to enhance its offerings. PortoBay's vision is to be recognized as a leader in the hospitality industry, known for its unique blend of luxury and authenticity, ensuring that every guest feels at home.

Name: VIP Hotels
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, Avenida António Serpa Nº13, 1069-199
Company description: VIP Hotels, é um Grupo Hoteleiro Português, fundado em 1978, com unidades de 5, 4 e 3 estrelas. Neste momento, o universo VIP Hotels é constituído por dezassete Hotéis que operam dentro das marcas: VIP Grand, VIP Executive, VIP Executive Suites e VIP Inn, englobando todos os segmentos de mercado e oferecendo serviços que vão ao encontro do perfil de cada cliente. Existem hotéis do Grupo que estão situados em Portugal, nas localidades de Lisboa, Sintra e Ponta Delgada, e também em Moçambique, nas localidades de Maputo, Tete e Beira. Os nossos Hotéis são ideais para lazer e eventos, tais como grupos, congressos e incentivos. Saiba mais em www.viphotels.com

Name: Clarion Hotel Sign
Company description: Clarion Hotel Sign is a premier hotel situated in the heart of Stockholm, adjacent to Norra Bantorget square and conveniently near Stockholm Central Station. The hotel offers a harmonious blend of modern Scandinavian design and comfort, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality, Clarion Hotel Sign focuses on creating memorable experiences through quality accommodations and personalized service. The hotel features 558 well-appointed rooms equipped with amenities such as minibars, climate control, and complimentary Wi-Fi, ensuring a comfortable stay for all guests. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including families, tourists exploring the vibrant city, and corporate guests seeking convenient meeting facilities. Clarion Hotel Sign boasts spacious conference facilities that can accommodate up to 600 participants, making it a preferred venue for business events. The hotel also offers a range of amenities, including a rooftop garden, spa, and diverse dining options, such as a breakfast buffet featuring local and organic ingredients, as well as a bar for relaxation. In addition to its commitment to exceptional service, Clarion Hotel Sign places a strong emphasis on sustainability. The hotel is dedicated to reducing its environmental impact and aims to achieve climate neutrality by 2030. This commitment not only enhances the guest experience but also reflects the hotel's responsibility towards the environment. Strategic partnerships with local attractions and businesses further enrich the overall experience for guests, solidifying Clarion Hotel Sign's reputation as a top choice for those visiting Stockholm.

Name: Bomporto Hotels
Company description: We are a group of small Boutique Hotels created in 2015.  Co-founders, Peter Lowe and Christopher Eddis imagined cool, contemporary, lush yet comfortable, lifestyle hotels in prime locations in Portugal.  May 2017 saw the opening of The Lumiares Hotel in Lisbon, and the group completed the acquisition of The Vintage Hotel, also in Lisbon in August 2017. In the summer of 2023 the group opened its newest project in Porto, The Rebello Hotel & Spa. Our mission is to grow the group adding in time new hotels to the family, offering premium quality accommodation, high standards of unpretentious and friendly service simple yet tasty seasonal food, great cocktails and beverages, and wellness moments  – above all memorable experiences in relaxed surroundings....    We embrace certain values such as commitment, dedication and respect for others and sustainable lifestyle and habits.  We hire and train our team according to these ideals.  Our strategy is to invest in the team, hiring multi-generation and multi-cultural talent, coaching our partners to participate with innovative ideas and services that differentiate it us from our key competitors.  We work to foster an environment where they can thrive.  We firmly believe happy people can affect positively feelgood happy experiences and create happy memories.   •	24 hour concierge “buddy”, through what’s app, chatboxes, or in person, from the moment you start to plan your holiday, to the time you spent discovering our lovely city, until you leave us, to help you make the best to your visit •	Great cocktails and tasty local food with our twist in our bars and restaurants •	Holistic wellness experiences in our Spa’s  •	In-room drinks and snacks and other surprises! So welcome to our hotels.  Work, relax or play, just enjoy the moment!

Name: Sembo Group
Company description: Sembo was founded 1987 in Helsingborg. The business idea was to offer affordable self drive packages to destinations around the Mediterranean on the Swedish market. Ever since then we have challenged the industry by selling dynamically packaged trips with different types of components. In fact in 2003, we were one of the first in the world to do this. Since 1987, we have accumulated a wealth of knowledge, experience and data that now means we dare to take the next step. Now we are developing a completely unique booking platform that will create great value for people to book completely unique user-generated trips in the future. A one stop shop for travel and experiences.  We have a bright view of the future. Where we built a data-driven travel tech company with big visions. Traveling is on most people's bucket list. At Sembo, we help people live their dreams. We became a part of Stena Line in 2007. A great opportunity to let Sembo create dynamic packages with ferry & hotel. This is something we still do today. Stena AB is one of the largest family-owned companies in Sweden and has global operations in shipping, ferry lines, offshore, real estate and finance. Stena also creates new businesses for the future.  Sembo is part of the Stena Line Travel & Retail Group. It's a business division within the Stena Line Group focused on leisure travel. The group has a turnover of more than 200 MEUR and operations within several European markets.

Name: CostaTerra Golf & Ocean Club
Company description: Running along the last untouched Atlantic coast in Southern Europe, CostaTerra is comprised of 300 residences on 292 hectares / 722 acres, over 30% of which are dedicated preserve land. It is an intimate, low-density community of like-minded families where you can build a lasting legacy. The attentive, personalised service, and engaging amenities create a healthy, supportive environment of life-long learning and forever friendships. Amenities such as CostaTerra’s exclusive Tom Fazio designed golf course, Equestrian Centre, family-focused Beach Club, Organic Farm, Wellness Centre and charming Community Village, ensure each new day will bring a new sense of fun and exploration the entire family will enjoy.

Name: Hotel Cascais Miragem
Company description: Hotel Cascais Miragem blends harmoniously with the beauty of the area. The hotel is located between the picturesque towns of Cascais and Estoril within 25 minute drive from Lisbon and its international airport.  The exquisite design of the interior speaks of elegance and the highest standards of quality, yet creating a feeling of comfort and well being – a truly unique place. The spacious lobby, contemporary guest rooms and a rich selection or restaurants, bars and leisure facilities set the scene for extraordinary experiences. Completed by the personalised service of our highly professional staff, your stay at Hotel Cascais Miragem will be sure to be an unforgettable one. The Hotel features 192 oversized guest rooms, including 11 suites and one presidential suite, all equipped with the latest amenities and comfort. The hotel is surrounded with a great variety of golf courses where players can enjoy special conditions and prices available exclusively for our guests. After golf our guests will be able to relax on the Zensations Spa which offers the last generation of treatments, aesthetic & wellness products and Aromatherapy Associates. The ideal location and stimulating atmosphere the hotel is offering to its guests make Hotel Cascais Miragem the perfect venue for your next conference or business meeting. Because decisions are easily made on the right environment...

Name: Torel Boutiques
Company description: A collection of prestigious hotels in Portugal: Torel Palace Lisbon, Torel Avantgarde, Torel 1884 Suites & Apartments and Torel Palace Porto.

Name: Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa
Company description: A warm welcome awaits you at the Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa.  Located in the heart of the business district, Sheraton Porto offers you the opportunity to explore and connect with the best-kept secret in Europe! Unique, exquisite and authentic, Porto is, like its wine, a treasure to be slowly appreciated.  Enjoy the convenience of being only a short distance away from the city’s rich heritage, where you connect with 800 years of history and experience port wine directly from its birthplace. Sheraton Porto Hotel & Spa offers a wide range of meeting rooms, totaling 1,750 square meters of meeting space. Or if you'd prefer to host an event outdoors, the hotel offers 4,000 square meters of garden space.  At THE SPA, body and mind find their equilibrium. Our concept is based on the essential seven pillars for well-being: Beauty, Harmony, Water, Vitality, Balance, Nature and Nutrition. The result is a space of pure leisure and relaxation, where you can dissolve the tensions of everyday’ s life.

Name: Mercan Properties
Company description: Mercan Properties is a premier real estate development company specializing in the creation and management of luxury hospitality projects. With a mission to blend modern design with rich cultural narratives, the company has successfully transformed historic buildings into elegant 5-star hotels, such as the Origine Porto Gaia and The Riverview, both located along the picturesque Douro River in Vila Nova de Gaia. These properties not only offer stunning views of Porto's skyline but also provide guests with unique experiences through their upscale amenities, including fine dining, rooftop pools, and wellness facilities. Mercan Properties aims to cater to discerning travelers seeking both sophistication and authenticity, while fostering partnerships that enhance the local tourism landscape. The company is dedicated to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences that celebrate the beauty and history of their locations.

Name: Orbis S.A.
Company description: Essendi is a leading hotel owner and operator in Europe. Beyond hospitality, we create dynamic, valuable places where people connect and thrive. Through responsible investments and operations, we bring Positive Hospitality to life for our people, our guests, and the communities beyond our walls.

Name: Onyria
Company description: Onyria is a distinguished group specializing in premium senior living solutions, launched in November 2021 with its Premium Selection Senior Living brand. The company is dedicated to enhancing the quality and visibility of senior care facilities across Portugal by providing tailored action plans, expert support, and training to improve service delivery. Onyria collaborates with reputable partners to offer cost-effective solutions and resources, ensuring that participating residences can meet the diverse needs of their residents. The company’s mission is to elevate the standards of senior living, while its vision focuses on creating a network of high-quality care options that prioritize the well-being of seniors. With a commitment to excellence, Onyria serves a wide range of clients, including senior living facilities and their residents, while also engaging with various stakeholders in the healthcare and hospitality sectors.

Name: Stureplansgruppen
Company description: Sweden’s largest entertainment group, Stureplansgruppen is active across the restaurant, entertainment, congress, contract catering, hotel and experience industries in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Visby and Åre. The company provides unique integrated solutions underpinned by a business idea which focuses on creating service-orientated meeting places and delivering premium quality entertainment experiences through a keen insight into the lifestyle and entertainment needs of its guests. At Stureplansgruppen, we endeavour to continuously lie at the cutting edge of the industry by creating and delivering unique value for our visitors, at the same time as offering a safe, secure experience. Our venues and events reflect the latest trends within cuisine, beverage, music and design. We create integrated concepts for individual guests as well as large groups, delivering overall solutions from start to finish. What makes Stureplansgruppen unique is its capacity to offer first class solutions from a single company spanning congresses, events, catering, conferencing, hotels,restaurants, nightclubs and concerts, while also handling marketing, sales and production within these areas through its own channels.

Name: Casa Do Marquês
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisboa, Prior Velho, Nº 17 Avenida Severiano Falcão, 2685-380
Company description: Criada em 1989, a Casa do Marquês orgulha-se de estar na vanguarda do sector de catering e eventos em Portugal. Mais de 30 anos de sucesso são reflexo de um serviço de excelência alicerçado na qualidade, inovação e dedicação de toda a sua equipa. A maior cozinha industrial do sector em Portugal, com capacidade de produção de 3.000 refeições por dia, e uma equipa multifacetada com a experiência e dinamismo necessários, permitem-lhe satisfazer todo o tipo de pedidos, sempre com o melhor serviço. A cultura do "sim", a total customização das suas propostas comerciais, e a qualidade permanente no catering e no serviço, fortalecem o compromisso da empresa para com os seus Clientes. Nos espaços exclusivos da Casa do Marquês ou em qualquer ponto de Portugal e do estrangeiro, para 10 ou 10.000 pessoas, tudo é (verdadeiramente) possível para que o seu evento não tenha igual.

Name: Confraria Da Rainha Santa Isabel
Company description: Confraria Da Rainha Santa Isabel is an organization dedicated to commemorating the 700th anniversary of Queen Santa Isabel's pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela, set to take place on July 23, 2024. The company aims to honor the historical and cultural significance of this event, fostering a deeper appreciation for the legacy of Queen Santa Isabel. Its mission revolves around promoting heritage, spirituality, and community engagement through various activities and events related to the pilgrimage. The organization collaborates with local communities, cultural institutions, and tourism partners to attract visitors and participants interested in history and religious pilgrimage. Its target market includes history enthusiasts, pilgrims, and individuals seeking to connect with the spiritual journey of Queen Santa Isabel.

Name: Gothia Towers
Company description: Gothia Towers is a premier hotel located in Gothenburg, Sweden, offering a unique blend of comfort and convenience for both leisure and business travelers. The hotel is strategically situated near popular attractions such as Liseberg Amusement Park and the Swedish Exhibition & Congress Centre, making it an ideal choice for families and event attendees alike. Gothia Towers aims to provide exceptional hospitality experiences, with a mission to create memorable stays through quality service and a range of amenities, including family-friendly activities and a luxurious spa. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including families, business professionals, and tourists, and partners with local attractions to enhance guest experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and community engagement, Gothia Towers strives to be a welcoming haven for all visitors to Gothenburg.

Name: Grupa Arche
Company description: Grupa Arche is a prominent Polish development company specializing in the revitalization of historical properties, transforming them into modern business hotels and community spaces. With a mission to preserve cultural heritage while fostering local communities, Arche focuses on innovative investments that breathe new life into neglected landmarks. The company operates a network of 21 hotels across Poland, catering to a diverse clientele that includes business travelers and tourists seeking unique accommodations. Arche's commitment to social responsibility is evident through its initiatives that support marginalized groups and promote sustainable development. By actively engaging with local communities and stakeholders, Grupa Arche aims to create spaces that not only serve as hospitality venues but also contribute positively to their surroundings.

Name: Hotel Varzinn
HQ Location: Portugal, Porto, Póvoa De Varzim, 100 Rua José Morneiro, 4490
Company description: Trabalhe na Póvoa de Varzim, no nosso hotel estratégicamente localizado num local sossegado, com excelentes acessos tanto ao centro da cidade da Póvoa de Varzim, como ao Centro de Congressos e à autoestrada (A28) que possibilita chegar em apenas 30 minutos de carro às maiores cidades de negócios no Norte de Portugal como Porto, Braga, Viana do Castelo, Ponte de Lima, Guimarães, entre outras.

Name: HOTI HOTEIS
Company description: HOTI HOTEIS is a hospitality company that operates the Logos INNSiDE Braga Centro, a modern hotel located in Braga, Portugal. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional service and comfortable accommodations for both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to enhance the guest experience through quality amenities and personalized service, HOTI HOTEIS aims to be a leader in the hospitality sector. Its target market includes tourists exploring the rich cultural heritage of Braga as well as corporate clients seeking convenient lodging for business trips. By partnering with local businesses and organizations, HOTI HOTEIS strives to create a welcoming environment that reflects the unique charm of the region.

Name: Conrad Algarve
HQ Location: Portugal, Almancil, 8135 Estrada Da Quinta Do Lago
Company description: Conrad Algarve is located in the south Portugal’s Algarve, Quinta do Lago, a breath taking resort next to the Atlantic Ocean, unspoiled golden beaches and world-class golf courses. Faro International Airport is only 20 minutes driving distance. Boosting 154 rooms & suites the property combines exquisite style and contemporary luxury with all the conveniences of a sophisticated modern retreat.  Discover unique opportunities and discover yourself at one of the world's most alluring destinations.

Name: The Editory Collection Hotels
Company description: Editory Collection Hotels is a brand that stands out for creating hotels that care about serving guests, but also cater for a contemporary experience and a unique lifestyle. This is the community era. The era of collaboration, cooperation, communication. This is a brand for the present time. Created by a group of people who cherish progressive values and are closely connected to communities, Editory is a collection founded on 4 pillars: Local, Art, Sustainability and Hospitality. From designing dream buildings to recovering historical heritage, from the principles of modern hospitality to the integration of a cultural setting and creative surroundings. The Editory is a new approach for hosting and entertaining demanding guests. A collection with its own curatorship of unique experiences and memorable stays. Name: The Steam Hotel
Company description: The Steam Hotel Det gamla ångkraftverket vid Mälaren, en gång en av landets största energiproducenter, har stått tomt i snart 25 år. Tills nu när ESS Group, skaparna av Ystad Saltsjöbad och Falkenberg Strandbad - två av Sveriges mest prisbelönta spa- och resorthotell, har förvandlat ångkraftverket från 1917 till ett 18 våningar hotell med 227 rum, restauranger, barer, konferenslokaler och spa. Med 15 meter till vattenkanten, dryga kilometern till centralstationen och knappa milen till Västerås flygplats erbjuder vi en helhetsupplevelse som sträcker sig långt utöver den vanlig konferensen. Mötesplatsen Möteslokalerna, varav den största har en kapacitet för upp till ca 550 personer, andas precis som övriga hotellet historien från det gamla ångkraftverket. Miljön från det industriellt råa kraftverket har mjukats upp genom varma materialval, mattor och möbler för att skapa en inbjudande och välkomnande känsla. Vår ambition är att skapa funktionella lokaler, utrustade med den senaste tekniken, där ni verkligen kommer trivas och vill stanna kvar även efter mötets slut. Läs mer här: https://www.steamhotel.se/konferens-malardalen/ Restaurangerna Den stora restaurangen på bottenvåningen, The Chamberlin, välkomnar er med en stor öppen brasa och ett livligt kök som växer ut i restaurangen. Med stora blyinfattade fönster som vetter ut mot Mälaren och den livfulla hamnen, sitter ni i en varm och skön miljö och njuter av internationellt inspirerad mat med fokus på grill och lokalproducerade råvaror. Här är vår ambition att trots kapaciteten på 300 platser, skapa en ombonad känsla, långt från de opersonliga kongressrestauranger vi är vana att se. Högst upp, på 18e våningen blir det en mäktig roof top restaurang, Locavore, där du njuter av mat och dryck omringad av den vidsträckta utsikten. Bara det en upplevelse i sig. HRF's mission is to empower its members and enhance their working conditions, while its vision focuses on fostering a fair and equitable workplace environment in the hospitality industry. The Masterplan of Palmares was defined to preserve and increase the value of the resort by honouring the area’s natural beauty and panoramic ocean views. The large natural amphitheatre enables spectacular views from all parts of the resort towards the golf, the Meia-Praia beach in Lagos and to the estuary of Alvor. The low density of construction at just 5.7%, and the state-of-the-art architecture, protect the original natural surroundings while forging an exceptional harmony between golf and the ocean. Strict construction parameters have been put in place to protect the sea views (building implementation zones and height limits) allowing each villa or apartment the opportunity to benefit individually. RCR Arquitectes, Pritzker award winners in 2017 designed the Clubhouse and the Signature Apartments and Villas. Whether for a permanent residence, an ideal holiday home or a rental investment, Palmares truly represents one of the last opportunities to own a resort property in the Algarve within walking distance to the beach.

Name: Praia Do Sal Resort
Company description: Discover our luxury apartments and the Resort itself, enjoy the authentic Italian cuisine at Omaggio or indulge yourself at Praia do Sal SPA.

Name: Hotéis Alexandre De Almeida
Company description: Hotéis Alexandre de Almeida is a distinguished hotel group in Portugal, offering a selection of unique accommodations in some of the country's most picturesque locations. With properties such as the Palace Hotel Bussaco, Curia Palace Hotel, and Astória Hotel, the company aims to provide guests with an enchanting experience steeped in history and natural beauty. The mission of Hotéis Alexandre de Almeida is to create memorable stays that celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Portugal, while its vision focuses on delivering exceptional hospitality and comfort. Catering to both leisure and business travelers, the company partners with various agencies and businesses to enhance its offerings and reach a diverse clientele. Whether exploring the historic city of Coimbra or the vibrant atmosphere of Lisbon, guests are invited to immerse themselves in the charm and elegance that define Hotéis Alexandre de Almeida.

Name: Phoenicia Express
Company description: Un hotel elegant, Phoenicia Express este situat in zona de nord a Bucurestiului la doar 5 minute de Aeroportul International Henri Coanda. Este cea mai buna solutie de cazare, daca participati la unul din targurile organizate la Centrul Expozitional Romexpo sau daca vreti sa vizitati Bucurestiul; atat pentru partea culturala oferind acces imediat catre centru (15 minute)-Piata Victoriei cat si pentru cumparaturi sau distractie: prin Baneasa Shopping City sau prin unele din cele mai cautate cluburi din Bucuresti. Fiind usor accesibil, situat pe soseaua de centura a Bucurestiului, hotelul ofera facilitati deosebite si servicii de calitate. Aici veti beneficia de 181 de camere asezate potrivit motto-lui nostru:” comfort, quality and good taste”, de piscina, centru SPA, doua restaurante, un lobby bar, club de noapte precum si 460 de locuri pregatite pentru conferinte, lansari, cocktailuri, nunti si petreceri private. Alegeti un hotel din zona de nord a Bucurestiului si in imediata vecinatate a orasului Otopeni si veti gasi intotdeauna preturile cele mai bune si respect pentru ceea ce inseamna grija pentru clienti!

Name: Residence Hotels
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, Alexandru Constantinescu Street
Company description: RESIDENCE HOTELS is the only 100% Romanian owned chain of boutique hotels. Located in Bucharest near the Arch of Triumph, Residence Hotels are 4 star luxury "Business & Wellness" hotels which provide the best quality of accommodation and restaurant services for businessmen, diplomats, official figures, top level managers and also leisure tourists visiting Romania. Our restaurants are the best choice for a gastronomic journey, offering an exceptional food and drinks menu, a fusion between modern and classic Romanian-International cuisine, accompanied by the perfect harmony of live piano music. Residence Hotels Bucharest also provide professional locations and services for corporate events such as seminars, conferences, presentations or team-buildings and private events as weddings, baptisms, banquets or parties. We are among the first members of BLLA (Boutique and Lifestyle Lodging Association), the only world association of boutique hotels, located in Los Angeles. Residence Hotels are also the first Romanian hotel partner of CNN, the only hotels in Romania who associate their name with the largest news and information network. Residence Hotels "Business & Wellness" celebrates 10 years since the opening of the first boutique-hotel in Romania and, over the first decade, we hosted many famous guests. From the prominent representatives of royal houses and illustrious diplomats to artists, from politicians to movies celebrities, from businessmen to tourists, in love with the unique atmosphere of our boutique-hotels. Prince Paul of Romania and Princess Lia, Nadia Comaneci, Gheorghe Hagi and Ion Tiriac, Cesaria Evora, Murray Abraham, Paul Sorvino, Goran Bregovic, Alexandra Maria Lara, Anna Valle, Daniel Bernhardt, Michael Pare, Diane Pernet and Alex Kingston are just a few of those who experienced the world of Residence Hotels, Bucharest, Romania.

Name: Grand Hôtel Stockholm
Company description: The Grand Hôtel in Stockholm has been home to celebrities, high-profile events and everyday bon-vivants since 1874. Situated in the best waterfront location imaginable, the hotel overlooks the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan, Stockholm’s old town. The Grand is also home to the classic Swedish Veranda restaurant, renowned for its traditional smörgåsbord, Mathias Dahlgren’s Matbaren and the spectacular Cadier Bar. For recreation, there’s the Nordic Spa & Fitness club with hot saunas and cool dipping pools.

Name: Nordic Light Hotel
Company description: Nordic Light Hotel is where the essence of the Nordics comes alive.  We are a contemporary meeting place, right in the hustle and bustle of central Stockholm. Here, the vibrant city is reflected in a house that never sleeps.

Name: MS Group
HQ Location: Portugal, Porto, Porto, N.º 45 Rua António Nicolau D'almeida, 4100-320
Company description: MS Group is a multifaceted company based in Porto, Portugal, specializing in various sectors including hospitality, real estate, and consulting. With a mission to deliver exceptional experiences and services, the company operates several high-end brands such as MS Collection and Moon & Sun, catering primarily to discerning clients in the tourism and leisure industries. MS Group is committed to sustainability and innovation, aiming to enhance the quality of life for its customers and partners. The company collaborates with a diverse range of stakeholders, including local businesses and international partners, to create unique offerings that resonate with its target market. Through its dedication to excellence, MS Group strives to be a leader in its fields, continually adapting to the evolving needs of its clientele.

Name: WOTELS
Company description: WOTELS is a hospitality company that offers unique accommodations and experiences in picturesque locations across Portugal, including the serene Lagoa da Pateira and the vibrant surf town of Ericeira. With a mission to provide guests with a tranquil and memorable stay, WOTELS features a range of options from cozy hotels to lively hostels, catering to diverse preferences and budgets. The company emphasizes a connection with nature, encouraging outdoor activities such as kayaking, paddleboarding, and birdwatching, while also offering delicious regional cuisine in its on-site restaurants. WOTELS aims to create a welcoming environment for both tourists and locals, making it an ideal choice for those seeking relaxation and adventure in beautiful natural settings. Its target market includes families, adventure seekers, and anyone looking to unwind in a charming and authentic Portuguese atmosphere.

Name: Eurosol Hotels
Company description: Eurosol Hotels is a prominent player in the Portuguese hospitality industry, offering a range of 3 and 4-star accommodations across five unique locations, including Alcanena, Leiria, Gouveia, and Seia. The company is dedicated to promoting national tourism responsibly while ensuring quality, comfort, and excellence in service. With a mission to exceed the expectations of customers, employees, and partners, Eurosol Hotels focuses on providing authentic and affordable experiences that reflect a strong social commitment. The target market includes both leisure and business travelers seeking cozy and welcoming environments, making it an ideal choice for those exploring the rich culture and natural beauty of Portugal. Through strategic partnerships and a commitment to customer satisfaction, Eurosol Hotels aims to create memorable stays that highlight the best of Portuguese hospitality.

Name: Camp Ripan
Company description: Camp Ripan is a family-owned experience facility located in Kiruna, where the breathtaking Arctic landscape meets a city undergoing constant transformation. The company is dedicated to sustainable tourism, guided by its comprehensive sustainability strategy known as the Camp Ripan Model, which focuses on social responsibility, local engagement, and climate consciousness. By promoting local culture and supporting regional producers, Camp Ripan aims to strengthen the local economy while providing guests with authentic experiences that reflect the area's unique heritage. The company prioritizes employee well-being and development, ensuring a fair and inclusive work environment. With a commitment to reducing its climate impact, Camp Ripan employs eco-friendly practices and educates both staff and guests on sustainability. Its target market includes environmentally conscious travelers seeking immersive cultural experiences in a stunning natural setting.

Name: DoubleTree By Hilton Hotel & Conference Centre Warsaw
Company description: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Conference Centre Warsaw is a premier hospitality destination that combines luxury accommodations with state-of-the-art conference facilities. The hotel is dedicated to providing exceptional service and creating memorable experiences for its guests, whether they are traveling for business or leisure. With a mission to offer a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality amenities, the hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including corporate clients seeking venues for conferences and events, families looking for a relaxing getaway, and couples planning special occasions like weddings. The hotel features a range of facilities, including a spa, fitness center, and various dining options, ensuring that all guests can enjoy a comprehensive and enjoyable stay. As a part of the Hilton brand, DoubleTree by Hilton Warsaw is committed to sustainability and community engagement, aiming to be a leader in the hospitality industry while fostering lasting relationships with its partners and clients.

Name: Nanny Poppins Portugal
Company description: We are a Nanny agency based in Cascais, Portugal providing only the best childcare services.  What we offer is a little more than your basic nanny. Our nanny’s will take excellent care of your child/children and offer fun activities such as arts and crafts, songs and dance, story time, day trips, educational games, cooking, light cleaning and so much more! We set ourselves apart from the rest by catering specifically to the international community in Portugal. Nanny Poppins Portugal is run by a British woman, Emma, who transitioned from teaching pre-school into working as a nanny. Soon after, Emma realised the the international community was missing something. So she created Nanny Poppins Portugal.  An agency that goes the extra mile to find the perfect nanny for your family based on your specific needs.   English, French, Spanish, German, Russian & Portuguese are just a few of the nationalities represented by our fantastic team of nannies.

Name: Marstrands Havshotell AB
Company description: That barren, salty, windswept calm, that constant encounter between land and sea is made for inspiration and gathering by the sea, all year round.  Here at Marstrands Havshotell we know exactly how to create the perfect meeting and event. We match personal service, knowledge and commitment with experience and a very unique location. From beginning to end.  No matter if you are looking for a private villa on a remote island, a greenhouse or a more traditional conference room, for big or small groups, Marstrands Havshotell is the place to come to.  Our conference packages always coffee breaks with in-house made cakes and snacks, relaxation in our west coast inspired SPA, mouth-watering meals in our restaurant Ottos Kök and in one of our 98 rooms you’ll find tranquillity at the end of the day.  With an activity you will make the conference extra memorable. We offer a wide selection of activities both on sea and shore.  Book your next conference or event with us. Because we are not like everyone else, but neither are you and your colleagues.  Welcome to the sea. Less than an hour from Gothenburg.

Name: Hotel Senator 4*
Company description: Hotel Senator, located in Dźwirzyno near Kołobrzeg, is a premier four-star family-friendly hotel that provides a unique seaside experience designed for guests of all ages. With 257 comfortable rooms, the hotel offers a wide array of amenities, including a large aquacenter, a luxurious spa, and dedicated facilities for children, all aimed at creating a joyful and engaging environment for families. The mission of Hotel Senator is to deliver memorable vacation experiences, ensuring that both children and adults can partake in a variety of activities, from daily animations to themed evenings.  The hotel collaborates with professionals, including the renowned Supernanny Dorota Zawadzka, to enhance its family-oriented services and workshops, further solidifying its commitment to family engagement. Targeting families, business travelers, and pet owners, Hotel Senator combines relaxation with opportunities for active leisure, making it an ideal destination for those seeking a peaceful retreat by the Baltic Sea.  In addition to its family-centric offerings, the hotel features themed workshops, sports activities for children, and a variety of indoor and outdoor play areas, ensuring that every guest feels like a valued member of the family. Its strategic location near the beach and surrounding pine forests makes it a perfect getaway for nature lovers and those looking to unwind. Through partnerships with local attractions and a steadfast commitment to exceptional service, Hotel Senator strives to deliver unforgettable holiday experiences, making it a top choice for families seeking a relaxing seaside escape.

Name: PVW Tinsa By Accumin
Company description: Em Portugal a PVW Tinsa by Accumin faz avaliações imobiliárias para entidades financeiras, como sejam instituições de crédito, sociedades financeiras, sociedades gestoras de fundos de pensões, fundos de investimento imobiliário, companhias de seguros ou de resseguros, entidades públicas e privadas, assim como para particulares. Prestamos também outros tipos de serviços, tais como avaliações para efeitos contabilísticos (de acordo com as normas IAS), avaliações para processos de partilhas, de fusões ou aquisições e avaliação de equipamentos. Fazemos parte da ACCUMIN, um líder global e independente em avaliações e consultoria, inteligência e software, e gestão de risco. Como um dos maiores e mais conceituados grupos imobiliários do mundo, unimos 3 continentes, 14 mercados e mais de 20 empresas com mais de 40 anos de experiência, a Accumin tem um objetivo claro: possibilitar que pessoas e empresas prosperem, tomando as decisões imobiliárias mais acertadas, e que a empresa expressa mediante "See Value Clearly".  A nossa força advém do conhecimento e da diversidade, combinados com as nossas capacidades inovadoras. Desde dados e software de última geração, a processos tecnológicos e avaliadores de nível mundial, a amplitude e profundidade da nossa experiência é inigualável.  Compreendemos o valor. Sabemos como fazê-lo crescer e como o proteger. Por isso, conte connosco para lhe trazer clareza e as nossas melhores competências para que possa ver o valor de forma clara. #SeeValueClearly

Company description: WorkTrips – nowa era podróży służbowych Intuicyjne rozwiązanie, które oszczędza czas i redukuje koszty, jest dostępne 24h on-line, ułatwia i upraszcza organizację wyjazdów biznesowych. Name: Europe's Famous Hostels
Company description: Europe's Famous Hostels is a renowned network of hostels across Europe, celebrating 30 years of providing unique and memorable experiences for backpackers and travelers. The company aims to create a vibrant community where stories of adventure, friendship, and spontaneity come to life, encouraging guests to share their own travel tales through initiatives like the "Tracks & Tales" competition. With over 50 hostels in prime locations, it caters primarily to young, adventurous travelers seeking affordable and authentic accommodations. Partnering with Eurail, Europe's Famous Hostels promotes sustainable travel by encouraging train journeys over flights, while also offering discounts for eco-conscious travelers. The company's mission is to ensure that every journey is as memorable as the destination, fostering connections among travelers from around the globe.

Name: SunGarden Golf & SPA Resort
HQ Location: Romania, Cluj, Cluj-napoca, 1000 The Deer Meadow Poiana Cerbului
Company description: SunGarden Golf & SPA Resort welcomes golfers and SPA lovers in a unique setting, in the heart of Transylvania, Romania. The 30 ha domain has its foundations on an old hunting ground. The private resort is a great escape for the seasoned travelers, for families and friends. The Deer Meadow in the middle of the Baciu Forest hosts today the SunGarden Hotel and Dining area, the SPA, the Eden events hall, the Roman Plazza, the Venice Plazza and Outdoor Pool, the Chapel, the Lake and the Golf Course. Should you be a SPA aficionado, a Golfer or a nature and culture explorer, you will please your heart at SunGarden Golf & SPA Resort.

Name: Ukino Hotels
Company description: Consulting & Management Company Specialised in the Hotel Industry

Name: Villa Dagmar Stockholm
Company description: A vibrant villa and an international hotel experience located in the heart of Stockholm. Villa Dagmar is an intimate boutique hotel with 70 individually designed guest rooms and suites as well as a range of restaurant experiences, event and private dining areas, a concept store, a flower shop, a spa and a fitness centre. This stunning home away from home, is the perfect space for the modern traveller who seeks a space with authentic character in one of Stockholm’s most prestigious neighbourhoods next to Östermalms saluhall. Villa Dagmar belongs to the same family as the renowned Hotel Diplomat. Villa Dagmar is the second hotel within the family-owned Diplomat Collection which also includes Hotel Diplomat and Villa Dahlia.

Name: Belver Hotels
Company description: Os Hotéis Belver são um Grupo Hoteleiro Português, com a sua sede em Lisboa, e são constituídos por 7 hotéis, localizados de Norte a Sul de Portugal. Os Hotéis Belver obedecem a uma ideia base: “Acolher em ambiente requintado, marcado pela História, pela localização ou por características únicas, de forma personalizada, para que quem vem se sinta simplesmente num não hotel.” A nossa recusa dos estereótipos hoteleiros e do tratamento em série traduz-se na criação de um conceito de acolhimento próprio, a um tempo familiar e caseiro.

Name: Associação Da Hotelaria De Portugal
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, Nº 75 Av. Duque De Ávila, 1000-139
Company description: Associação da Hotelaria de Portugal (AHP) A AHP promove o melhor da hotelaria em Portugal, assim como representa a maioria dos hotéis e empreendimentos turísticos do nosso país. A AHP é uma associação centenária que centra a sua acção no negócio e futuro dos seus associados, orientada para a inovação, o conhecimento e o mercado. A hotelaria representa o que de melhor se faz em Portugal, pela sua inovação, pela sua classe, pelo serviço de excelência dos seus profissionais, mas também pela representatividade que tem hoje no contributo para a economia nacional. Nos 100 anos que tem de vida, a AHP tem tido a responsabilidade de ser o reflexo do sector, dignificando a hotelaria e o associativismo em Portugal.  Somos uma associação para todos: grandes e pequenas unidades. Os pequenos hotéis podem encontrar na associação o apoio de uma estrutura que lhes permite ganhar escala, ter vantagens nas negociações comerciais, dispor de serviços que seriam incomportáveis para uma pequena empresa. A todos a AHP serve de plataforma de partilha de saber e conhecimento, com representatividade nacional e próxima dos centros de decisão.  A AHP é uma associação em crescimento e tem actualmente mais de 500 associados que, entre grandes e pequenas unidades, representam a maioria do contributo da hotelaria para a economia nacional. É nossa ambição crescer cada vez mais, associar todos os hotéis de Portugal e representá-los a uma só voz, com força, credibilidade e exigência.

Name: CFI HOTELS GROUP
HQ Location: Poland, Łódź Voivodeship, Łódź, 2 Plac Zwycięstwa, 90-312
Company description: CFI Hotels Group  to polska grupa hotelowa, której właścicielem jest spółka Central Fund of Immovables, zarządzająca obecnie 14 obiektami hotelowymi zlokalizowanymi w całym kraju. CFI posiada 8 obiektów hotelowych działających pod szyldem Boutique Hotel's: cztery w Łodzi, w której firma otworzyła w 2010r. swój pierwszy obiekt, dwa we Wrocławiu i po jednym w Bytomiu i Sosnowcu. Do sieci należy także designerski Art Hotel’s Sosnowiec i pierwszy obiekt nowej marki – Citi Hotel's, otwarty w lipcu 2017r. we Wrocławiu. Do grupy CFI należą także restauracje znajdujące się w Łodzi – Farina Bianco, Wall Street BBQ i Gęsi Puch.

Name: ARCHE HOTELE
Company description: ARCHE HOTELE is a prominent Polish hotel chain that specializes in providing comfortable accommodations in historic buildings across various locations. With a mission to create a network of hotels that blend modern comfort with cultural heritage, ARCHE aims to offer guests a unique experience that emphasizes relaxation and local charm. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers and leisure guests, and partners with organizations to host events and conferences. With properties in major cities like Warsaw, Wrocław, and Gdańsk, as well as picturesque countryside locations, ARCHE HOTELE targets both domestic and international visitors seeking quality lodging and exceptional service. The brand is committed to preserving historical sites while promoting sustainable tourism and community engagement through various initiatives.

Name: Hotel Skansen I Båstad
Company description: A hub of activity in the summer, a relaxing retreat in the winter. With the panoramic windows offering gorgeous sea views, Bjäre flavors coming out of the kitchen, and delightful guests all year round, come enjoy the special atmosphere that is sure to make you smile. As the 1900s king of Båstad Ludvig Nobel would say: “In Båstad, we live a life of leisure.”

Name: Hotele Diament SA
Company description: HOTELE DIAMENT S.A. to dynamicznie rozwijająca się sieć hoteli biznesowych zlokalizowana na południu Polski. Posiada blisko 20 letnie doświadczenie, działając w oparciu o wyłącznie polski kapitał. Aktualnie tworzą ją obiekty o standardzie czterech i trzech gwiazdek w siedmiu miastach: Chorzowie, Gliwicach, Katowicach, Siemianowicach Śląskich, Ustroniu, Wrocławiu i Zabrzu. Są to duże hotele biznesowe, butikowe hotele w zabytkowych kamienicach, hotele stylizowane oraz położone w malowniczych górskich okolicach.  Sieć oferuje gościom ponad 2000 miejsc noclegowych w blisko 1000 pokojach, prawie 3000 m2 powierzchni profesjonalnie wyposażonych sal konferencyjnych i pełną obsługę gastronomiczną. Miesięcznie Hotele Diament przyjmują ok. 25 000 gości.

Name: Ptak Warsaw Expo
Company description: Ptak Warsaw Expo is a leading exhibition and trade fair organizer in Poland, dedicated to meeting the evolving needs of modern businesses across various sectors. With a mission to foster innovation and collaboration, the company hosts a range of specialized events, including the ColdTech Poland, World of Build Expo, and LaserTechnica Poland, which attract thousands of participants and exhibitors from around the globe. Ptak Warsaw Expo aims to create valuable networking opportunities and facilitate knowledge sharing among industry leaders, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers. Its diverse clientele includes manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers from industries such as construction, refrigeration, and hospitality, all seeking to showcase their latest technologies and solutions. The company's vision is to enhance the international character of its events, promoting growth and development within the sectors it serves.

Name: Golden Club Cabanas
HQ Location: Portugal, Faro, De Tavira, Rua Tuberária Major Cabanas, 8800-591
Company description: Golden Club Cabanas is located on the waterfront, at the heart of the Nature Reserve of Ria Formosa, with magnificent views of the lagoon, close to the historic town of Tavira and to six golf courses, and 40 km away from the international airport of Faro. The resort provides three swimming pools, sauna, Turkish baths, Jacuzzi, exercise room, beach volleyball and multisport courts, boat to the beach, restaurant, bars, Children’s Club, sports and evening entertainment, and a low-rise aparthotel. Enjoy the comfort of low-rise holiday apartments with hotel service, in a protected area, facing a secluded sandy white beach. For more information, please visit our website: http://www.goldenclubcabanas.com/en/

Name: Hotel Opera Plaza
Company description: Situat în centrul istoric al oraşului, Opera Plaza îşi alimentează corpul arhitectonic cu vibraţiile Operei Române, aflată la doar câţiva paşi. Prin îmbinarea armonioasă dintre clasic şi modern, acest spaţiu este dincolo de dimensiunea temporală, adaptându-se perfect vârstei şi aşteptărilor tuturor celor care-i trec pragul. Linia caldă şi elegantă a hotelului se înscrie în atmosfera celei mai frumoase pieţe a oraşului vechi. Beneficiind de o tratare inovativă, hotelul oferă toate avantajele tehnologiei moderne clienţilor săi. Opera Plaza ofera o experienta unica prin personalizarea serviciilor si atentia individuala acordata fiecarui oaspete.

Name: Bank Hotel
Company description: Bank Hotel, located in the heart of Stockholm at Arsenalsgatan 6, is a luxurious destination that combines historic charm with modern elegance. As a proud member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World, the hotel aims to provide an exceptional experience for its guests, focusing on personalized service and high-quality amenities. The hotel's mission is to create memorable moments for visitors, whether they are enjoying a leisurely brunch at Bonnie’s or relaxing in the beautifully designed spaces. Catering primarily to discerning travelers and locals seeking a unique dining experience, Bank Hotel emphasizes sustainability and quality in all its offerings. With a commitment to excellence, the hotel serves as a premier choice for both business and leisure clients looking for a sophisticated stay in Stockholm.

Name: Artipelag
Company description: Artipelag is a unique venue outside Stockholm where art exhibitions, cultural activities, architecture, design and excellent food is combined with beautiful nature and stunning views.

Name: New Concept Travel - American Express GBT
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, Nr. 29 Str. Marcel Andreescu
Company description: Determinarea de a ne dezvolta permanent intr-un domeniu aflat in continua schimbare constitue premiza  pentru a continua sa ne consolidam pozitia de lider in corporate travel, prin performanta, inovatie si versatilitate.

Name: Ad Astra By Elite - Hotel Spa & Resort
Company description: Ad Astra by Elite is a distinguished hotel brand within the Elite Hotels group, offering a unique blend of historic charm and modern luxury. Located in prime city centers, such as Gothenburg, Ad Astra by Elite aims to provide guests with an exceptional experience characterized by high-quality service, elegant accommodations, and a commitment to sustainability, as evidenced by its Green Key ecolabel certification. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, tourists, and event organizers, providing tailored services for conferences, weddings, and special occasions. With a focus on comfort and guest satisfaction, Ad Astra by Elite partners with local businesses to enhance the overall experience, ensuring that every stay is memorable and enjoyable. The brand's mission is to create a welcoming atmosphere where guests can relax and feel at home while exploring the vibrant surroundings of their chosen location.

Name: Hotel Dom Henrique Downtown
HQ Location: Portugal, Porto, Porto, 223 Rua Do Bolhão, 4000-112
Company description: Um dos raros Hotéis independentes, com propriedade e gestão familiar há cerca de 48 anos e uma sólida tradição de bom serviço, localizado no centro tradicional do Porto junto da Rua Santa Catarina, a 300 metros da estação de Metro TRINDADE com ligação directa ao Aeroporto, próximo dos teatros, monumentos, da zona da Ribeira reconhecida pela UNESCO como Património Mundial, do cais de embarque dos Cruzeiros no Douro, das Caves de Vinho do Porto, e a 5 minutos da zona de animação nocturna da Galeria de Paris. Name: Ramundberget
Company description: Ramundberget, en utpost vid vägens ände och på gränsen till den orörda fjällvärlden. Alltsedan 1936 då de första gästerna knackade på dörren har fler och fler fattat tycke för Ramis. Idag är vi en etablerad liten skidort med ett mycket starkt varumärke och där bolaget äger och driver det mesta som man möts av som gäst. Själva litenheten är ett nyckelord som vi värnar om och behandlar med respekt även när vi planerar för det framtida Ramundberget. Hela vår verksamhet vilar på tre fundament: Naturen, Värdskapet och Historien. Naturen i form av att vid vägs ände förvalta och hantera den gåva i form av fjäll, vattendrag och mängden snö som gör skidåkningen möjlig från tidig höst till sen vår. Värdskapet som bottnar i Agaton & Britas sätt att ta hand om de allra första gästerna och där det alltid fanns plats för en till vid köksbordet. Få skidorter i Sverige har också en historia värd att berätta, i Ramundberget blev sagan sann och vi själva är en del av den, bära kulturarvet och dessutom utveckla det på ett varsamt är ett stort ansvar vi har tagit på oss. Ramundberget är ett äkta småskaligt alternativ till de som söker något bortom det massproducerade och lättkonsumerade. Självklart har vi höga ambitioner med våra parker, restaurangar, barnområden och konferens, men eftersom vi är en skidort som tänker lite annorlunda, sker all expansion utifrån våra fundament. Vi kommer nog aldrig att bli en ort för alla, men för allt fler verkar vi vara den enda skidort man kan tänka sig.  Stora som små Med nya moderna mötesrum tar vi nu emot grupper för stormöten, utbildningar, styrelsemöten, kick-off, fest och events.
