Name: Stora Brännbo Konferens & Hotell
Company description: Stora Brännbo is the perfect meeting place that lies in the heart of Sigtuna and offers a true Scandinavian atmosphere and welcome. Only 15 minutes from Stockholm Arlanda Airport Stora Brännbo is situated between Uppsala and Stockholm and provides the perfect location for meetings and conferences. And if holding an important meeting is your focus, Stora Brännbo is the place. We have created the prefect location for you and your colleagues to come together, whether it's in the formal setting in one of our well-equipped meeting rooms, more informally over a wonderful meal or even during a workout session in our gym and spa. Regardless of how you wish to meet we know you'll be inspired by our special environment, as our focus is always on helping you hold the perfect meeting. Stora Brännbo is labeled with the Nordic Ecolabel and is climate neutral and a member of Svenska Möten and Destination Sigtuna. Welcome to Stora Brännbo. When Meetings Count.

Name: Grupa Trip
Company description: Grupa Trip jest firmą z ponad dwudziestoletnim doświadczeniem w dziedzinie organizacji turystyki biznesowej. Specjalizujemy się w organizacji kongresów i konferencji, a także szkoleń i wyjazdów integracyjnych. Naszym atutem jest profesjonalny, zgrany zespół ekspertów z różnych dziedzin pomyślnie realizujący najbardziej wymagające projekty. Wspólnie planujemy, przygotowujemy kongresy, konferencje i szkolenia.

Name: Hotel Hotel
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, 22 Travessa Da Glória, 1250-118
Company description: SLEEP | EAT | CREATE | INDULGE O Hotel Hotel tem uma proposta irreverente para o centro de Lisboa, desconstruindo o formalismo dos hotéis convencionais. Um oásis urbano no centro da cidade, é um espaço plural feito de várias camadas, ambientes e sentidos que diminui, com paixão e criatividade, o fosso entre a natureza e o mundo civilizado.  A natureza inspira-nos. A arte liga-nos. No centro, as pessoas. As ligações e as surpresas.  As experiências que não se repetem nunca, porque se tecem sempre no aqui e agora. À volta de uma mesa, numa aula de yoga, numa conversa luminosa, ao som de uma boa música, forma-se uma comunidade. Somos o habitat natural dos viajantes excecionais.  Hotel Hotel has an irreverent proposal for the centre of Lisbon, deconstructing the formalism of conventional hotels. An urban oasis in the centre of the city, it is a plural space made of several layers, environments and senses that diminishes, with passion and creativity, the gap between nature and the civilized world.  Nature inspires us. Art connects us. With people at the centre. Connections and surprises. Unrepeatable experiences — because everything happens in the here and now. A community is born — at the table, in a yoga class, in a scintillating conversation, to the sound of good music. We are the natural habitat of exceptional travellers.

Name: Hotele SPA Dr Irena Eris
Company description: Z dala od miejskiego gwaru, w otoczeniu pięknej przyrody i malowniczych krajobrazów znajdą Państwo ukojenie dla swoich zmysłów i ciała. Pobyt w naszych Hotelach sprawi, że powrócą Państwo do codziennych zajęć pełni nowej energii i radości życia. Zapraszamy do naszych Hoteli SPA Dr Irena Eris! Każdy z Państwa jest u nas zawsze wyjątkowym Gościem. Far from the buzz of the city, surrounded by the beauty of nature and picturesque landscape, you can find a soothing balm for your body and senses. Dr Irena Eris SPA Hotels - Krynica Zdrój, Wzgórza Dylewskie and Polanica Zdrój - embody the idea of a spa based on a holistic approach to the human being and its beauty. They are an excellent place for those who wish to combine passive and active relaxation in luxurious conditions with rejuvenation in the SPA Centre and professional care at the Dr Irena Eris Skin Care Institute. Your stay in our Hotels will help you return to your daily activities with renewed energy and joy of life. Welcome to our Dr Irena Eris SPA Hotels! To us, every guest is always a very special guest.

Name: Sofitel Warsaw Victoria
Company description: Sofitel Warsaw Victoria is a distinguished hotel that is part of the Handwritten Collection, known for its uniquely stylish accommodations that reflect the warmth and personality of its hosts. The hotel aims to provide a genuinely human and bespoke experience, curating meaningful moments and amenities that foster interaction between guests and the dedicated staff, referred to as Heartists®. With a commitment to authentic charm and bespoke design, Sofitel Warsaw Victoria offers a blend of traditional and modern aesthetics, creating inviting spaces that embody the essence of stylish homes. The hotel primarily caters to discerning travelers seeking a luxurious and personalized stay, making it a preferred choice for both leisure and business clients. As part of the broader Accor group, Sofitel Warsaw Victoria benefits from a strong network of partners and a powerful booking platform, enhancing its appeal in the competitive hospitality market.

Name: Hotel Riverton AB
Company description: Hotel Riverton is an independant family owned and operated design hotel located by the waterfront in central Gothenburg. Only a few minutes away from the hotel are some of the main attractions of the city; the historic district Haga, popular shopping street Kungsgatan, the central station and the old fort Skansen Krona, making our location the perfect base to explore the city.  We offer modern rooms and suites that provide everything to ensure your stay in Gothenburg is more than comfortable. For longer stays, we offer 6 full-service apartments. The hotel offers a brand-new Spa, Serenity Spa located on the ground floor. Immerse yourself in our inviting indoor pool, enjoy your experience showers and saunas, or relax at your own pace in our Spa Lounge. All our guests are most welcome to add access to their room key against a fee. Meeting and Events at Hotel Riverton are always tailored and personalised to the need of our clients. Whether you need to hire a room for a meeting or exhibition, we have the capacity and the flexibility to accommodate your needs. With 18 conference and meeting rooms, there is a room for any size event and our on-site Conference coordinators are on hand to guide you through your event – from inquiry through to your event going live and beyond. Within the hotel, there are two restaurants, one skybar and one lobby bar, including View Skybar & Restaurant which is home to spectacular panoramic views across the Gothenburg harbour. We may be partial, but it really is the best view in the city! We also offer Restaurant ONE on the first floor and a lobby bar, The Livingroom with tasty drinks and lighter food on the ground floor.  So, whether you are visiting Gothenburg for business or exploring one of the many attractions Gothenburg has to offer; the facilities and team at Hotel Riverton aim to give all our guests a relaxed and valuable stay.

Name: Marholmen
Company description: Välkommen till Marholmen, en plats för vila, möten och upplevelser i Roslagens skärgård, cirka en timmes bilfärd nordost om Stockholm. Här hittar du hotellrum, stugor, villor, spa, konferens, restaurang, glampingtält, ställplatser och en mängd aktiviteter för alla åldrar.

Company description: Stylt is an award-winning concept development, interior architecture, design and marketing company based in Gothenburg, Sweden, and specialised in the hospitality industry. Stylt has been creating creative and commercial experiences for the hospitality industry for over 20 years, developing over 400 restaurants and around 250 hotels.  We create inspiring businesses noted for their longevity, profitability and brand-building power.  Read more at www.stylt.se or give us a call on +46 (0)31-708 68 00.

Name: Students Nobel NightCap
Company description: Students' Nobel NightCap is the final festivity of the Nobel week, held on the 10th of December in Stockholm after the Nobel Banquet. The event provides a relaxed atmosphere where students, Nobel Laureates, academics, politicians and business people mingle and enjoy themselves. Students' Nobel NightCap has grown tremendously over the recent years and today it is a project that has a turnover of well over a million SEK. It relies heavily on both a tight connection with the Swedish business community, but most importantly, a lot of dedication from the student associations that alternate as hosts, THS at the Royal Institute of Technology, SUS at Stockholm University, MF at Karolinska Institutet and SASSE at Stockholm School of Economics. This year the party is hosted by Alhuset at Stockholm University, making its grand comeback since the party was last hosted here in 2019. We can ensure that it will be an unforgettable night!

Name: HOTEL IAKI
Company description: Așezat în centrul stațiunii Mamaia, fostul Hotel București a fost cumpărat în anul 1999 de către marele fotbalist român Gheorghe Hagi.  În urma unui amplu proces de renovare, hotelul a fost ridicat la standarde înalte, de patru stele. Name: Vale D'Oliveiras Quinta Resort & Spa
Company description: Vale d'Oliveiras Quinta Resort & Spa is an elegant 5 star resort conveniently located between Carvoeiro and Ferragudo, in the Algarve. This hidden paradise is just a few minutes drive from some of the finest beaches and golf courses in Europe. It is an all year round destination, ideal for family holidays, golf breaks and group travel.  The resort comprises 22 rooms, 2 suites and 80 apartments as well as a large choice of leisure and wellbeing facilities, a restaurant and two bars.

Company description: Desenvolvido através de um conceito de excelência que utiliza uma arquitectura contemporânea integrada na vegetação, que a adoça e valoriza, sendo estes os aspectos centrais da estratégia de design. 23 Mestres de Arquitectura Contemporânea, uniram-se aos paisagistas, para num mesmo território ir de encontro as especificidades de cada área envolvente e criar o Bom Sucesso.

Name: Verdelago Resort
Company description: Located between Praia Verde and Altura, in Algarve, Verdelago Resort has an area of over 80 hectares where buildings occupy only 8.7%. With direct access to the beach and in full harmony with nature, the resort has several support infrastructures and a wide range of services and amenities in line with a healthy, holistic lifestyle, where nature takes center stage. Here everything is full. Of senses. Of experiences. Of well-being.  Already this summer, the Verdelago Resort will have, besides the approximately 50 tourist-residential units available for rent, a Wellness Dome, a complex with several multi-sports fields (2 tennis, 4 paddle tennis, 1 soccer, 1 sand court for volleyball, and beach soccer), a BMX/BTB pumptrack, several walking and cycling paths of about 7 km among cork and pine trees, temporary ponds and a lagoon, family support services (Kids Club and babysitting), a swimming pool in the central area of the resort. In the future, it will also have an orchard and vegetable garden with local products and a riding arena with horses for rides inside the resort. Verdelago Resort is also the first tourist resort in the country to join the Green Globe certification, one of the most demanding international sustainable tourism certifications, with affiliation to the United Nations Tourism Organization. In the cruise year, it will have 340 tourist residential units and a 197-room five-star hotel. Find out how to book your stay or purchase one of the magnificent properties at www.verdelago.com

With Almaria apartments, we provide our guests with an alternative to the usual hotel accomodation for guests who wish to spend vacations within short- or medium-term stays along with the unique opportunity to re-inhabit the remarkable history of soulful buildings in the city's center.

Somos uma unidade hoteleira de excelência, reconhecida a nível nacional, situada no coração da cidade do Porto, na Avenida da Boavista. Destina-se a famílias, negócios e lazer. Company description: In the heart of Porto, the G.A Palace Hotel stands as a serene oasis. Nestled upon the historic walls of an ancient XIXth-Century Portuguese village, this extraordinary establishment was conceived with a captivating vision that intertwines Italian and Portuguese influences, delivering a truly distinctive hospitality encounter. Offering 65 opulent rooms, a cutting-edge heated pool with contemporary design that seamlessly extends from the spa to the open air, a dining establishment that harmoniously unites the finest Italian and Portuguese culinary traditions, an inviting lounge, and a 5-star team, the Palace is dedicated to providing the epitome of excellence in the vibrant city of Porto.

Name: Hotel Saski Krakow Curio Collection By Hilton
Company description: Hotel Saski Krakow is the most iconic hotel in the city, with a history spanning over 200 years. Originally a place for a monastery and church, the first hotel has been established and later on extended to its current capacity in 1818. Famous composers such as Franz Liszt and Johannes Brahms performed here back in the days and attracted a wide audience. Today the exact same breath-taking ballroom has been restored with the original wall frescos. Located right at the main square, the building means a lot to the locals and is the perfect place to discover the historical city in a truly authentic way. A place to experience, not just to stay in.

Name: Alma
Company description: Alma is a members’ club and private workspace.  Founded to provide intellectual and social nourishment to our members, Alma offers a place to work, meet, dine and socialize, and provide access to reciprocal member clubs around the world. Recognizing the growing need for new forms of workspace and collaborative environments, Alma opened its doors on Nybrogatan 8 in Stockholm in 2017. A space for work and play, Alma was founded for the sole purpose of nurturing people and their ideas. Designed to meet the working needs of entrepreneurs, teams and individuals, predominantly in innovative and creative industries. The building, which for many years was home to Beckman’s School of Design, has been reimagined together with a group of architects and designers who have created furniture and products specifically for the house. The five-story structure has a mindful balance of work and social spaces, including dedicated work areas, rooms for meetings and collaboration, a state of the art music studio, an outdoor terrace, a bar and communal and private dining spaces. The restaurant, overseen by chefs Gordon Grimlund serves meals exclusively for members and their guests. A rich cultural program provides members and the creative community with talks, exhibits, entertainment, parties, and opportunity for collaboration. Integrating architecture, product design, and art, with cultural programming and services, Alma was created by the very people it caters to. Being a private community, Alma is made up of entrepreneurs, teams, and individuals working in technology, design, venture investing, architecture, film, fashion, branding, music, art and media. We offer five types of membership: Open, Dedicated, Studios, Private Office and Out-of-Town.

Name: Bofors Hotel
Company description: Bofors Hotel är det tredje hotellet i AB Bofors historia, och byggdes 1930 för att imponera på internationella kunder. Helt anpassat för viktiga möten. Representation på högsta nivå. Affärer där mycket står på spel och inget får gå fel. Under det första halvseklet var Bofors Hotel en intern angelägenhet, uteslutande tillägnad företagets gäster och högsta ledning. Förutsättningarna för hotellet har förändrats genom tiderna. Här har funnits egen tvätt, florist, en stor stab av servis och kökspersonal. Under en period hade man ingen meny vid de viktiga middagarna, utan gästerna beställde det de ville ha och kocken och den månghövdade kökspersonalen stod redo att lösa önskemålen. Under 1990-talet öppnades det välbevarade hotellet äntligen upp för företag och privatpersoner. Och för många har det blivit ett självklart val när de befinner sig i regionen. Det är idag Karlskogas (och sannolikt regionens) internationella mötesplats. Hotellet som går i italiensk villastil är ritat av arkitekt Wilhelm van Eyck, som även inspirerats av art déco och tidig funkis. Från 2007 har hela hotellet renoverats varsamt i enlighet med arkitektens ursprungliga intentioner. Ett lyckat möte mellan 1930-tal och 2010-tal. Idag är Bofors Hotel en oas som förenar svunna tider i de storslagna, men hemtrevliga, salongerna och det moderna Karlskoga med framtidens visioner.  Varmt välkommen!

Located on Madeira’s beautiful south coast, in the lively Lido area of Funchal, our hotels feature multiple swimming pools, tennis courts, rooftop spaces with stunning views, coworking facilities, diverse dining options, and even a disco space for entertainment. Surrounded by restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and local attractions, we provide everything our guests need for an unforgettable experience. Discover the perfect combination of comfort, amenities, and Madeira’s unique charm with Dorisol Hotels.

Name: Blekingska Nationen
Company description: Blekingska nationen är en av 13 studentnationer vid Lunds universitet. Nationen har sina lokaler och studentbostadshus hos Stiftelsen Herulero i Lund på Måsvägen i Lund, där cirka 100 av nationens medlemmar bor i både korridor och lägenheter. I direkt anslutning till nationen ligger studentbostadsområdet Vildanden. Nationen är allmänt känd som Lunds främsta musiknation framförallt tack vare deras koncept Klubb Indigo i kombination med satsningar på musikfestivaler och temaklubbar.

Company description: Vi kan möten, fest och event. Vi ser till att alla dina möten och event överträffar dina förväntningar. Berätta för oss om ert syfte, tid och vilka som deltar så skräddarsyr vi de bästa förutsättningarna för en lyckad konferens. Det är något speciellt med Såstaholm. Kanske sitter det i rummen, eller det vackra läget vid vattnet. Kanske är det restaurangen med dess excellenta service. Det skulle också kunna vara vårt rogivande läge på landet men ändå så nära Stockholm och Arlanda. En sak vet vi säkert, våra gäster återkommer tack vare vår personliga service. Name: Wave Międzyzdroje Resort&SPA
HQ Location: Poland, West Pomerania, Miedzyzdroje, 70 Gryfa Pomorskiego, 72-500
Company description: Inwestycja Wave Międzyzdroje Resort & SPA obejmuje pięć budynków apartamentowych o niezwykle bogatej infrastrukturze. Położone w pierwszej linii brzegowej pozwalają na korzystanie ze wszystkich atrakcji jakie oferuje bezpośredni dostęp do Zatoki Pomorskiej. Architektura Wave Międzyzdroje Resort & SPA inspirowana jest miejscem, w którym realizowana jest inwestycja - nadmorskim brzegiem, wiatrem i falami Bałtyku. Spiralny kształt każdego z budynków powoduje, że większość mieszkańców ma zapewniony widok na morze, może cieszyć się całorocznym nasłonecznieniem i spektakularnymi zachodami słońca. Projekt wyróżnia przeszklona fasada z panoramicznymi oknami i przeźroczyste balustrady tarasów i balkonów. Bezpośrednie sąsiedztwo szerokich, piaszczystych plaż i wydm zapewnia codzienny kontakt z naturą. Część apartamentów kupowana jest w celach inwestycyjnych i zarządzana przez dedykowanego operatora zajmującego się wynajmem, a pozostała część nabywana jest na użytek prywatny. Powierzchnie apartamentów wynoszą od 27. do 113. mkw. Kolejnym atutem jest dostęp do funkcji sportowo-rekreacyjnych dla najbardziej wymagających: dwóch basenów (wewnętrznego oraz całorocznego zewnętrznego, podgrzewanego), dwóch jacuzzi (wewnętrznego i zewnętrznego), strefy Wellness & SPA, brodzika dla dzieci, siłowni, pokoju zabaw dla dzieci, restauracji i kawiarni, terenów zielonych i placu zabaw. Szeroka promenada wzdłuż sosen prowadzi do centrum Międzyzdrojów, gdzie mieści się m.in. Oceanarium. Zaletą jest również usytuowanie kompleksu w sąsiedztwie Wolińskiego Parku Narodowego. Unikatowy projekt autorstwa pracowni MODO Architektura dla inwestora Green House Development otrzymał prestiżową European Property Awards 2022/23 w kategorii: Architecture Multiple Residence.

Name: Grand Hotel I Lund
Company description: På ett modernt hotell gör nattgästerna mer än att bara sova och äta. Och gästerna är mer än bara nattgäster. Så tänkte man när Grand öppnade 1899 och så tänker vi idag. Grand är ett hotell med själ. Den sitter i väggar, golv och tak - bevarad genom den historiska byggnadens alla renoveringar. Och i doften av god mat, klirret av glas, sorlet och många möten... Arkitekten bakom Grand hette Alfred Hellerström. Han gav hotellet dess karakteristiska yttre, med fransk slottarkitektur från renässansen som förebild. Interiörer som lobbyn, trapphuset och Stora Salen präglas av jugend. Genom åren har kända krögare som Gunnar Ek, Sven Holger Fogelklou och Frank Svensson drivit Grand. 1981-1990 drev bröderna Urban och Leif Paulsson Grand, den senare ända till 2005 tillsammans med hustrun Ann-Christin. Idag leder deras dotter Maria Paulsson Rickle familjeföretaget som även omfattar Hotel Lundia och Hotel Finn

Name: DoubleTree By Hilton Lodz
Company description: Przy ul. Łąkowej 29, gdzie obecnie mieści się DoubleTree by Hilton Łódź****, niegdyś powstawały perły polskiej kinematografii. Spuścizna Wytwórni Filmów Fabularnych definiuje unikalny charakter obiektu i pozwala na realizację najbardziej wymagających wydarzeń i produkcji. Przestrzenie, których próżno szukać w innych hotelach i obiektach konferencyjnych to dawne hale WFF. W swoim nowym życiu zyskały wystawienniczo-kongresowy charakter, a dzięki wyjątkowej konstrukcji dają niemal nieograniczone możliwości aranżacji. Nietuzinkowym miejscem jest także zrewitalizowana sala kinowa umożliwiająca projekcje 3D. Ofertę uzupełnia unikalna sala balowa, boardroom i 9 sal konferencyjnych z dostępem do światła dziennego. Hotel był wielokrotnie doceniany w ogólnopolskich i międzynarodowych plebiscytach zarówno w kategorii event venue oraz jako obiekt wyróżniający się najwyższym poziomem świadczonych usług. Zapraszamy w podróż do miejsca przesiąkniętego duszą polskiego kina. The exceptional atmosphere of the venue is inspired by its film history. The renowned Łódź Feature Film Studios operated here and Lakowa Street was a well-known address. The legacy of Łódź FFS defines the unique character of the facility and allows to organize the most demanding events and productions. Spaces that cannot be found in other hotels and conference venues are the former halls of the Feature Film Studios. In their new life, they gained an exhibition and congress character and hanks to their unique structure, they offer almost unlimited ways of arrangement. A remarkable place in the hotel is also a revitalized cinema hall, that enables 3D projections,. The offer is completed by a unique ballroom, a boardroom and 9 conference rooms with access to daylight. Hotel has been repeatedly appreciated in national and international plebiscites, both in the category of event venue and a facility with the highest level of services. Join us on a journey in a place filled with the spirit of Polish cinematography.

Name: Herdade Da Matinha
Company description: VEM TRABALHAR CONNOSCO A Herdade da Matinha é um lugar de conexão com a Natureza, com as pessoas e connosco próprios. Buscamos excelência na felicidade das pequenas coisas e da simplicidade dos momentos. O SONHO Construímos uma cultura de Work-Life Balance. Work Hard. Play Hard. Podem parecer clichês, mas aqui a vida quer-se mesmo assim. Tanto gostamos de preparar uma mesa bonita, como de servir um bom vinho enquanto deixamos escapar dicas de praias e cenários secretos que descobrimos esta tarde. Cuidamos dos hóspedes ao pequeno-almoço, mas quando o turno acaba caminhamos por trilhos, vamos até ao mar surfar ou passear os cães. A nossa equipa está a crescer. Procuramos pessoas com sede de viver rodeados de natureza, e que gostem de receber tão bem como nós. Espalhem a palavra ao vento e aos amigos. OS NOSSOS VALORES SIMPLICIDADE: Promovemos a autenticidade e a simplicidade de uma vida no campo.  PAZ: Favorecemos o reencontro com a Natureza para cuidar do corpo e da mente e desafiamo-nos a reinventar o luxo de braços dados com a Natureza, através de um serviço simples e familiar, mas único e exemplar. AMOR: Ouvimos e conhecemos os nossos hóspedes, aproximando-nos e cuidando deles, personalizando a sua experiência e trazendo-os para dentro da nossa casa. RESPEITO: Colocamos as pessoas no centro de tudo. Envolvemos, respeitamos e valorizamos as nossas pessoas - a nossa equipa, os nossos parceiros e fornecedores. Ajudando-os a evoluir no seu percurso profissional, estamos a contribuir para melhorar a experiência oferecida aos nossos hóspedes. A NOSSA PROMESSA Estamos empenhados em minimizar o nosso impacto ambiental ao integrar nas nossas rotinas operacionais medidas de sequestro de carbono. Focamo-nos numa cozinha farm-to-table / nature-to-table e preparamos os próximos passos para continuar a agir na preservação da floresta autóctone e na proteção das espécies de fauna e flora que nos rodeiam.

Hos oss får du lov att stanna upp och pausa i en tid som präglas av ständig rörelse och informationsbrus, vårt Andrum Spa och Frihetens kapell erbjuder en plats för lugn och återhämtning. Håll utkik på våra sociala medier för kommande event som t ex Historisk AW en gång/månaden och Akademihotellets Trapphusgalleri med en ny utställning och vernissage en gång/månad.  FRAMTID Clasonska gården, Akademihotellet med guldkant, öppnar senhösten 2025. På Övre Slottsgatan 1, intill Akademihotellet, byggs nu den anrika fastigheten Clasonska gården varsamt om till ny hotelldel under Akademihotellet med 13 individuellt utformade hotellrum. Alla de tidsepoker som huset har genomlevt, från 1700-tal och framåt, finns representerade i husets interiör och som hotellgäst kommer du att bli inbjuden att få följa med på en tidsresa inspirerad av husets respektive århundrande - här finns det Rum med historia. Välkommen till Akademihotellet och känn historiens vingslag!

Name: Bomans Hotell Trosa
Company description: Den 1 juni 1988 tog min familj över dåvarande Strömsborg och döpte om det till familjenamnet Boman. Vår intention har alltid varit att Bomans ska vara en oas för gäster av alla de slag.   Jag är passionerat förälskad i Bomans och det tror jag alla våra gäster märker. Rysch och pysch göra sig icke besvär på dagens Bomans, Laura Ashley är ett minne blott… Med min stigande ålder ökar inslaget av djurprint, provocerande fotografier, konstböcker och inte minst mängden skor (Manolos, Louboutins, Guccis, Dolce Gabbanas) som gästerna lånar till middagen. Min stora rädsla som också driver mig, är att Bomans ska bli ett insomnat landsortshotell med chintzgardiner och Chesterfieldsoffor. På sommaren kan man ofta hitta mig på balkongen utanför festvåningen stirrandes ut mot Bomans prunkande trädgård med alla sköna loungemöbler. Gästerna ligger och slöar i möblerna, utebaren är öppen, musiken ljuder i trädgårdshögtalarna, fåglarna kvittrar. Alla njuter, inte minst jag. Ibland får jag nypa mig själv när jag tänker är det här verkligen mitt? Har jag varit med och skapat allt detta? Hur ska jag någonsin kunna sälja det? Jag älskar Bomans … när rabatterna får liv och allt börjar växa…då dyker Johan, vår antroposofiske trädgårdsmästare upp och tittar över rabatter och häckar. Han beskriver mycket poetiskt hur vi ska få hela trädgården att blomstra och hur blommorna ska må som bäst. Tror att han har samma syn på blommor och träd som jag har på Bomans.  Nästan mänskliga egenskaper alltså. Lite knäppt… En viktig inspirationskälla för mig är hotell och restauranger världen över. Oriental Hotel i Bangkok, Nobu i Cape Town, L´Hôtel i Paris, Chez l’Ami Louis i Paris, Le Yacca i St Tropez… listan kan göras hur lång som helst. Idéer, känslor, musik, matinspiration, udda saker får åka med mig hem till Bomans. Välkommen hit! Kristin

Thanks to its undulating roof inclined towards the Vistula River, the form of the building was often compared to a melting ice block. The façade is finished with a mosaic from ceramic tiles in white and red, like the Polish flag, and in various shades of grey. The structure is closed by a glass façade with titanium and zinc elements.  Thanks to the effect achieved by the designers (the architecture studio Ingarden & Ewý Architekci, in cooperation with Arata Isozaki & Associates), the Centre smoothly blends with the panorama of the Vistula boulevards and of the city of Krakow as a whole.  The ICE Kraków has a conference space of more than 36 000 m² – the largest Auditorium Hall can accommodate around 2000 people. The Centre’s guests are also offered the Theatre Hall (600 places), the Chamber Hall (300 places or 2x150 places) as well as a complex of conference rooms of a total floor area of 500 m², which can be separated into smaller spaces via a system of acoustic rooms.  In addition, the ICE Kraków has 32 multifunctional meeting rooms and a three-tier foyer overlooking Wawel Castle and offering a panoramic view of Krakow. This area is perfectly suited for the function of an exhibition space. A two-level underground car park can accommodate 335 cars. ICE Kraków is the city’s new business flagship project, attracting, first of all, the MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions) industry. In view of its potential use as a venue for almost every type of event at the ICE Kraków, the Centre enjoys huge interest.

Przedsiębiorstwo budowlane PB Górski wykupiło Leśny Dwór w 2015 roku z zamiarem utworzenia tutaj eleganckiego obiektu noclegowego na bazie zespołu pałacowo-dworskiego.  Po prestiżowym Hotelu Quadrille Relais & Châteaux w Gdyni przyszedł czas na kolejne miejsce z duszą, otoczone naturą, będące oazą spokoju i wytchnienia. Lokalizacja w samym centrum tzw. Szwajcarii Kaszubskiej, w pięknych okolicznościach przyrody sprawia, iż jest to idealna przestrzeń na zorganizowanie niebanalnej ceremonii zaślubin czy też wspaniałego przyjęcia weselnego – w malowniczej scenerii i z dodatkowymi atrakcjami na łonie natury. Greve Gösta Posse, en av initiativtagarna till järnvägens etablering på Falbygden, undersökte traktens möjligheter för en lokalisering av en vattenkurort och Mösseberg valdes då vattnet visade sig vara “särdeles ymnigt” i S:t Eriks källa. Vattnet kunde lätt pumpas upp och komma en kurbadinrättning till godo. Även om många av Mössebergs Kurorts forna, celebra besökare idag har gått ur tiden – går arvet vidare. Med det hälsobringande vattenflödet som ett fortsatt bärande tema är Kurorten Mösseberg tillbaka vid sina källor, sitt ursprung. “Sällskapslivet vid Mösseberg bär prägeln af ett lugnt och stilla kurortslif, där inga hälsoskakande nöjen störa kurgästerna, men där dock rikliga tillfällen till förströelse finns.” Varmt välkomna till Mössebergs Kurort.

Name: Qvanti
Company description: Merparten av inköpen till hotell och restaurang sker idag genom volymavtal på ett antal utvalda produkter (sk anbudsprislistor) i syfte att ge en låg och kontrollerbar kostnadsbild. När produkter köps in utanför dessa avtal blir prisbilden i de flesta fall betydligt högre. Historiskt har vi sett stor potential för att spara betydande belopp genom att noggrant analysera samtliga inköp och beteendet runt dessa. De flesta verksamheter använder sig av ett stort antal leverantörer, vilket gör att det är svårt att överblicka helheten. Ju fler leverantörer som används desto viktigare blir det att få en överskådlig och greppbar helhet för samtliga inblandade. Genom Qvanti samlas alla leverantörer i ett systemverktyg tillsammans med ingångna avtal och inköpsförutsättningar, utlovade volymer samt bonusar. Därefter analyseras inköpen för att se vad som köps i och utanför avtal. I processen tar Qvanti då hänsyn till kvalitetskrav, leveranssäkerhet samt att det är rätt produkter som inhandlas. Därefter skapas åtgärdsplaner som redovisar artiklar som bör undvikas, felaktiga inköp, artiklar som bör bytas mot lämpligare alternativ och vilken besparingspotential som finns. Efter åtgärder sker löpande mätning, rapportering och uppföljning. Detta leder fram till en löpande rapport som visar exakt hur mycket Ni sparat. För maximal effekt följer Qvanti upp åtgärdsplanen mot den interna organisationen eller genomför listan i samråd med er.

Name: Convento Do Espinheiro Historic Hotel & Spa - Évora
Company description: A origem do Convento do Espinheiro está ligada a uma lenda que relata a aparição de uma imagem da Virgem sobre um espinheiro, por volta de 1400. Em 1412 foi mandada edificar uma ermida em honra de Nossa Senhora e dada a crescente importância deste local como ponto de peregrinação, no ano de 1458, durante o reinado de D. Afonso V, foi fundada a igreja e posteriormente o convento, o qual foi povoado... por monges da Ordem de S. Jerónimo. Recebia frequentemente este Convento a visita dos nossos reis, sobretudo os da Dinastia de Avis que tinham uma grande devoção à Virgem, tais como D. João II (que aqui realizou as cortes em 1481), D. Manuel I, D. Afonso V e D. Sebastião, que, quando em Évora, aqui se hospedava a convite dos monges. A 3 de Junho de 2005, após 3 anos de obras, o Convento do Espinheiro, Heritage Hotel & Spa, um dos dois hotéis Luxury Collection em Portugal, foi inaugurado em todo o seu esplendor. Situado a 2kms da cidade de Évora, o hotel está rodeado de 8 hectares de magníficos jardins e o seu interior foi luxuosamente decorado, mantendo no entanto o seu carácter. O convento em si dispõe de 17 quartos e 6 suites, enquanto que a ala nova dispõe de 36 quartos com vista para a piscina ou jardim interior. A partir de Setembro de 2008, foram inaugurados mais 33 quartos, oferecendo uma decoração mais contemporânea e totalizando assim 92 quartos.

Name: Bela Vista Hotel & Spa - Relais & Châteaux
Company description: The Bela Vista Hotel is an intimate and luxurious hotel as well as an historical property - an authentic experience in the Algarve, a Portuguese dream; a true boutique hotel situated right on the amazing beach of Praia da Rocha. A warm place combining luxurious, modern comfort with traditional standards of hospitality, where hotel guests feel welcomed and valued.  The building which houses the Bela Vista Hotel has belonged to a Portuguese family since the 19th century. The property used to be a small hotel of just 15 rooms which opened in 1934 on Praia da Rocha's famous beach.  Today the owner has decided to relaunch it, combining the old ambiance of 77 years of traditional hospitality where hotel guests feel at home with the best of luxury and modern comforts. The renovation of the hotel has been directed by Graça Viterbo, one Portugal's leading interior design firms with extensive experience in the independent luxury hotel sector. Graca Viterbo value interiors in terms of light, space, texture, culture and memory. Deployed on the cliffs of Praia da Rocha, some say it was the first hotel in the Algarve. Having hosted distinguished personalities, still has in its guest books, registration of signatures and comments from Sidónio Pais, the King of Italy Umberto di Savoia, Fulgâncio Baptista, among others. Combines refinement with hospitality in a historical space, perfectly adapted to the most modern requirements. With a stunning and awe-inspiring view of Praia da Rocha, the Bela Vista Hotel is within walking distance of the most prestigious Algarve Golf Clubs; Marina of Portimão, and no more than 10 kilometers from the Algarve International Circuit. A restaurant with a chef of excellence and a terrace overlooking the sea, two bars, private beach access, the inviting outdoor swimming pool, private parking, and a SPA signed by L'OCCITANE - unique in Portugal - turn this Hotel in a memorable and unexampled spot throughout the Algarve.

W naszym hotelu oferujemy eleganckie i przytulne pokoje, które zapewnią idealne warunki do wypoczynku i relaksu. Każdy z naszych pokoi został zaprojektowany z myślą o wygodzie i funkcjonalności, łącząc nowoczesny design z domową atmosferą. Zapraszamy do naszej wyjątkowej strefy basenowej i SPA, gdzie luksus spotyka się z harmonią i spokojem. To idealne miejsce na rodzinne obiady, romantyczne kolacje oraz spotkania biznesowe przy wyśmienitych daniach. Name: Silent Living
Company description: All of our houses started as our family’s homes, and they’re now open to whoever wants to experience them. They are part of our story and echo the importance of feeling at home. Along the way, we realized that we are not alone in the search for happiness and fulfilment, and thus it felt right to share our values and visions with everyone else - one house at a time.  By taking the time to hear each of our guests’ experiences, we found our own direction and path to realize our vision. Through our visitors’ empirical reflections, we finally understand the necessary ingredients to pursue Silent Living: Home, Memory, Local, Simplicity, Family, Nature, Material, Atmosphere. Santa Clara 1728  (6 suites) Like in all the houses, the renovation was carried out under the guidance of our good friend Manuel Aires Mateus. Not only to ensure we respected the original heritage of the 18th-century building but to also help add serenity and comfort through the purity that defines his type of architecture.  Ceia - Restaurant We want to offer you a long-standing memory of joy, comfort and friendship, where we can share our own memories and stories with you, through our food. The dinner takes place around one shared table, which sits fourteen guests. The farm elevates nature’s most precious elements. Casas na Areia  (House - 4 bedrooms) The thatched walls and the sand floor revive the memory of the old fishermen's houses, while the minimalism of contemporary architecture highlights the space's simplicity.   Cabanas no Rio  (Hut - 1 bedroom) We have made cabanas no rio free from all superfluous objects, thus strengthening the feeling of being part of something larger than the challenges of everyday life. O nosso objectivo O principal objectivo do grupo Alojamento Local Esclarecimentos  é unir uma massa crítica que fale a uma só voz, enfatizando a partilha e colaboração como a força motriz por trás de uma actividade  socialmente sustentável. Somos um grupo independente mas, pretendemos colaborar e explorar sinergias com as várias associações que promovem e defendem o alojamento local e todas as entidades interessadas em trabalhar em conjunto para estabelecer as condições necessárias à criação de um ambiente favorável para que este tipo de alojamento se torne um sucesso para o país, para os operadores, para os turistas que nos visitam e para as comunidades locais. O nosso objectivo é criar e promover parcerias ao longo de toda a cadeia de valor do alojamento local e da economia de partilha, através da entreajuda de quem opera no e para o alojamento local, da promoção do diálogo com as associações do alojamento e restantes entidades da economia de partilha. Com foco em encontrar soluções para questões operacionais e exemplos de boas práticas, a missão do grupo é ajudar o alojamento local a tornar-se uma alternativa de alojamento de pleno direito. A nossa mensagem é simples: queremos um quadro para o alojamento local e para a economia de partilha a prosperar. Actividades e Proposta de Valor No grupo Alojamento Local Esclarecimentos ajudamos quem está no alojamento local a entender e aproveitar o potencial deste tipo de alojamento, através da disponibilização de informação e promoção da partilha e entreajuda, tendo como ponto de partida a crença de que juntos somos melhores.

Name: Hotel Quadrille Relais & Châteaux
Company description: Feel invited to the Wonderland, that is Quadrille conference & spa, a palace and a park complex located in Gdynia, Poland. A place where you can relax, delight in delicious cuisine and fill your lungs with iodine. Its interior is inspired by Alice in Wonderland and, apart from professional services and excellent cuisine, nothing is taken seriously here. Looking at its décor, you will immediately think of Alice’s craziest adventures. A chequered pattern on the floor, on the wall lamps bending over towards the guests, card symbols instead of standard door numeration and white rabbits jumping out of lamps-hats in the restaurant. And still it is very tasteful and very impressive.  There are little surprises awaiting you the moment you cross the threshold. Even though the décor is extraordinary  and very original, the interior designer definitely placed a bet on quality. Each and every detail was thought out perfectly and selected in such a way as to create a coherent whole with the remaining elements. You will also be surprised with Bialy Krolik Restaurant (White Rabbit Restaurant). It has just been awarded with two hats in a prestigious Yellow Guide by Gault&Millau. Its love for the culinary traditions of the Pomeranian region is combined here with the highest quality of the food it serves. The culinary concept of the place was created by Marcin Popielarz, a young, talented head chef who gained his culinary experience in western restaurants with Michelin stars. Diz a História que o Mosteiro de Santa Maria da Vitória foi construído a mando de D. Destes, o gótico e o manuelino foram os mais expressivos. Esta obra — classificada como Património da Humanidade em 1985 e eleita uma das Sete Maravilhas de Portugal em 2007 — permanece incompleta até aos nossos dias, como o comprovam as Capelas Imperfeitas, a céu aberto, deste monumento incontornável da nossa História.

În detaliu. În desene, marmura din băi, oglinzi sau ergonomie. Confirmările însă au venit mult mai târziu. Când noi ne-am mutat de tot la Archia. Când am trecut de încrâncenarea celui care contruieşte. Când am înţeles lecţia. Când locul ne-a atras. Camera macilor, a florilor de câmp, a cailor şi a echitaţiei, a florilor de soare şi a frunzelor, a levănţicăi şi a hulubăriei, a vânătoarei şi a specificului românesc, a iazului şi a păpădiei. Blazon din natură. Mansarda, spiritul boierului contemporan! Domeniul, extensia boierului contemporan! Domeniul a ajuns la 10 hectare. Manejul, grajdurile, piscina, pavilioanele pentru nunţi, şpaiţul, wifi, parcare inclusă. Cu deschidere spre orice loc frumos din Transilvania. Cada detalhe foi pensado para proporcionar uma estadia diferenciada, combinando charme, funcionalidade e um toque especial que torna cada estadia memorável. Hoje, olhamos para o Sirius Park com orgulho pelo percurso que desenhámos e com entusiasmo pelo futuro que queremos construir. A nossa missão continua a ser proporcionar experiências autênticas e inesquecíveis em harmonia com a natureza, mantendo sempre a paixão e o compromisso com a qualidade. O Sirius Park é mais do que um espaço – é um projeto vivo, em constante evolução, onde cada detalhe é pensado para que os nossos clientes se sintam parte de algo especial.

For one year, Frederic stayed in the hollowed out ruins of the former noble home in order to fully comprehend the construction and landscape of the property. Holes in the ceilings, devoid of windows and doors, the project gradually began to take a life of its own. Which made full use of the holes in the roof and rain catching buckets to create a truly memorable scene.  Facing countless obstacles and seemingly insurmountable challenges, including an earthquake that nearly destroyed several years of work. the Palacio was finally complete and the iconic large red doors were opened to the public in the year 2000. Much more than a hotel, the Palacio is a guesthouse and sanctuary for the creative and inquisitive. A place to find peace within oneself while comwithin the history of our magnificent city. High above the historic district of Alfama, Palacio Belmonte lies just beneath the famous Sao Jorge Castelo. For over 2000 years, Palacio Belmonte has shared a history with the castelo and has  witnessed many of the most pivotal events of Lisbon’s storied past.  360 windows and 360º views, each view is a lense on the old world. Within our walls you’ll discover tranquil terraces, natural gardens, and peaceful patios. We welcome you to unlock your own experience; timeless, unforgettable and entirely your own.

Najmłodsi mogą dodatkowo skorzystać z wielu atrakcji na basenie, chociażby wziąć udział w lekcjach pływania czy zajęciach wodnego aerobiku. SPA & WELLNESS Hotel Wieniawa to również bogata infrastruktura SPA & WELLNESS. Duży wybór zabiegów pielęgnacyjnych przeznaczonych dla ciała i urody, zapewni niesamowity relaks i pomoże chociaż na moment zapomnieć o codziennych problemach i stresach. Sale konferencyjne nad morzem   Hotel Wieniawa jest doskonałym miejscem na zorganizowanie spotkania biznesowego. Name: Savoy Hotel - Mamaia
Company description: 🏖️ Bine ați venit la Hotelul Savoy 4****, o oază de liniște și confort situată în zond a stațiunii Mamaia, direct pe plaja idilică a Mării Negre. 🏨 Avem 143 de spații de cazare, împărțite în camere duble, camere family și apartamente, toate decorate în culori calde și primitoare, oferind vederi panoramice uimitoare. 🅿️ Parcarea este gratuită, în limita locurilor disponibile. 🌟 Fie că sunteți aici pentru afaceri, vacanță sau team-building, Hotelul Savoy Mamaia este alegerea ideală pentru o ședere de neuitat

Name: Hotel Oslo Coimbra

Name: Haga Slott
Company description: Hos oss på Haga Slott kan du boka konferenslokaler och konferenspaket i slottsmiljö. Vi finns i Enköping, hjärtat av mälardalen, med närhet till Stockholm. Name: Nobis Hospitality Group
Company description: Founded in 1987 by Alessandro Catenacci, Nobis Hospitality Group is a family-owned group of first-class hotels, restaurants, bars, nightclubs and meeting and event venues in Stockholm, expanding into international markets. Company description: Hotel Platinum Palace***** położony jest w historycznej części Wrocławia w pobliżu zabytkowego Parku Południowego. Company description: Manufaktura The Coffee Shop Restaurant turns every experience into a story with personalized touches, whether it's good food or the best coffee. Name: YP Master AB
Company description: We have rented out apartments to companies since 1986, from 1999 in Sweden. Name: Guö Värdshus
Company description: Hotell, restaurang, konferens, fester, bröllop, avkoppling och skärgård! Visste du att Blekinge har en fantastisk skärgård? Det vet vi. För längst inne i Guöviken, med Blekinge skärgård alldeles utanför bryggan hittar du Guö Värdshus. Värdshuset uppfördes under 1800-talets andra hälft. Tack vare den erkände krögaren Berndt Svensson, blev Guö ett värdshus att räkna med. Även utanför Sveriges gränser pratades det om det vackra värdshuset vid Blekinges kust. Idag ägs och drivs Guö Värdshus, samt skärgårdsön och systeranläggningen Tjärö, av familjen Althin. Under 2012 genomfördes en varsam renovering av Guö Värdshus. Huvudbyggnaden har kvar sin historiska värdshuscharm och är inrett med tidstypiska detaljer i ljusa och sobra färger. I huvudbyggnaden finner du reception, lobby, bar, restaurang och våra mindre konferensrum. Under 1990-talet byggdes en flygel med 24 hotellrum, samt ett större konferensrum. Här bor du bekvämt och funktionellt i hemtrevligt inredda hotellrum.  Närmsta ö, från Guöviken sett, är Tjärö. Tjärö är vår alldeles egna skärgårdsö. Under den varmare delen av året erbjuder vi boende och aktiviteter i sann bullerbyanda på Tjärö.

Name: Norrqvarn Hotell & Konferens

Name: Villa Aske
Company description: NÄR DITT FÖRETAG BEHÖVER EN PLATS FÖR SAMTAL  VILLA ASKE byggdes för drygt 200 år sedan med en florentinsk renässansvilla som förebild. Under åren har rummen fyllts av korta ordväxlingar, långa diskussioner och förtroliga samtal.  För att lära, skapa eller bygga relationer. Allt sånt där som bara ett riktigt bra snack kan ge. Exakt vad alla människor har pratat om under åren vet vi förstås inte. Men vi vet att de har lockats av VILLA ASKE som en oas med smak av Italien – mitt bland åkrar och skog utanför Stockholm. Och vi vet att människor fungerar likadant nu som då.  Dras dina tankar till Italien? Eller till konferens? Det spelar ingen roll för båda är rätt. Vi hyllar VILLA ASKES historia genom att erbjuda allt du behöver för en konferens – med en italiensk touch. Mat, dryck och samtal står fortfarande i fokus, men nu med wifi och flera sorters parmesan. Vi vill också poängtera att upplevelsen inte bara sitter i VILLA ASKES väggar. Omgivningen är också viktig, inte minst för att en stor del av maten vi bjuder på kommer därifrån.  Ta med medarbetarna på en resa till uppländska Florens – bara ca 30 minuter från Stockholm eller Arlanda.

Company description: Välkommen till ett av stadens mest centrala hotell, dessutom ett av de största hotellen i centrala Örebro, med 115 rum. Name: Stora Hotellet Umeå
Company description: Regarded as Swedenʼs most spectacular hotel project, Umeåʼs classic hotel, Stora Hotellet, has reopend in March 2014 following a two-year closure for renovation. Concept developed by the award-winning concept, architecture, and identity agency Stylt Trampoli Stora Hotellet has 82 unique rooms that run from spacious suites to compact cabins. There is a restaurant, bar, library and conference rooms. When Stora Hotellet opened in 1895 it was a place where those two worlds met. This was Umeå’s major hotel for over a century and extensive refurbishment was carried out prior to the reopening to mark Umeå being named European Capital of Culture 2014. The hotel stands once again in its seafaring finery, ready to welcome guests for another 100 years.

Name: Countryside Hotels Sweden
Company description: Countryside Hotels är en samling av 42 av Sveriges mest personliga hotellupplevelser – från slott och värdshus till designhotell och pensionat. Vi samlar destinationer värda en resa, och arbetar för att lyfta det genuina, det hållbara och det som gör den svenska hotellkulturen unik.

Name: Interparking Polska
Company description: Interparking jest jednym z czołowych graczy w europejskim sektorze parkingowym, budującym swoją pozycję od ponad sześćdziesięciu lat. Nasza działalność obejmuje kluczowe miasta w Europie, gdzie zyskaliśmy lojalność licznych klientów. Dzięki konsekwentnemu rozwojowi, obecnie oferujemy nasze usługi w dziewięciu krajach: Belgii, Holandii, Francji, Niemczech, Austrii, Włoszech, Hiszpanii, Polsce oraz Rumunii. Na terenie Polski nasze parkingi znaleźć można w Warszawie, Gdańsku, Balicach, Poznaniu, Pabianicach, Wrocławiu, Krakowie. Nasza strategia opiera się na trzech kluczowych filarach: - Ciągłe doskonalenie jakości naszych usług, aby sprostać oczekiwaniom klientów i dynamicznym potrzebom miast; - Wprowadzanie innowacyjnych rozwiązań transportowych, które pomagają zmierzyć się z wyzwaniami związanymi z urbanizacją; - Dbałość o środowisko naturalne poprzez odpowiedzialną politykę firmową. Nasze zobowiązanie do doskonałości, innowacyjności i zrównoważonego rozwoju sprawia, że jesteśmy niezawodnym partnerem dla klientów oraz miast, w których działamy.

Dzięki temu jesteśmy w stanie szybko reagować, oferując skuteczne wsparcie sprzedażowe i efektywny marketing przez cały rok. W wyniku kilku miesięcy współpracy nasi klienci osiągnęli imponujące wyniki, zwiększając swoją sprzedaż nawet o 40% (jak w przypadku Hotelu Smile*** w Szczawnicy-Zdroju) lub obniżając koszty sprzedaży i promocji nawet o 27% (jak w przypadku Resortu Grand Laola SPA i Apartamentów w Pobierowie) w porównywalnym sezonie wysokim w 2022 roku. Współpraca z KCHC pozwoli zredukować koszty prowizji z tytułu sprzedaży przez kanały OTA i jednocześnie skutecznie zwiększyć promocję sprzedaży ofert bezpośrednich, nawet w nadchodzącym niskim sezonie. Name: Hotel Elbląg
Company description: Hotel Elblag’s origins stretch back almost 450 years in history. Its architectural style, known as Dutch Mannerism is a northern version of Italian Renaissance. From 1636 to 1945, the owners who included patricians, mayors, politicians and bankers held the privilege of hosting important visitors to the city. Polish, Swedish and Prussian kings and Kaisers slept here including the founding father of the modern Russian state, Peter the Great – so when deciding on staying with us, you are following in the steps of the chosen ones! Through its commitment to exceptional service and unique offerings, Unlock Boutique Hotels strives to be a leader in the boutique hospitality sector, inviting travelers to explore the charm and diversity of the country.

Name: The Studio Hotel
Company description: Bo bekvämt över natten eller i flera veckor i Kistas bäst rankade hotell - minuter från Stockholm. Stockholm city når du snabbt med tunnelbana (18 minuter) och pendeltåg (13 minuter).

A VOM faz projectos personalizados e apresenta os designados chave na mão, respeitando a normalização existente. Como principais produtos são de referir expositores verticais (congelados, conservação, panorâmicos), bancadas de trabalho, máquinas de café e sumo, ar condicionado, os pavimentos e ventilação. A assistência técnica assegura, entre outros serviços, contratos de manutenção, decoração e instalações eléctricas.

Name: Best Western Arlanda Hotellby
Company description: Familjeägda Arlanda Hotellby,  nära  Stockholm Arlanda Airport, och bara 30 minuter från Stockholm City. Läget gör att hotellet passar lika bra för individuella gäster som för grupper och konferenser som vill bo eller mötas nära Arlanda Flygplats. Hotellrummen ligger i 17 charmiga gårdshus som tillsammans med ett bevarat torp med tillhörande gärdsgård, formar en gemytlig liten by. En gratis transferbuss avgår till och från Stockholm Arlanda Airports samtliga terminaler var 40:e minut. Vi hämtar våra gäster utanför alla terminaler, T4 på hållplats 11 mer info finns på hållplatsen, på T 2 och 3 hållplats 7 samt terminal 5 hämtas våra gäster på hållplats 13 .Bussen utgår  var 40 min från hotellet. Här finns också en inhägnad och TV-övervakad långtidsparkering till ett extra förmånligt pris för dig som är gäst.  Arlanda Hotellbys läge är idealiskt för att samla lokala och influgna deltagare för konferenser, möten, events, kick-off eller utbildningar. I de ljusa möteslokalerna kan upp till 125 personer mötas, naturligtvis med den allra senaste tekniken - inklusive möjligheter till videokonferens. WiFi finns självklart att tillgå i hela hotellet och är, liksom det välutrustade gymmet med bastu, gratis för hotellets gäster. Hotellets restaurang serverar vällagade rätter med inspiration från hela världen och den uppskattade hotellfrukosten serveras redan från kl. 04.00 för dem som har ett tidigt flyg att passa.  Familjen Azizsson önskar dig varmt välkommen till Arlanda Hotellby.

Name: Hotel Gyllene Uttern
Company description: På en klippa, söder om Gränna, reser sig trappstegsgavlarna på denna ståtliga slottsborg. Vi erbjuder konferenser, boende och mat - till en fantastisk utsikt över Vättern och Visingsö.

Name: Lastberget Konferens - Människor Och Möten
Company description: Kreativa möten - personlig omtanke. Endast 45 minuter från Arlanda, Stockholm Uppsala och Västerås finner Du en kreativ mötesanläggning. Strax utanför Bålsta vid Mälaren omgiven av skogens grönska är Lastberget vackert beläget. Lastberget byggdes 1984 och är ritad av Owe Svärd. Arkitektens tanke med konferensanläggningen var just "mötet" och som en röd tråd följer rymd och flexibilitet i arkitekturen. Han har tagit med den vackra naturen och låtit berget komma in i byggnaden på flera ställen. Utsikten mot Mälaren är fantastisk och kan njutas från alla hotellrum, matsal och lounge.  Vårt fokus är möten! Konferenser, kick offer, planeringsdagar, minimässor, mingelkvällar, utbildningsdagar, temafester, bröllopsfester, weekends, möten mm. Det finns 78 hotellrum och 130 bäddar. Vi har 8 konferenslokaler och 9000 kvm yta att mötas på.  Välkomna!

Name: Hotell Bellevue
Company description: Hos oss kommer du att få uppleva lugnet och det häpnadsväckande landskapet när solen går upp över en av Sveriges största sjöar, Vättern. Bli kär i Hjos kulturminnesförklarade Stadspark eller fyren vid bryggorna samt hotellets slående arkitektur och rika historia. Skaraborg är känt som Sveriges skafferi så glöm inte att ta dig tid att njuta av middag och några drinkar i vår populära restaurang som erbjuder lokalt producerad förstklassig mat och levande musik under utvalda kvällar. Company description: O Monte Prado Minho encontra-se entre o Rio Minho e o Gerês e as cadeias montanhosas da Galiza. Company description: Palheiro Golf, part of the Palheiro Nature Estate on Madeira Island, offers a luxurious and serene golfing experience set against stunning ocean and city views. The family project “SELÃO DA EIRA – Turismo Rural no Alentejo” on the south-west coast of Portugal coincides with this increasing desire to revitalize by getting in touch with nature once in a while. Truly unique is the Nature Paradise "Selão da Eira Velha" located in a river valley with own forest, lakes, animals and bio gardening  in plain National Ecological Reserve Yet, we understand that "nature" is more than the green space around accommodations and resorts, not just the backdrop for relaxing holidays and retreats.  Nature is complex and mighty - it provides resources and can cure, but will hit hard on our lives and the living conditions on earth, if too late mankind will come to understand that natural resources have to be explored wisely and preserved carefully. If we want nature to remain our lifeline and not become the source and cause of life-threatening disasters, we MUST recognize the "sustainability issue" as utterly urgent. Ours and future generations must take the challenge to think deeply and work rock-hard on adequate strategies and practices for sustainability to become a mainstream paradigm. SELÃO DA EIRA develops and acts in that consciousness, and is a certificated member of the BIOSPHERE international community oriented towards the sustainability goals of the UN Agenda Horizon 2030.

Na zona, a habitação é conhecida por "Casa dos Três Deputados", por três dos seus proprietários terem exercido funções parlamentares. Imagine your team brainstorming under ancient trees, engaging in collaborative discussions around a fire, or simply unwinding in the stillness of the wilderness or in our renovated stone Mills dating from Roman times. Whether you’re planning a leadership summit, strategic retreat, or a C suite seminar, Tinhela610 is the ultimate destination to host your next corporate event. Name: Hotel & Restaurant Na Półboru
Company description: Hotel Na Półboru is situated in a picturesque area near the nature reserve. It is ideal for those who appreciate the holiday away from the big cities and resorts.  Our advantage is the location in the center of Poland, near the S8 route.  The hotel is located at the national road no. 14 between two county towns: Sieradz - Zduńska Wola.  Both Sieradz and Zduńska Wola are characterized by tourist attractions. Sieradz is famous for its Landscape Park Międzyrzecze Warty and Widawka, the City Theater, or the revitalized Castle Hill with an open air museum.  Zduńska Wola is associated primarily with the birthplace of St. Maximilian Kolbe, here is the Birthplace of the Holy, which is his historic biographical museum.  The town of Zduńska Wola is located in the Kępina Lagoon - an ideal place for anglers, as well as the Museum of Zduńska Wola Karsznice, where there are several dozen locomotives.  We offer 63 rooms with free internet access.  We have three saunas, gym, billiards, tennis court, basketball and volleyball court, we also offer the possibility of renting bicycles and sticks for Nordic walking, hiking around Sieradz and Zduńska Wola.  In addition, we have two air-conditioned conference and banquet rooms equipped with audiovisual equipment, accommodating 50 and 30 people.  In addition, in a short time guests will be able to use the hall for up to 300 people and can be divided into three separate rooms. Our customers can taste delicious Polish and European dishes served in the modern and elegant Terrace Restaurant and a 24/7 self-service bar.  You're welcome!

Company description: I höstas drabbades Natasha av cancer. Möten i studentföreningarna byttes mot läkarbesök på Hematologen på Sahlgrenska Sjukhuset. Studierna vid Chalmers Tekniska Högskola ersattes av soffmaraton framför tv:n. Efter två veckor var håret borta. Utbytesterminen i Schweiz blev inte av. När livet sätts på sin spets kommer tillvaron förändras. Man vet inte hur förrän man har gått igenom det. Natashas syster Philippa har tagit med sig kameran på cellgiftsbehandlingar, vilostunder och långsamma promenader. Hon har fotat det som gör ont och det som har lindrat. Tanken med fotona var att dokumentera sjukdomstiden för att minnas. Nu, med fem cellgiftsbehandlingar avklarade och fyra kvar, har Natasha och Philippa börjat sammanställa en fotoutställning. Våren 2014 kommer den öppna för allmänheten. Målet är att samla in pengar till cancerfonden. Hjälp oss att hjälpa andra! English This fall Natasha suffered from the cancer form lymphoma. Meetings with the student unions were exchanged for medical appointments at the hematologist at Sahlgrenska Hospital in Gothenburg. The studies at Chalmers University were replaced by time in bed, watching TV. After two weeks, the hair was gone. The exchange semester in Switzerland was not an option anymore and Natasha started a completely new chapter of her life. When you life is put to the test that’s your life will change for real. One does not know how until you have gone through it. Natasha's sister, Philippa, has taken her camera in chemotherapy treatments, periods of chaos and times that are better. She has photographed what hurts and what has been alleviated. The idea of the photos was to document the disease to remember it. Now, with six chemotherapy treatments completed and three left, Natasha and Philippa has started to compile all the photos for a photographic exhibition. This exhibition will take place during the spring of 2014. The goal is to raise money for Cancerfonden. Help us to help others!

Therefore, let us introduce you to “Edelweiss”, our 210- seat saloon, where you can enjoy your big day, and relish mouth-watering dishes in our a la carte restaurant or the one dedicated to ceremonies. So, let us introduce you the rest of the best: three bars, an exquisite 50 -seat terrace, with a fully-equipped kitchen, grill area, interior and exterior pool, both for adults and kids, pool and table tennis, dry sauna, massage room and free parking.
